Joshua: Vayehi achare mot moshe eved Adonai vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua bin-nun mesharet moshe lemor
Moshe avdi met veatta kum avor et-hayyarden hazze atta vechal-haam hazze el-haaretz asher anochi noten lahem livne yisrael
Kal-makom asher tidroch kaf-raglechem bo lachem netattiv kaasher dibbarti el-moshe
Mehammidbar vehallevanon hazze vead-hannahar haggadol nehar-perat kol eretz hachittim vead-hayyam haggadol mevo hashshamesh yihye gevulchem
Lo-yityatztzev ish lefanecha kol yeme chayyecha kaasher hayiti im-moshe ehye immach lo arpecha velo eezvekka
Chazak veematz ki atta tanchil et-haam hazze et-haaretz asher-nishbati laavotam latet lahem
Rak chazak veematz meod lishmor laasot kechal-hattora asher tzivvecha moshe avdi al-tasur mimmennu yamin usmol lemaan taskil bechol asher telech
Lo-yamush sefer hattora hazze mippicha vehagita bo yomam valayela lemaan tishmor laasot kechal-hakkatuv bo ki-az tatzliach et-derachecha veaz taskil
Halo tziviticha chazak veematz al-taarotz veal-techat ki immecha Adonai elohecha bechol asher telech
Vayetzav yehoshua et-shotre haam lemor
Ivru bekerev hammachane vetzauu et-haam lemor hachinu lachem tzeda ki beod sheloshet yamim attem ovrim et-hayyarden hazze lavo lareshet et-haaretz asher Adonai elohechem noten lachem lerishtah
Velaruveni velaggadi velachatzi shevet hamnashshe amar yehoshua lemor
Zachor et-haddavar asher tziva etchem moshe eved-Adonai lemor Adonai elohechem meniach lachem venatan lachem et-haaretz hazzot
Neshechem tappechem umiknechem yeshvu baaretz asher natan lachem moshe beever hayyarden veattem taavru chamushim lifne achechem kol gibbore hachayil vaazartem otam

Ad asher-yaniach Adonai laachechem kachem veyarshu gam-hemma et-haaretz asher-Adonai elohechem noten lahem veshavtem leeretz yerushshatchem virishtem otah asher natan lachem moshe eved Adonai beever hayyarden mizrach hashshamesh
Vayyaanu et-yehoshua lemor kol asher-tzivitanu naase veel-kal-asher tishlachenu nelech
Kechol asher-shamanu el-moshe ken nishma elecha rak yihye Adonai elohecha immach kaasher haya im-moshe
Kal-ish asher-yamre et-picha velo-yishma et-devarecha lechol asher-tetzavennu yumat rak chazak veematz
Vayyishlach yehoshua-bin-nun min-hashshittim shenayim-anashim meraggelim cheresh lemor lechu reu et-haaretz veet-yericho vayyelchu vayyavou bet-ishsha zona ushmah rachav vayyishkevu-shamma
Vayyeamar lemelech yericho lemor hinne anashim bau henna hallayela mibbene yisrael lachpor et-haaretz
Vayyishlach melech yericho el-rachav lemor hotzii haanashim habbaim elayich asher-bau levetech ki lachpor et-kal-haaretz bau
Vattikkach haishsha et-shene haanashim vattitzpeno vattomer ken bau elay haanashim velo yadati meayin hemma
Vayehi hashshaar lisgor bachoshech vehaanashim yatzau lo yadati ana halchu haanashim ridfu maher acharehem ki tassigum
Vehi heelatam haggaga vattitmenem befishte haetz haaruchot lah al-haggag
Vehaanashim radfu acharehem derech hayyarden al hammaberot vehashshaar sagaru achare kaasher yatzu harodfim acharehem
Vehemma terem yishkavun vehi alta alehem al-haggag
Vattomer el-haanashim yadati ki-natan Adonai lachem et-haaretz vechi-nafla ematchem alenu vechi namogu kal-yoshve haaretz mippenechem
Ki shamanu et asher-hovish Adonai et-me yam-suf mippenechem betzetchem mimmitzrayim vaasher asitem lishne malche haemori asher beever hayyarden lesichon ulog asher hecheramtem otam
Vannishma vayyimmas levavenu velo-kama od ruach beish mippenechem ki Adonai elohechem hu elohim bashshamayim mimmaal veal-haaretz mittachat
Veatta hishshavu-na li ba-Adonai ki-asiti immachem chased vaasitem gam-attem im-bet avi chesed untattem li ot emet
Vehachayitem et-avi veet-immi veet-achay achotay veet kal-asher lahem vehitztzaltem et-nafshotenu mimmavet
Vayyomru lah haanashim nafshenu tachtechem lamut im lo taggidu et-devarenu ze vehaya betet-Adonai lanu et-haaretz veasinu immach chesed veemet
Vattoridem bachevel bead hachallon ki vetah bekir hachoma uvachoma hi yoshavet
Vattomer lahem hahara lechu pen-yifgeu vachem harodfim venachbetem shamma sheloshet yamim ad shov harodfim veachar telchu ledarkechem
Vayyomru eleha haanashim nekiyyim anachnu mishshevuatech hazze asher hishbatanu
Hinne anachnu vaim baaretz et-tikvat chut hashshani hazze tiksheri bachallon asher horadtenu vo veet-avich veet-immech veet-achayich veet kal-bet avich taasfi elayich habbayeta
Vehaya kol asher-yetze middalte vetech hachutza damo verosho vaanachnu nekiyyim vechol asher yihye ittach babbayit damo veroshenu im-yad tihye-bo
Veim-taggidi et-devarenu ze vehayinu nekiyyim mishshevuatech asher hishbatanu
Vattomer kedivrechem ken-hu vatteshallechem vayyelechu vattikshor et-tikvat hashshani bachallon
Vayyelchu vayyavou hahara vayyeshvu sham sheloshet yamim ad-shavu harodfim vayevakshu harodfim bechal-hadderech velo matzau
Vayyashuvu shene haanashim vayyerdu mehahar vayyaavru vayyavou el-yehoshua bin-nun vayesapperu-lo et kal-hammotzot otam
Vayyomru el-yehoshua ki-natan Adonai beyadenu et-kal-haaretz vegam-namogu kal-yoshve haaretz mippanenu
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyisu mehashshittim vayyavou ad-hayyarden hu vechal-bene yisrael vayyalinu sham terem yaavoru
Vayehi miktze sheloshet yamim vayyaavru hashshotrim bekerev hammachane
Vayetzauu et-haam lemor kirotchem et aron berit-Adonai elohechem vehakkohanim halviyyim nosim oto veattem tisu mimmekomchem vahalachtem acharav
Ach rachok yihye benechem uvenav kealpayim amma bammidda al-tikrevu elav lemaan asher-tedu et-hadderech asher telchu-vah ki lo avartem badderech mittemol shilshom
Vayyomer yehoshua el-haam hitkaddashu ki machar yaase Adonai bekirbechem niflaot
Vayyomer yehoshua el-hakkohanim lemor seu et-aron habberit veivru lifne haam vayyisu et-aron habberit vayyelchu lifne haam
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua hayyom hazze achel gaddelcha beene kal-yisrael asher yedun ki kaasher hayiti im-moshe ehye immach
Veatta tetzave et-hakkohanim nose aron-habberit lemor kevoachem ad-ketze me hayyarden bayyarden taamodu
Vayyomer yehoshua el-bene yisrael goshu henna veshimu et-divre Adonai elohechem
Vayyomer yehoshua bezot tedun ki el chay bekirbechem vehoresh yorish mippenechem et-hakkenaani veet-hachitti veet-hachivi veet-happerizzi veet-haggirgashi vehaemori vehayevusi
Hinne aron habberit adon kal-haaretz over lifnechem bayyarden
Veatta kechu lachem shene asar ish mishshivte yisrael ish-echad ish-echad lashshavet
Vehaya kenoach kappot ragle hakkohanim nose aron Adonai adon kal-haaretz beme hayyarden me hayyarden yikkaretun hammayim hayyordim milmala veyaamdu ned echad
Vayehi binsoa haam meaholehem laavor et-hayyarden vehakkohanim nose haaron habberit lifne haam
Uchvo nose haaron ad-hayyarden veragle hakkohanim nose haaron nitbelu biktze hammayim vehayyarden male al-kal-gedotav kol yeme katzir
Vayyaamdu hammayim hayyordim milmala kamu ned-echad harchek meod meadam hair asher mitztzad tzartan vehayyordim al yam haarava yam-hammelach tammu nichratu vehaam avru neged yericho
Vayyaamdu hakkohanim nose haaron berit-Adonai becharava betoch hayyarden hachen vechal-yisrael ovrim becharava ad asher-tammu kal-haggoy laavor et-hayyarden
Vayehi kaasher-tammu chal-haggoy laavor et-hayyarden f vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua lemor
Kechu lachem min-haam shenem asar anashim ish-echad ish-echad mishshavet
Vetzauu otam lemor seu-lachem mizze mittoch hayyarden mimmatztzav ragle hakkohanim hachin shettem-esre avanim vehaavartem otam immachem vehinnachtem otam bammalon asher-talinu vo hallayela
Vayyikra yehoshua el-shenem heasar ish asher hechin mibbene yisrael ish-echad ish-echad mishshavet
Vayyomer lahem yehoshua ivru lifne aron Adonai elohechem el-toch hayyarden veharimu lachem ish even achat al-shichmo lemispar shivte vene-yisrael
Lemaan tihye zot ot bekirbechem ki-yishalun benechem machar lemor ma haavanim haelle lachem
Vaamartem lahem asher nichretu meme hayyarden mippene aron berit-Adonai beavro bayyarden nichretu me hayyarden vehau haavanim haelle lezikkaron livne yisrael ad-olam

Vayyaasu-chen bene-yisrael kaasher tziva yehoshua vayyisu shette-esre avanim mittoch hayyarden kaasher dibber Adonai el-yehoshua lemispar shivte vene-yisrael vayyaavirum immam el-hammalon vayyannichum sham
Ushtem esre avanim hekim yehoshua betoch hayyarden tachat matztzav ragle hakkohanim nose aron habberit vayyihu sham ad hayyom hazze
Vehakkohanim nose haaron omdim betoch hayyarden ad tom kal-haddavar asher-tziva Adonai et-yehoshua ledabber el-haam kechol asher-tziva moshe et-yehoshua vayemaharu haam vayyaavoru
Vayehi kaasher-tam kal-haam laavor vayyaavor aron-Adonai vehakkohanim lifne haam
Vayyaavru bene-reuven uvne-gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe chamushim lifne bene yisrael kaasher dibber alehem moshe
Kearbaim elef chalutze hatztzava avru lifne Adonai lammilchama el arvot yericho
Bayyom hahu giddal Adonai et-yehoshua beene kal-yisrael vayyiru oto kaasher yaru et-moshe kal-yeme chayyav
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua lemor
Tzave et-hakkohanim nose aron haedut veyaalu min-hayyarden
Vayetzav yehoshua et-hakkohanim lemor alu min-hayyarden
Vayehi kaalot hakkohanim nose aron berit-Adonai mittoch hayyarden nitteku kappot ragle hakkohanim el hecharava vayyashuvu me-hayyarden limkomam vayyelchu chitmol-shilshom al-kal-gedotav
Vehaam alu min-hayyarden beasor lachodesh harishon vayyachanu baggilgal biktze mizrach yericho
Veet shettem esre haavanim haelle asher lakchu min-hayyarden hekim yehoshua baggilgal
Vayyomer el-bene yisrael lemor asher yishalun benechem machar et-avotam lemor ma haavanim haelle
Vehodatem et-benechem lemor bayyabbasha avar yisrael et-hayyarden hazze
Asher-hovish Adonai elohechem et-me hayyarden mippenechem ad-avrechem kaasher asa Adonai elohechem leyam-suf asher-hovish mippanenu ad-avrenu
Lemaan daat kal-amme haaretz et-yad Adonai ki chazaka hi lemaan yeratem et-Adonai elohechem kal-hayyamim

Vayehi chishmoa kal-malche haemori asher beever hayyarden yamma vechal-malche hakkenaani asher al-hayyam et asher-hovish Adonai et-me hayyarden mippene vene-yisrael avram vayyimmas levavam velo-haya vam od ruach mippene bene-yisrael
Baet hahi amar Adonai el-yehoshua ase lecha charvot tzurim veshuv mol et-bene-yisrael shenit
Vayyaas-lo yehoshua charvot tzurim vayyamal et-bene yisrael el-givat haaralot
Veze haddavar asher-mal yehoshua kal-haam hayyotze mimmitzrayim hazzecharim kol anshe hammilchama metu vammidbar badderech betzetam mimmitzrayim
Ki-mulim hau kal-haam hayyotzim vechal-haam hayyillodim bammidbar badderech betzetam mimmitzrayim lo-malu

Ki arbaim shana halchu vene-yisrael bammidbar ad-tom kal-haggoy anshe hammilchama hayyotzim mimmitzrayim asher lo-shamu bekol Adonai asher nishba Adonai lahem levilti harotam et-haaretz asher nishba Adonai laavotam latet lanu eretz zavat chalav udvash
Veet-benehem hekim tachtam otam mal yehoshua ki-arelim hau ki lo-malu otam baddarech
Vayehi kaasher-tammu chal-haggoy lehimmol vayyeshvu tachtam bammachane ad chaotam
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua hayyom galloti et-cherpat mitzrayim mealechem vayyikra shem hammakom hahu gilgal ad hayyom hazze
Vayyachanu vene-yisrael baggilgal vayyaasu et-happesach bearbaa asar yom lachodesh baerev bearvot yericho
Vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmachorat happesach matztzot vekaluy beetzem hayyom hazze
Vayyishbot hamman mimmachorat beachlam meavur haaretz velo-haya od livne yisrael man vayyochlu mittevuat eretz kenaan bashshana hahi
Vayehi bihot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vehinne-ish omed lenegdo vecharbo shelufa beyado vayyelech yehoshua elav vayyomer lo halanu atta im-letzarenu
Vayyomer lo ki ani sar-tzeva-Adonai atta vati vayyippol yehoshua el-panav artza vayyishtachu vayyomer lo ma adoni medabber el-avdo
Vayyomer sar-tzeva Adonai el-yehoshua shal-naalcha meal raglecha ki hammakom asher atta omed alav kodesh hu vayyaas yehoshua ken
Viricho sogeret umsuggeret mippene bene yisrael en yotze veen ba
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua ree natatti veyadcha et-yericho veet-malkah gibbore hechayil
Vesabbotem et-hair kol anshe hammilchama hakkef et-hair paam echat ko taase sheshet yamim
Veshiva chohanim yisu shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne haaron uvayyom hashshevii tasobbu et-hair sheva peamim vehakkohanim yitkeu bashshofarot
Vehaya bimshoch bekeren hayyovel keshamachem et-kol hashshofar yariu chal-haam terua gedola venafla chomat hair tachteha vealu haam ish negdo
Vayyikra yehoshua bin-nun el-hakkohanim vayyomer alehem seu et-aron habberit veshiva chohanim yisu shiva shofrot yovlim lifne aron Adonai
Vayyomer el-haam ivru vesobbu et-hair vehechalutz yaavor lifne aron Adonai
Vayehi keemor yehoshua el-haam veshiva hakkohanim nosim shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne Adonai avru vetaku bashshofarot vaaron berit Adonai holech acharehem
Vehechalutz holech lifne hakkohanim toke hashshofarot vehamassef holech achare haaron haloch vetakoa bashshofarot
Veet-haam tziva yehoshua lemor lo tariu velo-tashmiu et-kolchem velo-yetze mippichem davar ad yom amri alechem hariu vahariotem
Vayyassev aron-Adonai et-hair hakkef paam echat vayyavou hammachane vayyalinu bammachane
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyisu hakkohanim et-aron Adonai
Veshiva hakkohanim nosim shiva shofrot hayyovlim lifne aron Adonai holchim haloch vetaku bashshofarot vehechalutz holech lifnehem vehamassef holech achare aron Adonai haloch vetakoa bashshofarot
Vayyasobbu et-hair bayyom hashsheni paam achat vayyashuvu hammachane ko asu sheshet yamim
Vayehi bayyom hashshevii vayyashkimu kaalot hashshachar vayyasobbu et-hair kammishpat hazze sheva peamim rak bayyom hahu savvu et-hair sheva peamim
Vayehi bappaam hashsheviit taku hakkohanim bashshofarot vayyomer yehoshua el-haam hariu ki-natan Adonai lachem et-hair
Vehayeta hair cherem hi vechal-asher-bah la-Adonai rak rachav hazzona tichye hi vechal-asher ittah babbayit ki hechbeata et-hammalachim asher shalachnu
Verak-attem shimru min-hacherem pen-tacharimu ulkachtem min-hacherem vesamtem et-machane yisrael lecherem vaachartem oto
Vechol kesef vezahav uchle nechoshet uvarzel kodesh hu la-Adonai otzar Adonai yavo
Vayyara haam vayyitkeu bashshofarot vayehi chishmoa haam et-kol hashshofar vayyariu haam terua gedola vattippol hachoma tachteha vayyaal haam haira ish negdo vayyilkedu et-hair
Vayyacharimu et-kal-asher bair meish vead-ishsha minnaar vead-zaken vead shor vase vachamor lefi-charev
Velishnayim haanashim hamraggelim et-haaretz amar yehoshua bou bet-haishsha hazzona vehotziu mishsham et-haishsha veet-kal-asher-lah kaasher nishbatem lah
Vayyavou hannearim hamraggelim vayyotziu et-rachav veet-aviha veet-immah veet-acheha veet-kal-asher-lah veet kal-mishpechoteha hotziu vayyannichum michutz lemachane yisrael
Vehair sarfu vaesh vechal-asher-bah rak hakkesef vehazzahav uchle hannechoshet vehabbarzel natnu otzar bet-Adonai
Veet-rachav hazzona veet-bet aviha veet-kal-asher-lah hecheya yehoshua vatteshev bekerev yisrael ad hayyom hazze ki hechbia et-hammalachim asher-shalach yehoshua leraggel et-yericho
Vayyashba yehoshua baet hahi lemor arur haish lifne Adonai asher yakum uvana et-hair hazzot et-yericho bivchoro yeyassedenna uvitziro yatztziv delateha
Vayehi Adonai et-yehoshua vayehi shamo bechal-haaretz
Vayyimalu vene-yisrael maal bacherem vayyikkach achan ben-karmi ven-zavdi ven-zerach lematte yehuda min-hacherem vayyichar-af Adonai bivne yisrael
Vayyishlach yehoshua anashim miricho haay asher im-bet aven mikkedem levet-el vayyomer alehem lemor alu veraggelu et-haaretz vayyaalu haanashim vayeraggelu et-haay
Vayyashuvu el-yehoshua vayyomru elav al-yaal kal-haam kealpayim ish o kishloshet alafim ish yaalu veyakku et-haay al-teyagga-shamma et-kal-haam ki meat hemma
Vayyaalu min-haam shamma kishloshet alafim ish vayyanusu lifne anshe haay
Vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish vayyirdefum lifne hashshaar ad-hashshevarim vayyakkum bammorad vayyimmas levav-haam vayehi lemayim
Vayyikra yehoshua simlotav vayyippol al-panav artza lifne aron Adonai ad-haerev hu vezikne yisrael vayyaalu afar al-rosham
Vayyomer yehoshua ahah adonay Adonai lama heavarta haavir et-haam hazze et-hayyarden latet otanu beyad haemori lehaavidenu velu hoalnu vanneshev beever hayyarden
Bi adonay ma omar achare asher hafach yisrael oref lifne oyevav
Veyishmeu hakkenaani vechol yoshve haaretz venasabbu alenu vehichritu et-shemenu min-haaretz uma-taase leshimcha haggadol
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua kum lach lamma ze atta nofel al-panecha
Chata yisrael vegam avru et-beriti asher tziviti otam vegam lakchu min-hacherem vegam ganvu vegam kichashu vegam samu vichlehem
Velo yuchlu bene yisrael lakum lifne oyevehem oref yifnu lifne oyevehem ki hau lecherem lo osif lihot immachem im-lo tashmidu hacherem mikkirbechem
Kum kaddesh et-haam veamarta hitkaddeshu lemachar ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael cherem bekirbecha yisrael lo tuchal lakum lifne oyevecha ad-hasirchem hacherem mikkirbechem

Venikravtem babboker leshivtechem vehaya hashshevet asher-yilkedennu Adonai yikrav lammishpachot vehammishpacha asher-yilkedenna Adonai tikrav labbattim vehabbayit asher yilkedennu Adonai yikrav laggevarim
Vehaya hannilkad bacherem yissaref baesh oto veet-kal-asher-lo ki avar et-berit Adonai vechi-asa nevala beyisrael
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyakrev et-yisrael lishvatav vayyillached shevet yehuda
Vayyakrev et-mishpachat yehuda vayyilkod et mishpachat hazzarchi vayyakrev et-mishpachat hazzarchi laggevarim vayyillached zavdi
Vayyakrev et-beto laggevarim vayyillached achan ben-karmi ven-zavdi ben-zerach lematte yehuda
Vayyomer yehoshua el-achan beni sim-na chavod la-Adonai elohe yisrael veten-lo toda vehagged-na li me asita al-techached mimmenni
Vayyaan achan et-yehoshua vayyomar amna anochi chatati la-Adonai elohe yisrael vechazot vechazot asiti
Vaere vashshalal adderet shinar achat tova umatayim shekalim kesef ulshon zahav echad chamishshim shekalim mishkalo vaechmedem vaekkachem vehinnam temunim baaretz betoch haaholi vehakkesef tachteha
Vayyishlach yehoshua malachim vayyarutzu haohela vehinne temuna beaholo vehakkesef tachteha
Vayyikkachum mittoch haohel vayevium el-yehoshua veel kal-bene yisrael vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai

Vayyikkach yehoshua et-achan ben-zerach veet-hakkesef veet-haadderet veet-leshon hazzahav veet-banav veet-benotav veet-shoro veet-chamoro veet-tzono veet-aholo veet-kal-asher-lo vechal-yisrael immo vayyaalu otam emek achor
Vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai bayyom hazze vayyirgemu oto chal-yisrael even vayyisrefu otam baesh vayyiskelu otam baavanim
Vayyakimu alav gal-avanim gadol ad hayyom hazze vayyashav Adonai mecharon appo al-ken kara shem hammakom hahu emek achor ad hayyom hazze
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira veal-techat kach immecha et kal-am hammilchama vekum ale haay ree natatti veyadcha et-melech haay veet-ammo veet-iro veet-artzo
Veasita laay ulmalkah kaasher asita liricho ulmalkah rak-shelalah uvhemtah tavozzu lachem sim-lecha orev lair meachareha
Vayyakam yehoshua vechal-am hammilchama laalot haay vayyivchar yehoshua sheloshim elef ish gibbore hachayil vayyishlachem layela
Vayetzav otam lemor reu attem orvim lair meachare hair al-tarchiku min-hair meod vihyitem kullechem nechonim
Vaani vechal-haam asher itti nikrav el-hair vehaya ki-yetzu likratenu kaasher barishona venasnu lifnehem
Veyatzu acharenu ad hattikenu otam min-hair ki yomru nasim lefanenu kaasher barishona venasnu lifnehem
Veattem takumu mehaorev vehorashtem et-hair untanah Adonai elohechem beyedchem
Vehaya ketafsechem et-hair tatztzitu et-hair baesh kidvar Adonai taasu reu tziviti etchem
Vayyishlachem yehoshua vayyelchu el-hammarav vayyeshvu ben bet-el uven haay miyyam laay vayyalen yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haam
Vayyashkem yehoshua babboker vayyifkod et-haam vayyaal hu vezikne yisrael lifne haam haay
Vechal-haam hammilchama asher itto alu vayyiggeshu vayyavou neged hair vayyachanu mitztzefon laay vehaggay benav uven-haay
Vayyikkach kachameshet alafim ish vayyasem otam orev ben bet-el uven haay miyyam lair
Vayyasimu haam et-kal-hammachane asher mitztzefon lair veet-akevo miyyam lair vayyelech yehoshua ballayela hahu betoch haemek
Vayehi kirot melech-haay vayemaharu vayyashkimu vayyetzu anshe-hair likrat-yisrael lammilchama hu vechal-ammo lammoed lifne haarava vehu lo yada ki-orev lo meachare hair
Vayyinnagu yehoshua vechal-yisrael lifnehem vayyanusu derech hammidbar
Vayyizzaaku kal-haam asher baay lirdof acharehem vayyirdefu achare yehoshua vayyinnatku min-hair
Velo-nishar ish baay uvet el asher lo-yatzu achare yisrael vayyaazvu et-hair petucha vayyirdefu achare yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua nete bakkidon asher-beyadcha el-haay ki veyadcha ettenenna vayyet yehoshua bakkidon asher-beyado el-hair
Vehaorev kam mehera mimmekomo vayyarutzu kintot yado vayyavou hair vayyilkeduha vayemaharu vayyatztzitu et-hair baesh
Vayyifnu anshe haay acharehem vayyiru vehinne ala ashan hair hashshamayema velo-haya vahem yadayim lanus henna vahenna vehaam hannas hammidbar nehpach el-harodef
Vihoshua vechal-yisrael rau ki-lachad haorev et-hair vechi ala ashan hair vayyashuvu vayyakku et-anshe haay
Veelle yatzu min-hair likratam vayyihu leyisrael battavech elle mizze veelle mizze vayyakku otam ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid ufalit
Veet-melech haay tafsu chay vayyakrivu oto el-yehoshua
Vayehi kechallot yisrael laharog et-kal-yoshve haay bassade bammidbar asher redafum bo vayyippelu chullam lefi-cherev ad-tummam vayyashuvu chal-yisrael haay vayyakku otah lefi-charev
Vayehi chal-hannoflim bayyom hahu meish vead-ishsha shenem asar alef kol anshe haay
Vihoshua lo-heshiv yado asher nata bakkidon ad asher hecherim et kal-yoshve haay
Rak habbehema ushlal hair hahi bazzu lahem yisrael kidvar Adonai asher tziva et-yehoshua
Vayyisrof yehoshua et-haay vayesimeha tel-olam shemama ad hayyom hazze
Veet-melech haay tala al-haetz ad-et haarev uchvo hashshemesh tziva yehoshua vayyoridu et-nivlato min-haetz vayyashlichu otah el-petach shaar hair vayyakimu alav gal-avanim gadol ad hayyom hazze
Az yivne yehoshua mizbeach la-Adonai elohe yisrael behar eval
Kaasher tziva moshe eved-Adonai et-bene yisrael kakkatuv besefer torat moshe mizbach avanim shelemot asher lo-henif alehen barzel vayyaalu alav olot la-Adonai vayyizbechu shelamim
Vayyichtav-sham al-haavanim et mishne torat moshe asher katav lifne bene yisrael

Vechal-yisrael uzkenav veshotrim veshoftav omdim mizze umizze laaron neged hakkohanim halviyyim nose aron berit-Adonai kagger kaezrach chetzo el-mul har-gerizim vehachetzo el-mul har-eval kaasher tziva moshe eved-Adonai levarech et-haam yisrael barishona
Veachare-chen kara et-kal-divre hattora habberacha vehakkelala kechal-hakkatuv besefer hattora
Lo-haya davar mikkol asher-tziva moshe asher lo-kara yehoshua neged kal-kehal yisrael vehannashim vehattaf vehagger haholech bekirbam
Vayehi chishmoa kal-hammelachim asher beever hayyarden bahar uvashshefela uvchol chof hayyam haggadol el-mul hallevanon hachitti vehaemori hakkenaani happerizzi hachivi vehayevusi
Vayyitkabbetzu yachdav lehillachem im-yehoshua veim-yisrael pe echad
Veyoshve givon shamu et asher asa yehoshua liricho velaay
Vayyaasu gam-hemma bearma vayyelchu vayyitztayyaru vayyikchu sakkim balim lachamorehem venodot yayin balim umvukkaim umtzorarim
Unalot balot umtullaot beraglehem uslamot balot alehem vechol lechem tzedam yavesh haya nikkudim
Vayyelchu el-yehoshua el-hammachane haggilgal vayyomru elav veel-ish yisrael meeretz rechoka banu veatta kirtu-lanu verit
Vayyomer ish-yisrael el-hachivi ulay bekirbi atta yoshev veech chrt-echrat- lecha verit
Vayyomru el-yehoshua avadecha anachnu vayyomer alehem yehoshua mi attem umeayin tavou
Vayyomru elav meeretz rechoka meod bau avadecha leshem Adonai elohecha ki-shamanu shamo veet kal-asher asa bemitzrayim
Veet kal-asher asa lishne malche haemori asher beever hayyarden lesichon melech cheshbon ulog melech-habbashan asher beashtarot
Vayyomru elenu zekenenu vechal-yoshve artzenu lemor kechu veyedchem tzeda ladderech ulchu likratam vaamartem alehem avdechem anachnu veatta kirtu-lanu verit
Ze lachmenu cham hitztayyadnu oto mibbattenu beom tzetenu lalechet alechem veatta hinne yavesh vehaya nikkudim
Veelle nodot hayyayin asher millenu chadashim vehinne hitbakkau veelle salmotenu unalenu balu merov hadderech meod
Vayyikchu haanashim mitztzedam veet-pi Adonai lo shaalu
Vayyaas lahem yehoshua shalom vayyichrot lahem berit lechayyotam vayyishshavu lahem nesie haeda
Vayehi miktze sheloshet yamim achare asher-kartu lahem berit vayyishmeu ki-kerovim hem elav uvkirbo hem yoshvim
Vayyisu vene-yisrael vayyavou el-arehem bayyom hashshelishi vearehem givon vehakkefira uverot vekiryat yearim
Velo hikkum bene yisrael ki-nishbeu lahem nesie haeda ba-Adonai elohe yisrael vayyillonu chal-haeda al-hannesiim
Vayyomru chal-hannesiim el-kal-haeda anachnu nishbanu lahem ba-Adonai elohe yisrael veatta lo nuchal lingoa bahem
Zot naase lahem vehachaye otam velo-yihye alenu ketzef al-hashshevua asher-nishbanu lahem
Vayyomru alehem hannesiim yichu vayyihu chotve etzim veshoave-mayim lechal-haeda kaasher dibberu lahem hannesiim
Vayyikra lahem yehoshua vayedabber alehem lemor lamma rimmitem otanu lemor rechokim anachnu mikkem meod veattem bekirbenu yoshvim
Veatta arurim attem velo-yikkaret mikkem eved vechotve etzim veshoave-mayim levet elohay

Vayyaanu et-yehoshua vayyomru ki hugged huggad laavadecha et asher tziva Adonai elohecha et-moshe avdo latet lachem et-kal-haaretz ulhashmid et-kal-yoshve haaretz mippenechem vannira meod lenafshotenu mippenechem vannaase et-haddavar hazze
Veatta hinnu veyadecha kattov vechayyashar beenecha laasot lanu ase
Vayyaas lahem ken vayyatztzel otam miyyad bene-yisrael velo haragum
Vayyittenem yehoshua bayyom hahu chotve etzim veshoave mayim laeda ulmizbach Adonai ad-hayyom hazze el-hammakom asher yivchar
Vayehi chishmoa adoni-tzedek melech yerushalam ki-lachad yehoshua et-haay vayyacharimah kaasher asa liricho ulmalkah ken-asa laay ulmalkah vechi hishlimu yoshve givon et-yisrael vayyihu bekirbam
Vayyiru meod ki ir gedola givon keachat are hammamlacha vechi hi gedola min-haay vechal-anasheha gibborim
Vayyishlach adoni-tzedek melech yerushalam el-hoham melech-chevron veel-piram melech-yarmut veel-yafia melech-lachish veel-devir melech-eglon lemor
Alu-elay veizruni venakke et-givon ki-hishlima et-yehoshua veet-bene yisrael
Vayyeasfu vayyaalu chameshet malche haemori melech yerushalam melech-chevron melech-yarmut melech-lachish melech-eglon hem vechal-machanehem vayyachanu al-givon vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyishlechu anshe givon el-yehoshua el-hammachane haggilgala lemor al-teref yadecha meavadecha ale elenu mehera vehoshia lanu veazrenu ki nikbetzu elenu kal-malche haemori yoshve hahar
Vayyaal yehoshua min-haggilgal hu vechal-am hammilchama immo vechol gibbore hechayil
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira mehem ki veyadcha netattim lo-yaamod ish mehem befanecha
Vayyavo alehem yehoshua pitom kal-hallayela ala min-haggilgal
Vayehummem Adonai lifne yisrael vayyakkem makka-gedola begivon vayyirdefem derech maale vet-choron vayyakkem ad-azeka vead-makkeda

Vayehi benusam mippene yisrael hem bemorad bet-choron va-Adonai hishlich alehem avanim gedolot min-hashshamayim ad-azeka vayyamutu rabbim asher-metu beavne habbarad measher hargu bene yisrael becharev
Az yedabber yehoshua la-Adonai beom tet Adonai et-haemori lifne bene yisrael vayyomer leene yisrael shemesh begivon dom veyareach beemek ayyalon
Vayyiddom hashshemesh veyareach amad ad-yikkom goy oyevav halo-hi chetuva al-sefer hayyashar vayyaamod hashshemesh bachatzi hashshamayim velo-atz lavo keom tamim
Velo haya kayyom hahu lefanav veacharav lishmoa Adonai bekol ish ki Adonai nilcham leyisrael
Vayyashav yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo el-hammachane haggilgala
Vayyanusu chameshet hammelachim haelle vayyechavu vammeara bemakkeda
Vayyuggad lihoshua lemor nimtzeu chameshet hammelachim nechbeim bammeara bemakkeda
Vayyomer yehoshua gollu avanim gedolot el-pi hammeara vehafkidu aleha anashim leshamram
Veattem al-taamodu ridfu achare oyevechem vezinnavtem otam al-tittenum lavo el-arehem ki netanam Adonai elohechem beyedchem
Vayehi kechallot yehoshua uvne yisrael lehakkotam makka gedola-meod ad-tummam vehasseridim sardu mehem vayyavou el-are hammivtzar
Vayyashuvu chal-haam el-hammachane el-yehoshua makkeda beshalom lo-charatz livne yisrael leish et-leshono
Vayyomer yehoshua pitchu et-pi hammeara vehotziu elay et-chameshet hammelachim haelle min-hammeara
Vayyaasu chen vayyotziu elav et-chameshet hammelachim haelle min-hammeara et melech yerushalam et-melech chevron et-melech yarmut et-melech lachish et-melech eglon

Vayehi kehotziam et-hammelachim haelle el-yehoshua vayyikra yehoshua el-kal-ish yisrael vayyomer el-ketzine anshe hammilchama hehalchu itto kirvu simu et-raglechem al-tzavvere hammelachim haelle vayyikrevu vayyasimu et-raglehem al-tzavverehem
Vayyomer alehem yehoshua al-tiru veal-techattu chizku veimtzu ki chacha yaase Adonai lechal-oyevechem asher attem nilchamim otam
Vayyakkem yehoshua achare-chen vayemitem vayyitlem al chamishsha etzim vayyihu teluyim al-haetzim ad-haarev
Vayehi leet bo hashshemesh tziva yehoshua vayyoridum meal haetzim vayyashlichum el-hammeara asher nechbeu-sham vayyasimu avanim gedolot al-pi hammeara ad-etzem hayyom hazze
Veet-makkeda lachad yehoshua bayyom hahu vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-malkah hecherim otam veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo hishir sarid vayyaas lemelech makkeda kaasher asa lemelech yericho
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo mimmakkeda livna vayyillachem im-livna
Vayyitten Adonai gam-otah beyad yisrael veet-malkah vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo-hishir bah sarid vayyaas lemalkah kaasher asa lemelech yericho
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo millivna lachisha vayyichan aleha vayyillachem bah
Vayyitten Adonai et-lachish beyad yisrael vayyilkedah bayyom hashsheni vayyakkeha lefi-cherev veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah kechol asher-asa lelivna
Az ala horam melech gezer lazor et-lachish vayyakkehu yehoshua veet-ammo ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid
Vayyaavor yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo millachish eglona vayyachanu aleha vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyilkeduha bayyom hahu vayyakkuha lefi-cherev veet kal-hannefesh asher-bah bayyom hahu hecherim kechol asher-asa lelachish
Vayyaal yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo meeglona chevrona vayyillachamu aleha
Vayyilkeduha vayyakkuha-lefi-cherev veet-malkah veet-kal-areha veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lo-hishir sarid kechol asher-asa leeglon vayyacharem otah veet-kal-hannefesh asher-bah
Vayyashav yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo devira vayyillachem aleha
Vayyilkedah veet-malkah veet-kal-areha vayyakkum lefi-cherev vayyacharimu et-kal-nefesh asher-bah lo hishir sarid kaasher asa lechevron ken-asa lidvira ulmalkah vechaasher asa lelivna ulmalkah
Vayyakke yehoshua et-kal-haaretz hahar vehannegev vehashshefela vehaashedot veet kal-malchehem lo hishir sarid veet kal-hanneshama hecherim kaasher tziva Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyakkem yehoshua mikkadesh barnea vead-azza veet kal-eretz goshen vead-givon
Veet kal-hammelachim haelle veet-artzam lachad yehoshua paam echat ki Adonai elohe yisrael nilcham leyisrael
Vayyashav yehoshua vechal-yisrael immo el-hammachane haggilgala
Vayehi kishmoa yavin melech-chatzor vayyishlach el-yovav melech madon veel-melech shimron veel-melech achshaf
Veel-hammelachim asher mitztzefon bahar uvaarava negev kinarot uvashshefela uvnafot dor miyyam
Hakkenaani mimmizrach umiyyam vehaemori vehachitti vehapperizzi vehayevusi bahar vehachivi tachat chermon beeretz hammitzpa
Vayyetzu hem vechal-machanehem immam am-rav kachol asher al-sefat-hayyam larov vesus varechev rav-meod
Vayyivaadu kol hammelachim haelle vayyavou vayyachanu yachdav el-me merom lehillachem im-yisrael
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehoshua al-tira mippenehem ki-machar kaet hazzot anochi noten et-kullam chalalim lifne yisrael et-susehem teakker veet-markevotehem tisrof baesh
Vayyavo yehoshua vechal-am hammilchama immo alehem al-me merom pitom vayyippelu bahem
Vayyittenem Adonai beyad-yisrael vayyakkum vayyirdefum ad-tzidon rabba vead misrefot mayim vead-bikat mitzpe mizracha vayyakkum ad-bilti hishir-lahem sarid
Vayyaas lahem yehoshua kaasher amar-lo Adonai et-susehem ikker veet-markevotehem saraf baesh
Vayyashav yehoshua baet hahi vayyilkod et-chatzor veet-malkah hikka vecharev ki-chatzor lefanim hi rosh kal-hammamlachot haelle
Vayyakku et-kal-hannefesh asher-bah lefi-cherev hacharem lo notar kal-neshama veet-chatzor saraf baesh
Veet-kal-are hammelachim-haelle veet-kal-malchehem lachad yehoshua vayyakkem lefi-cherev hecherim otam kaasher tziva moshe eved Adonai
Rak kal-hearim haomdot al-tillam lo serafam yisrael zulati et-chatzor levaddah saraf yehoshua
Vechol shelal hearim haelle vehabbehema bazzu lahem bene yisrael rak et-kal-haadam hikku lefi-cherev ad-hishmidam otam lo hishiru kal-neshama
Kaasher tziva Adonai et-moshe avdo ken-tziva moshe et-yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo-hesir davar mikkol asher-tziva Adonai et-moshe
Vayyikkach yehoshua et-kal-haaretz hazzot hahar veet-kal-hannegev veet kal-eretz haggoshen veet-hashshefela veet-haarava veet-har yisrael ushfelato
Min-hahar hechalak haole seir vead-baal gad bevikat hallevanon tachat har-chermon veet kal-malchehem lachad vayyakkem vayemitem
Yamim rabbim asa yehoshua et-kal-hammelachim haelle milchama
Lo-hayeta ir asher hishlima el-bene yisrael bilti hachivi yoshve givon et-hakkol lakchu vammilchama
Ki meet Adonai hayeta lechazzek et-libbam likrat hammilchama et-yisrael lemaan hacharimam levilti heot-lahem techinna ki lemaan hashmidam kaasher tziva Adonai et-moshe
Vayyavo yehoshua baet hahi vayyachret et-haanakim min-hahar min-chevron min-devir min-anav umikkol har yehuda umikkol har yisrael im-arehem hecherimam yehoshua
Lo-notar anakim beeretz bene yisrael rak beazza begat uvashdod nisharu
Vayyikkach yehoshua et-kal-haaretz kechol asher dibber Adonai el-moshe vayyittenah yehoshua lenachala leyisrael kemachlekotam leshivtehem vehaaretz shakta mimmilchama
Veelle malche haaretz asher hikku vene-yisrael vayyirshu et-artzam beever hayyarden mizrecha hashshamesh minnachal arnon ad-har chermon vechal-haarava mizracha
Sichon melech haemori hayyoshev becheshbon moshel mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vetoch hannachal vachatzi haggilad vead yabbok hannachal gevul bene ammon
Vehaarava ad-yam kinrot mizracha vead yam haarava yam-hammelach mizracha derech bet hayeshimot umitteman tachat ashdot happisga
Ugvul og melech habbashan miyyeter harfaim hayyoshev beashtarot uvedrei
Umoshel behar chermon uvsalcha uvchal-habbashan ad-gevul haggeshuri vehammaachati vachatzi haggilad gevul sichon melech-cheshbon
Moshe eved-Adonai uvne yisrael hikkum vayyittenah moshe eved-Adonai yerushsha laruuveni velaggadi velachatzi shevet hamnashshe

Veelle malche haaretz asher hikka yehoshua uvne yisrael beever hayyarden yamma mibbaal gad bevikat hallevanon vead-hahar hechalak haole seira vayyittenah yehoshua leshivte yisrael yerushsha kemachlekotam
Bahar uvashshefela uvaarava uvaashedot uvammidbar uvannegev hachitti haemori vehakkenaani happerizzi hachivi vehayevusi
Melech yericho echad melech haay asher-mitztzad bet-el echad
Melech yerushalam echad melech chevron echad
Melech yarmut echad melech lachish echad
Melech eglon echad melech gezer echad
Melech devir echad melech geder echad
Melech charma echad melech arad echad
Melech livna echad melech adullam echad
Melech makkeda echad melech bet-el echad
Melech tappuach echad melech chefer echad
Melech afek echad melech lashsharon echad
Melech madon echad melech chatzor echad
Melech shimron meron echad melech achshaf echad
Melech tanach echad melech megiddo echad
Melech kedesh echad melech-yaknoam lakkarmel echad
Melech dor lenafat dor echad melech-goyim legilgal echad
Melech tirtza echad kal-melachim sheloshim veechad
Vihoshua zaken ba bayyamim vayyomer Adonai elav atta zakanta bata vayyamim vehaaretz nishara harbe-meod lerishtah
Zot haaretz hannisharet kal-gelilot happelishtim vechal-haggeshuri
Min-hashshichor asher al-pene mitzrayim vead gevul ekron tzafona lakkenaani techashev chameshet sarne felishtim haazzati vehaashdodi haeshkeloni haggitti vehaekroni vehaavim
Mitteman kal-eretz hakkenaani umara asher latztzidonim ad-afeka ad gevul haemori
Vehaaretz haggivli vechal-hallevanon mizrach hashshemesh mibbaal gad tachat har-chermon ad levo chamat
Kal-yoshve hahar min-hallevanon ad-misrefot mayim kal-tzidonim anochi orishem mippene bene yisrael rak happileha leyisrael benachala kaasher tziviticha
Veatta challek et-haaretz hazzot benachala letishat hashshevatim vachatzi hashshevet hamnashshe
Immo haruveni vehaggadi lakchu nachalatam asher natan lahem moshe beever hayyarden mizracha kaasher natan lahem moshe eved Adonai
Mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vehair asher betoch-hannachal vechal-hammishor medva ad-divon
Vechol are sichon melech haemori asher malach becheshbon ad-gevul bene ammon
Vehaggilad ugvul haggeshuri vehammaachati vechol har chermon vechal-habbashan ad-salcha
Kal-mamlechut og babbashan asher-malach beashtarot uvedrei hu nishar miyyeter harfaim vayyakkem moshe vayyorishem
Velo horishu bene yisrael et-haggeshuri veet-hammaachati vayyeshev geshur umaachat bekerev yisrael ad hayyom hazze
Rak leshevet hallevi lo natan nachala ishshe Adonai elohe yisrael hu nachalato kaasher dibber-lo
Vayyitten moshe lematte vene-reuven lemishpechotam
Vayehi lahem haggevul mearoer asher al-sefat-nachal arnon vehair asher betoch-hannachal vechal-hammishor al-medva
Cheshbon vechal-areha asher bammishor divon uvamot baal uvet baal meon
Veyahtza ukdemot umefaat
Vekiryatayim vesivma vetzeret hashshachar behar haemek
Uvet peor veashdot happisga uvet hayeshimot

Vechol are hammishor vechal-mamlechut sichon melech haemori asher malach becheshbon asher hikka moshe oto veet-nesie midyan et-evi veet-rekem veet-tzur veet-chur veet-reva nesiche sichon yoshve haaretz
Veet-bilam ben-beor hakkosem hargu vene-yisrael bacherev el-challehem
Vayehi gevul bene reuven hayyarden ugvul zot nachalat bene-reuven lemishpechotam hearim vechatzrehen
Vayyitten moshe lematte-gad livne-gad lemishpechotam

Vayyitten Adonai leyisrael et-kal-haaretz asher nishba latet laavotam vayyirashuha vayyeshvu vah

Lo-nafal davar mikkol haddavar hattov asher-dibber Adonai el-bet yisrael hakkol ba
Az yikra yehoshua laruveni velaggadi velachatzi matte menashshe
Vayyomer alehem attem shemartem et kal-asher tziva etchem moshe eved Adonai vattishmeu vekoli lechol asher-tziviti etchem
Lo-azavtem et-achechem ze yamim rabbim ad hayyom hazze ushmartem et-mishmeret mitzvat Adonai elohechem
Veatta heniach Adonai elohechem laachechem kaasher dibber lahem veatta penu ulchu lachem leaholechem el-eretz achuzzatchem asher natan lachem moshe eved Adonai beever hayyarden

Rak shimru meod laasot et-hammitzva veet-hattora asher tziva etchem moshe eved-Adonai leahava et-Adonai elohechem velalechet bechal-derachav velishmor mitzotav uldavka-vo ulavdo bechal-levavchem uvchal-nafshechem
Vayevarchem yehoshua vayeshallechem vayyelchu el-aholehem
Velachatzi shevet hamnashshe natan moshe babbashan ulchetzo natan yehoshua im-achehem beever hayyarden yamma vegam ki shillecham yehoshua el-aholehem vayevarachem
Vayyomer alehem lemor binchasim rabbim shuvu el-aholechem uvmikne rav-meod bechesef uvzahav uvinchoshet uvvarzel uvislamot harbe meod chilku shelal-oyevechem im-achechem

Vayyashuvu vayyelchu bene-reuven uvne-gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe meet bene yisrael mishshilo asher beeretz-kenaan lalechet el-eretz haggilad el-eretz achuzzatam asher nochazu-vah al-pi Adonai beyad-moshe
Vayyavou el-gelilot hayyarden asher beeretz kenaan vayyivnu vene-reuven uvne-gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe sham mizbeach al-hayyarden mizbeach gadol lemare
Vayyishmeu vene-yisrael lemor hinne vanu vene-reuven uvne-gad vachatzi shevet hamnashshe et-hammizbeach el-mul eretz kenaan el-gelilot hayyarden el-ever bene yisrael
Vayyishmeu bene yisrael vayyikkahalu kal-adat bene-yisrael shilo laalot alehem latztzava
Vayyishlechu vene-yisrael el-bene-reuven veel-bene-gad veel-chatzi shevet-menashshe el-eretz haggilad et-pinchas ben-elazar hakkohen
Vaasara nesiim immo nasi echad nasi echad levet av lechol mattot yisrael veish rosh bet-avotam hemma lealfe yisrael
Vayyavou el-bene-reuven veel-bene-gad veel-chatzi shevet-menashshe el-eretz haggilad vayedabberu ittam lemor
Ko amru kol adat Adonai ma-hammaal hazze asher mealtem belohe yisrael lashuv hayyom meachare Adonai bivnotchem lachem mizbeach limradchem hayyom ba-Adonai
Hamat-lanu et-aon peor asher lo-hittaharnu mimmennu ad hayyom hazze vayehi hannegef baadat Adonai
Veattem tashuvu hayyom meachare Adonai vehaya attem timredu hayyom ba-Adonai umachar el-kal-adat yisrael yiktzof

Veach im-temea eretz achuzzatchem ivru lachem el-eretz achuzzat Adonai asher shachan-sham mishkan Adonai veheachazu betochenu uva-Adonai al-timrodu veotanu el-timrodu bivnotchem lachem mizbeach mibbalade mizbach Adonai elohenu
Halo achan ben-zerach maal maal bacherem veal-kal-adat yisrael haya katzef vehu ish echad lo gava baaono

Ugvul natan-Adonai benenu uvenechem bene-reuven uvne-gad et-hayyarden en-lachem chelek ba-Adonai vehishbitu venechem et-banenu levilti yero et-Adonai
Vannomer naase-na lanu livnot et-hammizbeach lo leola velo lezavach
Ki ed hu benenu uvenechem uven dorotenu acharenu laavod et-avodat Adonai lefanav beolotenu uvizvachenu uvishlamenu velo-yomru venechem machar levanenu en-lachem chelek ba-Adonai
Vannomer vehaya ki-yomru elenu veel-dorotenu machar veamarnu reu et-tavnit mizbach Adonai asher-asu avotenu lo leola velo lezevach ki-ed hu benenu uvenechem
Chalila lanu mimmennu limrod ba-Adonai velashuv hayyom meachare Adonai livnot mizbeach leola lemincha ulzavach millevad mizbach Adonai elohenu asher lifne mishkano
Vayyishma pinchas hakkohen unsie haeda verashe alfe yisrael asher itto et-haddevarim asher dibberu bene-reuven uvne-gad uvne menashshe vayyitav beenehem

Vayyomer pinchas ben-elazar hakkohen el-bene-reuven veel-bene-gad veel-bene menashshe hayyom yadanu ki-vetochenu Adonai asher lo-mealtem ba-Adonai hammaal hazze az hitztzaltem et-bene yisrael miyyad Adonai
Vayyashav pinchas ben-elazar hakkohen vehannesiim meet bene-reuven umeet bene-gad meeretz haggilad el-eretz kenaan el-bene yisrael vayyashivu otam davar
Vayyitav haddavar beene bene yisrael vayevarachu elohim bene yisrael velo amru laalot alehem latztzava leshachet et-haaretz asher bene-reuven uvne-gad yoshvim bah
Vayyikreu bene-reuven uvne-gad lammizbeach ki ed hu benotenu ki Adonai haelohim
Vayehi miyyamim rabbim achare asher-heniach Adonai leyisrael mikkal-oyevehem missaviv vihoshua zaken ba bayyamim
Vayyikra yehoshua lechal-yisrael lizkenav ulrashav ulshoftav ulshotrav vayyomer alehem ani zakanti bati bayyamim

Vachazaktem meod lishmor velaasot et kal-hakkatuv besefer torat moshe levilti sur-mimmennu yamin usmol
Levilti-vo baggoyim haelle hannisharim haelle ittechem uvshem elohehem lo-tazkiru velo tashbiu velo taavdum velo tishtachau lahem
Ki im-ba-Adonai elohechem tidbaku kaasher asitem ad hayyom hazze

Ish-echad mikkem yirdaf-alef ki Adonai elohechem hu hannilcham lachem kaasher dibber lachem
Venishmartem meod lenafshotechem leahava et-Adonai elohechem
Ki im-shov tashuvu udvaktem beyeter haggoyim haelle hannisharim haelle ittechem vehitchattantem bahem uvatem bahem vehem bachem

Beavrechem et-berit Adonai elohechem asher tziva etchem vahalachtem vaavadtem elohim acherim vehishtachavitem lahem vechara af-Adonai bachem vaavadtem mehera meal haaretz hattova asher natan lachem

Vaeshlach et-moshe veet-aharon vaeggof et-mitzrayim kaasher asiti bekirbo veachar hotzeti etchem
Vaotzi et-avotechem mimmitzrayim vattavou hayyamma vayyirdefu mitzrayim achare avotechem berechev uvfarashim yam-suf
Vayyitzaku el-Adonai vayyasem maafel benechem uven hammitzrim vayyave alav et-hayyam vayechassehu vattirena enechem et asher-asiti bemitzrayim vatteshvu vammidbar yamim rabbim

Veim ra beenechem laavod et-Adonai bacharu lachem hayyom et-mi taavodun im et-elohim asher-avdu avotechem asher meever hannahar veim et-elohe haemori asher attem yoshvim beartzam veanochi uveti naavod et-Adonai
Vayyaan haam vayyomer chalila lanu meazov et-Adonai laavod elohim acherim

Vayegaresh Adonai et-kal-haammim veet-haemori yoshev haaretz mippanenu gam-anachnu naavod et-Adonai ki-hu elohenu

Ki taazvu et-Adonai vaavadtem elohe nechar veshav vehera lachem vechilla etchem achare asher-hetiv lachem
Vayyomer haam el-yehoshua lo ki et-Adonai naavod
Vayyomer yehoshua el-haam edim attem bachem ki-attem bechartem lachem et-Adonai laavod oto vayyomru edim
Veatta hasiru et-elohe hannechar asher bekirbechem vehattu et-levavchem el-Adonai elohe yisrael
Vayyomru haam el-yehoshua et-Adonai elohenu naavod uvkolo nishma
Vayyichrot yehoshua berit laam bayyom hahu vayyasem lo chok umishpat bishchem
Vayyichtov yehoshua et-haddevarim haelle besefer torat elohim vayyikkach even gedola vayekimeha sham tachat haalla asher bemikdash Adonai
Vayyomer yehoshua el-kal-haam hinne haeven hazzot tihye-banu leeda ki-hi shama et kal-imre Adonai asher dibber immanu vehayeta vachem leeda pen-techachashun belohechem
Vayeshallach yehoshua et-haam ish lenachalato
Vayehi achare haddevarim haelle vayyamat yehoshua bin-nun eved Adonai ben-mea vaeser shanim
Vayyikberu oto bigvul nachalato betimnat-serach asher behar-efrayim mitztzefon lehar-gaash
Vayyaavod yisrael et-Adonai kol yeme yehoshua vechol yeme hazzekenim asher heerichu yamim achare yehoshua vaasher yadu et kal-maase Adonai asher asa leyisrael
Veet-atzmot yosef asher-heelu vene-yisrael mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem bechelkat hassade asher kana yaakov meet bene-chamor avi-shechem bemea kesita vayyihu livne-yosef lenachala
Veelazar ben-aharon met vayyikberu oto begivat pinchas beno asher nittan-lo behar efrayim
Judges: Vayehi achare mot yehoshua vayyishalu bene yisrael ba-Adonai lemor mi yaale-lanu el-hakkenaani battechilla lehillachem bo
Vayyomer Adonai yehuda yaale hinne natatti et-haaretz beyado
Vayyomer yehuda leshimon achiv ale itti vegorali venillachama bakkenaani vehalachti gam-ani ittecha begoralecha vayyelech itto shimon
Vayyaal yehuda vayyitten Adonai et-hakkenaani vehapperizzi beyadam vayyakkum bevezek aseret alafim ish
Vayyimtzeu et-adoni vezek bevezek vayyillachamu bo vayyakku et-hakkenaani veet-happerizzi
Vayyanas adoni vezek vayyirdefu acharav vayyochazu oto vayekatztzetzu et-behonot yadav veraglav
Vayyomer adoni-vezek shivim melachim behonot yedehem veraglehem mekutztzatzim hau melakketim tachat shulchani kaasher asiti ken shillam-li elohim vayeviuhu yerushalam vayyamat sham
Vayyillachamu vene-yehuda birushalam vayyilkedu otah vayyakkuha lefi-charev veet-hair shillechu vaesh
Veachar yardu bene yehuda lehillachem bakkenaani yoshev hahar vehannegev vehashshefela
Vayyelech yehuda el-hakkenaani hayyoshev bechevron veshem-chevron lefanim kiryat arba vayyakku et-sheshay veet-achiman veet-talmay
Vayyelech mishsham el-yoshve devir veshem-devir lefanim kiryat-sefer
Vayyomer kalev asher-yakke et-kiryat-sefer ulchadah venatatti lo et-achsa vitti leishsha
Vayyilkedah atniel ben-kenaz achi chalev hakkaton mimmennu vayyitten-lo et-achsa vitto leishsha
Vayehi bevoah vattesitehu lishol meet-aviha hassade vattitznach meal hachamor vayyomer-lah kalev ma-lach
Vattomer lo hava-li veracha ki eretz hannegev netattani venatatta li gullot mayim vayyitten-lah kalev et gullot illit veet gullot tachtit
Uvne keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim et-bene yehuda midbar yehuda asher benegev arad vayyelech vayyeshev et-haam
Vayyelech yehuda et-shimon achiv vayyakku et-hakkenaani yoshev tzefat vayyacharimu otah vayyikra et-shem-hair charma
Vayyilkod yehuda et-azza veet-gevulah veet-ashkelon veet-gevulah veet-ekron veet-gevulah
Vayehi Adonai ett-yehuda vayyoresh et-hahar ki lo lehorish et-yoshve haemek ki-rechev barzel lahem
Vayyittenu lechalev et-chevron kaasher dibber moshe vayyoresh mishsham et-shelosha bene haanak
Veet-hayevusi yoshev yerushalam lo horishu bene vinyamin vayyeshev hayevusi et-bene vinyamin birushalam ad hayyom hazze
Vayyaalu vet-yosef gam-hem bet-el va-Adonai immam
Vayyatiru vet-yosef bevet-el veshem-hair lefanim luz
Vayyiru hashshomrim ish yotze min-hair vayyomru lo harenu na et-mevo hair veasinu immecha chased
Vayyarem et-mevo hair vayyakku et-hair lefi-charev veet-haish veet-kal-mishpachto shillechu
Vayyelech haish eretz hachittim vayyiven ir vayyikra shemah luz hu shemah ad hayyom hazze

Veefrayim lo horish et-hakkenaani hayyoshev begazer vayyeshev hakkenaani bekirbo begazer

Asher lo horish et-yoshve akko veet-yoshve tzidon veet-achlav veet-achziv veet-chelba veet-afik veet-rechov
Vayyeshev haasheri bekerev hakkenaani yoshve haaretz ki lo horisho
Naftali lo-horish et-yoshve vet-shemesh veet-yoshve vet-anat vayyeshev bekerev hakkenaani yoshve haaretz veyoshve vet-shemesh uvet anat hau lahem lamas
Vayyilchatzu haemori et-bene-dan hahara ki-lo netano laredet laemek
Vayyoel haemori lashevet behar-cheres beayyalon uvshaalvim vattichbad yad bet-yosef vayyihu lamas
Ugvul haemori mimmaale akrabbim mehassela vamala
Vayyaal malach-Adonai min-haggilgal el-habbochim f vayyomer aale etchem mimmitzrayim vaavi etchem el-haaretz asher nishbati laavotechem vaomar lo-afer beriti ittechem leolam
Veattem lo-tichretu verit leoshve haaretz hazzot mizbechotehem tittotzun velo-shematem bekoli ma-zot asitem
Vegam amarti lo-agaresh otam mippenechem vehau lachem letziddim velohehem yihu lachem lemokesh
Vayehi kedabber malach Adonai et-haddevarim haelle el-kal-bene yisrael vayyisu haam et-kolam vayyivku
Vayyikreu shem-hammakom hahu bochim vayyizbechu-sham la-Adonai
Vayeshallach yehoshua et-haam vayyelchu vene-yisrael ish lenachalato lareshet et-haaretz
Vayyaavdu haam et-Adonai kol yeme yehoshua vechol yeme hazzekenim asher heerichu yamim achare yehoshua asher rau et kal-maase Adonai haggadol asher asa leyisrael
Vayyamat yehoshua bin-nun eved Adonai ben-mea vaeser shanim
Vayyikberu oto bigvul nachalato betimnat-cheres behar efrayim mitztzefon lehar-gaash
Vegam kal-haddor hahu neesfu el-avotav vayyakam dor acher acharehem asher lo-yadu et-Adonai vegam et-hammaase asher asa leyisrael
Vayyaasu vene-yisrael et-hara beene Adonai vayyaavdu et-habbealim
Vayyaazvu et-Adonai elohe avotam hammotzi otam meeretz mitzrayim vayyelchu achare elohim acherim meelohe haammim asher sevivotehem vayyishtachau lahem vayyachisu et-Adonai
Vayyaazvu et-Adonai vayyaavdu labbaal velaashtarot
Vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael vayyittenem beyad-shosim vayyashossu otam vayyimkerem beyad oyevehem missaviv velo-yachlu od laamod lifne oyevehem
Bechol asher yatzu yad-Adonai hayeta-bam leraa kaasher dibber Adonai vechaasher nishba Adonai lahem vayyetzer lahem meod
Vayyakem Adonai shoftim vayyoshium miyyad shosehem
Vegam el-shoftehem lo shameu ki zanu achare elohim acherim vayyishtachau lahem saru maher min-hadderech asher halchu avotam lishmoa mitzot-Adonai lo-asu chen
Vechi-hekim Adonai lahem shoftim vehaya Adonai im-hashshofet vehoshiam miyyad oyevehem kol yeme hashshofet ki-yinnachem Adonai minnaakatam mippene lochatzehem vedochakehem
Vehaya bemot hashshofet yashuvu vehishchitu meavotam lalechet achare elohim acherim leavdam ulhishtachaot lahem lo hippilu mimmaallehem umiddarkam hakkasha
Vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael vayyomer yaan asher avru haggoy hazze et-beriti asher tziviti et-avotam velo shamu lekoli
Gam-ani lo osif lehorish ish mippenehem min-haggoyim asher-azav yehoshua vayyamot
Lemaan nassot bam et-yisrael hashomrim hem et-derech Adonai lalechet bam kaasher shamru avotam im-lo
Vayyannach Adonai et-haggoyim haelle levilti horisham maher velo netanam beyad-yehoshua
Veelle haggoyim asher hinniach Adonai lenassot bam et-yisrael et kal-asher lo-yadu et kal-milchamot kenaan
Rak lemaan daat dorot bene-yisrael lelammedam milchama rak asher-lefanim lo yedaum
Chameshet sarne felishtim vechal-hakkenaani vehatztzidoni vehachivi yoshev har hallevanon mehar baal chermon ad levo chamat
Vayyihu lenassot bam et-yisrael ladaat hayishmeu et-mitzot Adonai asher-tziva et-avotam beyad-moshe
Uvne yisrael yashvu bekerev hakkenaani hachitti vehaemori vehapperizzi vehachivi vehayevusi
Vayyikchu et-benotehem lahem lenashim veet-benotehem natnu livnehem vayyaavdu et-elohehem
Vayyaasu vene-yisrael et-hara beene Adonai vayyishkechu et-Adonai elohehem vayyaavdu et-habbealim veet-haasherot
Vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael vayyimkerem beyad kushan rishatayim melech aram naharayim vayyaavdu vene-yisrael et-kushan rishatayim shemone shanim
Vayyizaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai vayyakem Adonai moshia livne yisrael vayyoshiem et atniel ben-kenaz achi chalev hakkaton mimmennu
Vattehi alav ruach-Adonai vayyishpot et-yisrael vayyetze lammilchama vayyitten Adonai beyado et-kushan rishatayim melech aram vattaaz yado al kushan rishatayim
Vattishkot haaretz arbaim shana vayyamat atniel ben-kenaz
Vayyosifu bene yisrael laasot hara beene Adonai vayechazzek Adonai et-eglon melech-moav al-yisrael al ki-asu et-hara beene Adonai
Vayyeesof elav et-bene ammon vaamalek vayyelech vayyach et-yisrael vayyirshu et-ir hattemarim
Vayyaavdu vene-yisrael et-eglon melech-moav shemone esre shana
Vayyizaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai vayyakem Adonai lahem moshia et-ehud ben-gera ben-hayemini ish itter yad-yemino vayyishlechu vene-yisrael beyado mincha leeglon melech moav
Vayyaas lo ehud cherev velah shene feot gomed arkah vayyachgor otah mittachat lemaddav al yerech yemino
Vayyakrev et-hammincha leeglon melech moav veeglon ish bari meod
Vayehi kaasher killa lehakriv et-hammincha vayeshallach et-haam nose hammincha
Vehu shav min-happesilim asher et-haggilgal vayyomer devar-seter li elecha hammelech vayyomer has vayyetzu mealav kal-haomdim alav
Veehud ba elav vehu-yoshev baaliyyat hammekera asher-lo levaddo vayyomer ehud devar-elohim li elecha vayyakam meal hakkisse
Vayyishlach ehud et-yad semolo vayyikkach et-hacherev meal yerech yemino vayyitkaeha bevitno
Vayyavo gam-hannitztzav achar hallahav vayyisgor hachelev bead hallahav ki lo shalaf hacherev mibbitno vayyetze happarshedona
Vayyetze ehud hammisderona vayyisgor daltot haaliyya baado venaal
Vehu yatza vaavadav bau vayyiru vehinne daltot haaliyya neulot vayyomru ach mesich hu et-raglav bachadar hammekera
Vayyachilu ad-bosh vehenne enennu foteach daltot haaliyya vayyikchu et-hammafteach vayyiftachu vehinne adonehem nofel artza met
Veehud nimlat ad hitmahmeham vehu avar et-happesilim vayyimmalet hasseirata
Vayehi bevoo vayyitka bashshofar behar efrayim vayyerdu immo vene-yisrael min-hahar vehu lifnehem
Vayyomer alehem ridfu acharay ki-natan Adonai et-oyevechem et-moav beyedchem vayyerdu acharav vayyilkedu et-maberot hayyarden lemoav velo-natnu ish laavor
Vayyakku et-moav baet hahi kaaseret alafim ish kal-shamen vechal-ish chayil velo nimlat ish
Vattikkana moav bayyom hahu tachat yad yisrael vattishkot haaretz shemonim shana
Veacharav haya shamgar ben-anat vayyach et-pelishtim shesh-meot ish bemalmad habbakar vayyosha gam-hu et-yisrael
Vayyosifu bene yisrael laasot hara beene Adonai veehud met
Vayyimkerem Adonai beyad yavin melech-kenaan asher malach bechatzor vesar-tzevao sisra vehu yoshev bacharoshet haggoyim
Vayyitzaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai ki tesha meot rechev-barzel lo vehu lachatz et-bene yisrael bechazka esrim shana
Udvora ishsha nevia eshet lappidot hi shofta et-yisrael baet hahi
Vehi yoshevet tachat-tomer devora ben harama uven bet-el behar efrayim vayyaalu eleha bene yisrael lammishpat

Vattishlach vattikra levarak ben-avinoam mikkedesh naftali vattomer elav halo tziva Adonai elohe-yisrael lech umashachta behar tavor velakachta immecha aseret alafim ish mibbene naftali umibbene zevulun
Umashachti elecha el-nachal kishon et-sisra sar-tzeva yavin veet-richbo veet-hamono untattihu beyadecha
Vayyomer eleha barak im-telchi immi vehalachti veim-lo telchi immi lo elech
Vattomer haloch elech immach efes ki lo tihye tifartecha al-hadderech asher atta holech ki veyad-ishsha yimkor Adonai et-sisra vattakam devora vattelech im-barak kedsha
Vayyazek barak et-zevulun veet-naftali kedsha vayyaal beraglav aseret alfe ish vattaal immo devora
Vechever hakkeni nifrad mikkayin mibbene chovav choten moshe vayyet aholo ad-elon betzaanannim asher et-kedesh
Vayyaggidu lesisra ki ala barak ben-avinoam har-tavor
Vayyazek sisra et-kal-richbo tesha meot rechev barzel veet-kal-haam asher itto mecharoshet haggoyim el-nachal kishon
Vattomer devora el-barak kum ki ze hayyom asher natan Adonai et-sisra beyadecha halo Adonai yatza lefanecha vayyered barak mehar tavor vaaseret alafim ish acharav
Vayyaham Adonai et-sisra veet-kal-harechev veet-kal-hammachane lefi-cherev lifne varak vayyered sisra meal hammerkava vayyanas beraglav
Uvarak radaf achare harechev veachare hammachane ad charoshet haggoyim vayyippol kal-machane sisra lefi-cherev lo nishar ad-echad
Vesisra nas beraglav el-ohel yael eshshet chever hakkeni ki shalom ben yavin melech-chatzor uven bet chever hakkeni
Vattetze yael likrat sisra vattomer elav sura adoni sura elay al-tira vayyasar eleha haohela vattechassehu bassemicha
Vayyomer eleha hashkini-na meat-mayim ki tzameti vattiftach et-nod hechalav vattashkehu vattechassehu
Vayyomer eleha amod petach haohel vehaya im-ish yavo ushelech veamar hayesh-po ish veamarte ayin
Vattikkach yael eshet-chever et-yetad haohel vattasem et-hammakkevet beyadah vattavo elav ballat vattitka et-hayyated berakkato vattitznach baaretz vehu-nirdam vayyaaf vayyamot
Vehinne varak rodef et-sisra vattetze yael likrato vattomer lo lech vearekka et-haish asher-atta mevakkesh vayyavo eleha vehinne sisra nofel met vehayyated berakkato
Vayyachna elohim bayyom hahu et yavin melech-kenaan lifne bene yisrael
Vattelech yad bene-yisrael haloch vekasha al yavin melech-kenaan ad asher hichritu et yavin melech-kenaan
Vattashar devora uvarak ben-avinoam bayyom hahu lemor
Bifroa peraot beyisrael behitnaddev am barachu Adonai
Shimu melachim haazinu roznim anochi la-Adonai anochi ashira azammer la-Adonai elohe yisrael
Adonai betzetcha misseir betzadecha missede edom eretz raasha gam-shamayim natafu gam-avim natfu mayim
Harim nazlu mippene Adonai ze sinay mippene Adonai elohe yisrael
Bime shamgar ben-anat bime yael chadlu orachot veholche netivot yelchu orachot akalkallot
Chadlu ferazon beyisrael chadellu ad shakkamti devora shakkamti em beyisrael
Yivchar elohim chadashim az lachem shearim magen im-yerae varomach bearbaim elef beyisrael
Libbi lechokke yisrael hammitnaddevim baam barachu Adonai
Rochve atonot tzechorot yoshve al-middin veholche al-derech sichu
Mikkol mechatztzim ben mashabbim sham yetannu tzidkot Adonai tzidkot pirzono beyisrael az yardu lashshearim am-Adonai
Uri uri devora uri uri dabberi-shir kum barak ushave shevyecha ben-avinoam
Az yerad sarid leaddirim am Adonai yerad-li baggibborim
Minni efrayim sharsham baamalek acharecha vinyamin baamamecha minni machir yardu mechokkim umizzevulun moshchim beshevet sofer
Vesaray beyissashchar im-devora veyissashchar ken barak baemek shullach beraglav biflaggot reuven gedolim chikke-lev
Lamma yashavta ben hammishpetayim lishmoa sherikot adarim liflaggot reuven gedolim chikre-lev
Gilad beever hayyarden shachen vedan lamma yagur oniyyot asher yashav lechof yammim veal mifratzav yishkon
Zevulun am cheref nafsho lamut venaftali al merome sade
Bau melachim nilchamu az nilchamu malche chenaan betanach al-me megiddo betza kesef lo lakachu
Min-shamayim nilchamu hakkochavim mimmesillotam nilchamu im-sisra
Nachal kishon gerafam nachal kedumim nachal kishon tidrechi nafshi oz
Az halmu ikkeve-sus middaharot daharot abbirav
Oru meroz amar malach Adonai oru aror yoshveha ki lo-vau leezrat Adonai leezrat Adonai baggibborim
Tevorach minnashim yael eshet chever hakkeni minnashim baohel tevorach
Mayim shaal chalav natana besefel addirim hikriva chema
Yadah layyated tishlachna viminah lehalmut amelim vehalma sisra machaka rosho umachatza vechalfa rakkato
Ben ragleha kara nafal shachav ben ragleha kara nafal baasher kara sham nafal shadud
Bead hachallon nishkefa vatteyabbev em sisra bead haeshnav maddua boshesh richbo lavo maddua echeru paame markevotav
Chachmot saroteha taanena af-hi tashiv amareha lah
Halo yimtzeu yechalleku shalal racham rachamatayim lerosh gever shelal tzevaim lesisra shelal tzevaim rikma tzeva rikmatayim letzavvere shalal
Ken yovdu chal-oyevecha Adonai veohavav ketzet hashshemesh bigvurato vattishkot haaretz arbaim shana
Vayyaasu vene-yisrael hara beene Adonai vayyittenem Adonai beyad-midyan sheva shanim
Vattaaz yad-midyan al-yisrael mippene midyan asu lahem bene yisrael et-hamminharot asher beharim veet-hammearot veet-hammetzadot
Vehaya im-zara yisrael veala midyan vaamalek uvne-kedem vealu alav
Vayyachanu alehem vayyashchitu et-yevul haaretz ad-boacha azza velo-yashiru michya beyisrael vese vashor vachamor
Ki hem umiknehem yaalu veaholehem uvau chede-arbe larov velahem veligmallehem en mispar vayyavou vaaretz leshachatah
Vayyiddal yisrael meod mippene midyan vayyizaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai
Vayehi ki-zaaku vene-yisrael el-Adonai al odot midyan
Vayyishlach Adonai ish navi el-bene yisrael vayyomer lahem ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael anochi heeleti etchem mimmitzrayim vaotzi etchem mibbet avadim
Vaatztzil etchem miyyad mitzrayim umiyyad kal-lochatzechem vaagaresh otam mippenechem vaettena lachem et-artzam
Vaomra lachem ani Adonai elohechem lo tiru et-elohe haemori asher attem yoshvim beartzam velo shematem bekoli
Vayyavo malach Adonai vayyeshev tachat haela asher beafra asher leoash avi haezri vegidon beno chovet chittim baggat lehanis mippene midyan
Vayyera elav malleach Adonai vayyomer elav Adonai immecha gibbor hechayil

Vayyomer elav gidon bi adoni veyesh Adonai immanu velamma metzaatnu kal-zot veayye chal-nifleotav asher sipperu-lanu avotenu lemor halo mimmitzrayim heelanu Adonai veatta netashanu Adonai vayyittenenu bechaf-midyan
Vayyifen elav Adonai vayyomer lech bechochacha ze vehoshata et-yisrael mikkaf midyan halo shelachticha
Vayyomer elav bi adonay bamma oshia et-yisrael hinne alpi haddal bimnashshe veanochi hatztzair bevet avi
Vayyomer elav Adonai ki ehye immach vehikkita et-midyan keish echad

Al-na tamush mizze ad-boi elecha vehotzeti et-minchati vehinnachti lefanecha vayyomar anochi eshev ad shuvecha
Vegidon ba vayyaas gedi-izzim veefat-kemach matztzot habbasar sam bassal vehammarak sam bapparur vayyotze elav el-tachat haela vayyaggash
Vayyomer elav malach haelohim kach et-habbasar veet-hammatztzot vehannach el-hassela hallaz veet-hammarak shefoch vayyaas ken
Vayyishlach malach Adonai et-ketze hammishenet asher beyado vayyigga babbasar uvammatztzot vattaal haesh min-hatztzur vattochal et-habbasar veet-hammatztzot umalach Adonai halach meenav
Vayyar gidon ki-malach Adonai hu s vayyomer gidon ahah adonay Adonai ki-al-ken raiti malach Adonai panim el-panim
Vayyomer lo Adonai shalom lecha al-tira lo tamut
Vayyiven sham gidon mizbeach la-Adonai vayyikra-lo Adonai shalom ad hayyom hazze odennu beafrat avi haezri
Vayehi ballayela hahu vayyomer lo Adonai kach et-par-hashshor asher leavicha ufar hashsheni sheva shanim veharasta et-mizbach habbaal asher leavicha veet-haashera asher-alav tichrot
Uvanita mizbeach la-Adonai elohecha al rosh hammaoz hazze bammaaracha velakachta et-happar hashsheni vehaalita ola baatze haashera asher tichrot
Vayyikkach gidon asara anashim meavadav vayyaas kaasher dibber elav Adonai vayehi kaasher yare et-bet aviv veet-anshe hair measot yomam vayyaas layela
Vayyashkimu anshe hair babboker vehinne nuttatz mizbach habbaal vehaashera asher-alav korata veet happar hashsheni hoala al-hammizbeach habbanuy
Vayyomru ish el-reehu mi asa haddavar hazze vayyidreshu vayevakshu vayyomru gidon ben-yoash asa haddavar hazze
Vayyomru anshe hair el-yoash hotze et-bincha veyamot ki natatz et-mizbach habbaal vechi charat haashera asher-alav
Vayyomer yoash lechol asher-amdu alav haattem terivun labbaal im-attem toshiun oto asher yariv lo yumat ad-habboker im-elohim hu yarev lo ki natatz et-mizbecho
Vayyikra-lo vayyom-hahu yerubbaal lemor yarev bo habbaal ki natatz et-mizbecho
Vechal-midyan vaamalek uvne-kedem neesfu yachdav vayyaavru vayyachanu beemek yizreel
Veruach Adonai lavsha et-gidon vayyitka bashshofar vayizzaek aviezer acharav
Umalachim shalach bechal-menashshe vayizzaek gam-hu acharav umalachim shalach beasher uvizvulun uvnaftali vayyaalu likratam
Vayyomer gidon el-haelohim im-yeshcha moshia beyadi et-yisrael kaasher dibbarta
Hinne anochi matztzig et-gizzat hatztzemer baggoren im tal yihye al-haggizza levaddah veal-kal-haaretz chorev veyadati ki-toshia beyadi et-yisrael kaasher dibbarta
Vayehi-chen vayyashkem mimmachorat vayyazar et-haggizza vayyimetz tal min-haggizza melo hassefel mayim
Vayyomer gidon el-haelohim al-yichar appecha bi vaadabbera ach happaam anasse na-rak-happaam baggizza yehi-na chorev el-haggizza levaddah veal-kal-haaretz yihye-tal
Vayyaas elohim ken ballayela hahu vayehi-chorev el-haggizza levaddah veal-kal-haaretz haya tal
Vayyashkem yerubbaal hu gidon vechal-haam asher itto vayyachanu al-en charod umachane midyan haya-lo mitztzafon miggivat hammore baemek
Vayyomer Adonai el-gidon rav haam asher ittach mittitti et-midyan beyadam pen-yitpaer alay yisrael lemor yadi hoshia li
Veatta kera na beazne haam lemor mi-yare vechared yashov veyitzpor mehar haggilad vayyashav min-haam esrim ushnayim elef vaaseret alafim nisharu

Vayyomer Adonai el-gidon od haam rav hored otam el-hammayim veetzrefennu lecha sham vehaya asher omar elecha ze yelech ittach hu yelech ittach vechol asher-omar elecha ze lo-yelech immach hu lo yelech
Vayyored et-haam el-hammayim s vayyomer Adonai el-gidon kol asher-yalok bilshono min-hammayim kaasher yalok hakkelev tatztzig oto levad vechol asher-yichra al-birkav lishtot
Vayehi mispar hamalakkim beyadam el-pihem shelosh meot ish vechol yeter haam karu al-birchehem lishtot mayim
Vayyomer Adonai el-gidon bishlosh meot haish hamalakkim oshia etchem venatatti et-midyan beyadecha vechal-haam yelchu ish limkomo
Vayyikchu et-tzeda haam beyadam veet shofrotehem veet kal-ish yisrael shillach ish leohalav uvishlosh-meot haish hechezik umachane midyan haya lo mittachat baemek
Vayehi ballayela hahu vayyomer elav Adonai kum red bammachane ki netattiv beyadecha
Veim-yare atta laredet red atta ufura naarcha el-hammachane
Veshamata ma-yedabberu veachar techezakna yadecha veyaradta bammachane vayyered hu ufura naaro el-ketze hachamushim asher bammachane
Umidyan vaamalek vechal-bene-kedem noflim baemek kaarbe larov veligmallehem en mispar kachol sheal-sefat hayyam larov

Vayyavo gidon vehinne-ish mesapper lereehu chalom vayyomer hinne chalom chalamti vehinne tzelil lechem seorim mithappech bemachane midyan vayyavo ad-haohel vayyakkehu vayyippol vayyahafchehu lemala venafal haohel

Vayyachatz et-shelosh-meot haish shelosha rashim vayyitten shofarot beyad-kullam vechaddim rekim velappidim betoch hakkaddim
Vayyomer alehem mimmenni tiru vechen taasu vehinne anochi va biktze hammachane vehaya chaasher-eese ken taasun
Vetakati bashshofar anochi vechal-asher itti utkatem bashshofarot gam-attem sevivot kal-hammachane vaamartem la-Adonai ulgidon

Vayyitkeu sheloshet harashim bashshofarot vayyishberu hakkaddim vayyachaziku veyad-semolam ballappidim uvyad-yeminam hashshofarot litkoa vayyikreu cherev la-Adonai ulgidon
Vayyaamdu ish tachtav saviv lammachane vayyaratz kal-hammachane vayyariu vayyanusu
Vayyitkeu shelosh-meot hashshofarot vayyasem Adonai et cherev ish bereehu uvchal-hammachane vayyanas hammachane ad-bet hashshitta tzererata ad sefat-avel mechola al-tabbat
Vayyitztzaek ish-yisrael minnaftali umin-asher umin-kal-menashshe vayyirdefu achare midyan

Umalachim shalach gidon bechal-har efrayim lemor redu likrat midyan velichdu lahem et-hammayim ad bet bara veet-hayyarden vayyitztzaek kal-ish efrayim vayyilkedu et-hammayim ad bet bara veet-hayyarden
Vayyilkedu shene-sare midyan et-orev veet-zeev vayyahargu et-orev betzur-orev veet-zeev hargu veyekev-zeev vayyirdefu el-midyan verosh-orev uzev heviu el-gidon meever layyarden
Vayyomru elav ish efrayim ma-haddavar hazze asita lanu levilti kerot lanu ki halachta lehillachem bemidyan vayerivun itto bechazka
Vayyomer alehem me-asiti atta kachem halo tov ollot efrayim mivtzir aviezer
Beyedchem natan elohim et-sare midyan et-orev veet-zeev uma-yacholti asot kachem az rafta rucham mealav bedabbero haddavar hazze
Vayyavo gidon hayyardena over hu ushlosh-meot haish asher itto ayefim verodfim
Vayyomer leanshe sukkot tenu-na kikkerot lechem laam asher beraglay ki-ayefim hem veanochi rodef achare zevach vetzalmunna malche midyan
Vayyomer sare sukkot hachaf zevach vetzalmunna atta beyadecha ki-nitten litzvaacha lachem
Vayyomer gidon lachen betet Adonai et-zevach veet-tzalmunna beyadi vedashti et-besarchem et-kotze hammidbar veet-habbarkonim
Vayyaal mishsham penuel vayedabber alehem kazot vayyaanu oto anshe fenuel kaasher anu anshe sukkot
Vayyomer gam-leanshe fenuel lemor beshuvi veshalom ettotz et-hammigdal hazze
Vezevach vetzalmunna bakkarkor umachanehem immam kachameshet asar elef kol hannotarim mikkol machane vene-kedem vehannoflim mea veesrim elef ish sholef charev
Vayyaal gidon derech hashshechune vaohalim mikkedem lenovach veyagboha vayyach et-hammachane vehammachane haya vetach
Vayyanusu zevach vetzalmunna vayyirdof acharehem vayyilkod et-shene malche midyan et-zevach veet-tzalmunna vechal-hammachane hecherid
Vayyashav gidon ben-yoash min-hammilchama milmaale hechares
Vayyilkad-naar meanshe sukkot vayyishalehu vayyichtov elav et-sare sukkot veet-zekeneha shivim veshiva ish
Vayyavo el-anshe sukkot vayyomer hinne zevach vetzalmunna asher cheraftem oti lemor hachaf zevach vetzalmunna atta beyadecha ki nitten laanashecha hayeefim lachem
Vayyikkach et-zikne hair veet-kotze hammidbar veet-habbarkonim vayyoda bahem et anshe sukkot
Veet-migdal penuel natatz vayyaharog et-anshe hair
Vayyomer el-zevach veel-tzalmunna efo haanashim asher haragtem betavor vayyomru kamocha chemohem echad ketoar bene hammelech
Vayyomar achay bene-immi hem chay-Adonai lu hachayitem otam lo haragti etchem
Vayyomer leyeter bechoro kum harog otam velo-shalaf hannaar charbo ki yare ki odennu naar
Vayyomer zevach vetzalmunna kum atta ufga-banu ki chaish gevurato vayyakam gidon vayyaharog et-zevach veet-tzalmunna vayyikkach et-hassaharonim asher betzavvere gemallehem
Vayyomru ish-yisrael el-gidon meshal-banu gam-atta gam-bincha gam ben-benecha ki hoshatanu miyyad midyan

Vayyomer alehem gidon eshala mikkem sheela utnu-li ish nezem shelalo ki-nizme zahav lahem ki yishmeelim hem

Vayehi mishkal nizme hazzahav asher shaal elef ushva-meot zahav levad min-hassaharonim vehannetifot uvigde haargaman sheal malche midyan ulvad min-haanakot asher betzavvere gemallehem
Vayyaas oto gidon leefod vayyatztzeg oto veiro beafra vayyiznu chal-yisrael acharav sham vayehi legidon ulveto lemokesh

Vayyelech yerubbaal ben-yoash vayyeshev beveto
