Vayyerdu elav vayyitpallel elisha el-Adonai vayyomar hach-na et-haggoy-hazze bassanverim vayyakkem bassanverim kidvar elisha
Vayyomer alehem elisha lo ze hadderech velo zo hair lechu acharay veolicha etchem el-haish asher tevakkeshun vayyolech otam shomrona
Vayehi kevoam shomron vayyomer elisha Adonai pekach et-ene-elle veyiru vayyifkach Adonai et-enehem vayyiru vehinne betoch shomron
Vayyomer melech-yisrael el-elisha kiroto otam haakke akke avi
Vayyomer lo takke haasher shavita becharbecha uvkashtecha atta makke sim lechem vamayim lifnehem veyochlu veyishtu veyelchu el-adonehem
Vayyichre lahem kera gedola vayyochlu vayyishtu vayeshallechem vayyelchu el-adonehem velo-yasfu od gedude aram lavo beeretz yisrael
Vayehi achare-chen vayyikbotz ben-hadad melech-aram et-kal-machanehu vayyaal vayyatzar al-shomron
Vayehi raav gadol beshomron vehinne tzarim aleha ad heot rosh-chamor bishmonim kesef verova hakkav divonim bachamishsha-chasef
Vayehi melech yisrael over al-hachoma veishsha tzaaka elav lemor hoshia adoni hammelech
Vayyomer al-yoshiech Adonai meayin oshiech hamin-haggoren o min-hayyakev
Vayyomer-lah hammelech ma-lach vattomer haishsha hazzot amra elay teni et-benech venochlennu hayyom veet-beni nochal machar
Vannevashshel et-beni vannochlehu vaomar eleha bayyom haacher teni et-benech venochlennu vattachbi et-benah
Vayehi chishmoa hammelech et-divre haishsha vayyikra et-begadav vehu over al-hachoma vayyar haam vehinne hassak al-besaro mibbayit
Vayyomer ko-yaase-li elohim vecho yosif im-yaamod rosh elisha ben-shafat alav hayyom

Veelisha yoshev beveto vehazzekenim yoshvim itto vayyishlach ish millefanav beterem yavo hammalach elav vehu amar el-hazzekenim harreitem ki-shalach ben-hamratztzeach hazze lehasir et-roshi reu kevo hammalach sigru haddelet ulchatztem oto baddelet halo kol ragle adonav acharav
Odennu medabber immam vehinne hammalach yored elav vayyomer hinne-zot haraa meet Adonai ma-ochil la-Adonai od
Vayyomer elisha shimu devar-Adonai ko amar Adonai kaet machar sea-solet beshekel vesatayim seorim beshekel beshaar shomron
Vayyaan hashshalish asher-lammelech nishan al-yado et-ish haelohim vayyomar hinne Adonai ose arubbot bashshamayim hayihye haddavar hazze vayyomer hinnecha roe beenecha umishsham lo tochel
Vearbaa anashim hau metzoraim petach hashshaar vayyomru ish el-reehu ma anachnu yoshvim po ad-matnu
Im-amarnu navo hair veharaav bair vamatnu sham veim-yashavnu fo vamatnu veatta lechu venippela el-machane aram im-yechayyunu nichye veim-yemitunu vamatnu
Vayyakumu vanneshef lavo el-machane aram vayyavou ad-ketze machane aram vehinne en-sham ish
Vadonay hishmia et-machane aram kol rechev kol sus kol chayil gadol vayyomru ish el-achiv hinne sachar-alenu melech yisrael et-malche hachittim veet-malche mitzrayim lavo alenu
Vayyakumu vayyanusu vanneshef vayyaazvu et-aholehem veet-susehem veet-chamorehem hammachane kaasher-hi vayyanusu el-nafsham

Vayyavou hamtzoraim haelle ad-ketze hammachane vayyavou el-ohel echad vayyochlu vayyishtu vayyisu mishsham kesef vezahav uvgadim vayyelchu vayyatminu vayyashuvu vayyavou el-ohel acher vayyisu mishsham vayyelchu vayyatminu
Vayyomru ish el-reehu lo-chen anachnu osim hayyom hazze yom-besora hu vaanachnu machshim vechikkinu ad-or habboker umtzaanu aon veatta lechu venavoa venaggida bet hammelech
Vayyavou vayyikreu el-shoer hair vayyaggidu lahem lemor banu el-machane aram vehinne en-sham ish vekol adam ki im-hassus asur vehachamor asur veohalim kaasher-hemma
Vayyikra hashshoarim vayyaggidu bet hammelech penima

Vayyakam hammelech layela vayyomer el-avadav aggida-na lachem et asher-asu lanu aram yadu ki-reevim anachnu vayyetzu min-hammachane lehechave vassade lemor ki-yetzu min-hair venitpesem chayyim veel-hair navo
Vayyaan echad meavadav vayyomer veyikchu-na chamishsha min-hassusim hannisharim asher nisharu-vah hinnam hamon yisrael asher nisharu-vah hinnam kechal-hamon yisrael asher-tammu venishlecha venire
Vayyikchu shene rechev susim vayyishlach hammelech achare machane-aram lemor lechu uru
Vayyelchu acharehem ad-hayyarden vehinne chal-hadderech melea vegadim vechelim asher-hishlichu aram bechafzam vayyashuvu hammalachim vayyaggidu lammelech
Vayyetze haam vayyavozzu et machane aram vayehi sea-solet beshekel vesatayim seorim beshekel kidvar Adonai
Vehammelech hifkid et-hashshalish asher-nishan al-yado al-hashshaar vayyirmesuhu haam bashshaar vayyamot kaasher dibber ish haelohim asher dibber beredet hammelech elav
Vayehi kedabber ish haelohim el-hammelech lemor satayim seorim beshekel usa-solet beshekel yihye kaet machar beshaar shomron
Vayyaan hashshalish et-ish haelohim vayyomar vehinne Adonai ose arubbot bashshamayim hayihye kaddavar hazze vayyomer hinnecha roe beenecha umishsham lo tochel
Vayehi-lo ken vayyirmesu oto haam bashshaar vayyamot
Veelisha dibber el-haishsha asher-hecheya et-benah lemor kumi ulchi atte uvetech veguri baasher taguri ki-kara Adonai laraav vegam-ba el-haaretz sheva shanim
Vattakam haishsha vattaas kidvar ish haelohim vattelech hi uvetah vattagar beeretz-pelishtim sheva shanim
Vayehi miktze sheva shanim vattashav haishsha meeretz pelishtim vattetze litzok el-hammelech el-betah veel-sadah
Vehammelech medabber el-gechazi naar ish-haelohim lemor sappera-na li et kal-haggedolot asher-asa elisha

Vayehi hu mesapper lammelech et asher-hecheya et-hammet vehinne haishsha asher-hecheya et-benah tzoeket el-hammelech al-betah veal-sadah vayyomer gechazi adoni hammelech zot haishsha veze-benah asher-hecheya elisha
Vayyishal hammelech laishsha vattesapper-lo vayyitten-lah hammelech saris echad lemor hashev et-kal-asher-lah veet kal-tevuot hassade miyyom azva et-haaretz vead-atta
Vayyavo elisha dammesek uven-hadad melech-aram chole vayyuggad-lo lemor ba ish haelohim ad-henna
Vayyomer hammelech el-chazahel kach beyadcha mincha velech likrat ish haelohim vedarashta et-Adonai meoto lemor haechye mecholi ze
Vayyelech chazael likrato vayyikkach mincha veyado vechal-tuv dammesek massa arbaim gamal vayyavo vayyaamod lefanav vayyomer bincha ven-hadad melech-aram shelachani elecha lemor haechye mecholi ze
Vayyomer elav elisha lech lo chayo tichye vehirani Adonai ki-mot yamut
Vayyaamed et-panav vayyasem ad-bosh vayyevke ish haelohim
Vayyomer chazael maddua adoni voche vayyomer ki-yadati et asher-taase livne yisrael raa mivtzerehem teshallach baesh uvachurehem bacherev taharog veollehem terattesh veharotehem tevakkea
Vayyomer chazahel ki ma avdecha hakkelev ki yaase haddavar haggadol hazze vayyomer elisha hirani Adonai otcha melech al-aram
Vayyelech meet elisha vayyavo el-adonav vayyomer lo ma-amar lecha elisha vayyomer amar li chayo tichye
Vayehi mimmachorat vayyikkach hammachber vayyitbol bammayim vayyifros al-panav vayyamot vayyimloch chazahel tachtav
Uvishnat chamesh leoram ben-achav melech yisrael vihoshafat melech yehuda malach yehoram ben-yehoshafat melech yehuda
Ben-sheloshim ushtayim shana haya vemalcho ushmone shanim malach birushalam
Vayyelech bederech malche yisrael kaasher asu bet achav ki bat-achav hayeta-lo leishsha vayyaas hara beene Adonai
Velo-ava Adonai lehashchit et-yehuda lemaan david avdo kaasher amar-lo latet lo nir levanav kal-hayyamim
Beyamav pasha edom mittachat yad-yehuda vayyamlichu alehem melech
Vayyaavor yoram tzaira vechal-harechev immo vayehi-hu kam layela vayyakke et-edom hassovev elav veet sare harechev vayyanas haam leohalav
Vayyifsha edom mittachat yad-yehuda ad hayyom hazze az tifsha livna baet hahi
Veyeter divre yoram vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav yoram im-avotav vayyikkaver im-avotav beir david vayyimloch achazyahu veno tachtav
Bishnat shettem-esre shana leoram ben-achav melech yisrael malach achazyahu ven-yehoram melech yehuda
Ben-esrim ushtayim shana achazyahu vemalcho veshana achat malach birushalam veshem immo atalyahu bat-amri melech yisrael
Vayyelech bederech bet achav vayyaas hara beene Adonai kevet achav ki chatan bet-achav hu
Vayyelech et-yoram ben-achav lammilchama im-chazahel melech-aram beramot gilad vayyakku arammim et-yoram

Vayyashav yoram hammelech lehitrappe veyizreel min-hammakkim asher yakkuhu arammim barama behillachamo et-chazahel melech aram vaachazyahu ven-yehoram melech yehuda yarad lirot et-yoram ben-achav beyizreel ki-chole hu
Veelisha hannavi kara leachad mibbene hanneviim vayyomer lo chagor matnecha vekach pach hashshemen hazze beyadecha velech ramot gilad
Uvata shamma ure-sham yehu ven-yehoshafat ben-nimshi uvata vahakemoto mittoch echav veheveta oto cheder bechader
Velakachta fach-hashshemen veyatzakta al-rosho veamarta ko-amar Adonai meshachticha lemelech el-yisrael ufatachta haddelet venasta velo techakke
Vayyelech hannaar hannaar hannavi ramot gilad
Vayyavo vehinne sare hachayil yoshvim vayyomer davar li elecha hassar vayyomer yehu el-mi mikkullanu vayyomer elecha hassar
Vayyakam vayyavo habbayeta vayyitzok hashshemen el-rosho vayyomer lo ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael meshachticha lemelech el-am Adonai el-yisrael
Vehikkita et-bet achav adonecha venikkamti deme avaday hanneviim udme kal-avde Adonai miyyad izavel
Veavad kal-bet achav vehichratti leachav mashtin bekir veatzur veazuv beyisrael
Venatatti et-bet achav kevet yaravam ben-nevat uchvet basha ven-achiyya
Veet-izevel yochlu hakkelavim bechelek yizreel veen kover vayyiftach haddelet vayyanos
Veyehu yatza el-avde adonav vayyomer lo hashalom maddua ba-hamshugga hazze elecha vayyomer alehem attem yedatem et-haish veet-sicho
Vayyomru sheker hagged-na lanu vayyomer kazot vechazot amar elay lemor ko amar Adonai meshachticha lemelech el-yisrael
Vayemaharu vayyikchu ish bigdo vayyasimu tachtav el-gerem hammaalot vayyitkeu bashshofar vayyomru malach yehu
Vayyitkashsher yehu ben-yehoshafat ben-nimshi el-yoram veoram haya shomer beramot gilad hu vechal-yisrael mippene chazael melech-aram

Vayyashav yehoram hammelech lehitrappe viyezereel min-hammakkim asher yakkuhu arammim behillachamo et-chazael melech aram vayyomer yehu im-yesh nafshechem al-yetze falit min-hair lalechet lehaggid beyizreel
Vayyirkav yehu vayyelech yizreela ki yoram shochev shamma vaachazya melech yehuda yarad lirot et-yoram
Vehatztzofe omed al-hammigdal beyizreel vayyar et-shifat yehu bevoo vayyomer shifat ani roe vayyomer yehoram kach rakkav ushlach likratam veyomar hashalom
Vayyelech rochev hassus likrato vayyomer ko-amar hammelech hashalom vayyomer yehu ma-lecha ulshalom sov el-acharay vayyagged hatztzofe lemor ba-hammalach ad-hem velo-shav
Vayyishlach rochev sus sheni vayyavo alehem vayyomer ko-amar hammelech shalom vayyomer yehu ma-lecha ulshalom sov el-acharay
Vayyagged hatztzofe lemor ba ad-alehem velo-shav vehamminhag keminhag yehu ven-nimshi ki veshiggaon yinhag
Vayyomer yehoram esor vayyesor richbo vayyetze yehoram melech-yisrael vaachazyahu melech-yehuda ish berichbo vayyetzu likrat yehu vayyimtzauhu bechelkat navot hayyizreeli
Vayehi kirot yehoram et-yehu vayyomer hashalom yehu vayyomer ma hashshalom ad-zenune izevel immecha uchshafeha harabbim
Vayyahafoch yehoram yadav vayyanos vayyomer el-achazyahu mirma achazya
Veyehu mille yado vakkeshet vayyach et-yehoram ben zeroav vayyetze hachetzi millibbo vayyichra berichbo
Vayyomer el-bidkar shalisho sa hashlichehu bechelkat sede navot hayyizreeli ki-zechor ani vaatta et rochvim tzemadim achare achav aviv va-Adonai nasa alav et-hammassa hazze
Im-lo et-deme navot veet-deme vanav raiti emesh neum-Adonai veshillamti lecha bachelka hazzot neum-Adonai veatta sa hashlichehu bachelka kidvar Adonai
Vaachazya melech-yehuda raa vayyanas derech bet haggan vayyirdof acharav yehu vayyomer gam-oto hakkuhu el-hammerkava bemaale-gur asher et-yivleam vayyanas megiddo vayyamat sham
Vayyarkivu oto avadav yerushalama vayyikberu oto vikvurato im-avotav beir david
Uvishnat achat esre shana leoram ben-achav malach achazya al-yehuda
Vayyavo yehu yizreela veizevel shama vattasem bappuch eneha vattetev et-roshah vattashkef bead hachallon
Veyehu ba vashshaar vattomer hashalom zimri horeg adonav
Vayyissa fanav el-hachallon vayyomer mi itti mi vayyashkifu elav shenayim shelosha sarisim
Vayyomer shimtuha vayyishmetuha vayyiz middamah el-hakkir veel-hassusim vayyirmesenna
Vayyavo vayyochal vayyeshte vayyomer pikdu-na et-haarura hazzot vekivruha ki vat-melech hi
Vayyelchu lekavrah velo-matzu vah ki im-haggulgolet veharaglayim vechappot hayyadayim
Vayyashuvu vayyaggidu lo vayyomer devar-Adonai hu asher dibber beyad-avdo eliyyahu hattishbi lemor bechelek yizreel yochlu hakkelavim et-besar izavel
Vehayeta nivlat izevel kedomen al-pene hassade bechelek yizreel asher lo-yomru zot izavel
Ulachav shivim banim beshomron vayyichtov yehu sefarim vayyishlach shomron el-sare yizreel hazzekenim veel-haomnim achav lemor
Veatta kevo hassefer hazze alechem veittechem bene adonechem veittechem harechev vehassusim veir mivtzar vehannashek
Uritem hattov vehayyashar mibbene adonechem vesamtem al-kisse aviv vehillachamu al-bet adonechem
Vayyiru meod meod vayyomru hinne shene hammelachim lo amdu lefanav veech naamod anachnu
Vayyishlach asher-al-habbayit vaasher al-hair vehazzekenim vehaomnim el-yehu lemor avadecha anachnu vechol asher-tomar elenu naase lo-namlich ish hattov beenecha ase
Vayyichtov alehem sefer shenit lemor im-li attem ulkoli attem shomim kechu et-rashe anshe vene-adonechem uvou elay kaet machar yizreela uvne hammelech shivim ish et-gedole hair megaddelim otam
Vayehi kevo hassefer alehem vayyikchu et-bene hammelech vayyishchatu shivim ish vayyasimu et-rashehem baddudim vayyishlechu elav yizreela
Vayyavo hammalach vayyagged-lo lemor heviu rashe vene-hammelech vayyomer simu otam shene tzibburim petach hashshaar ad-habboker
Vayehi vabboker vayyetze vayyaamod vayyomer el-kal-haam tzaddikim attem hinne ani kasharti al-adoni vaehregehu umi hikka et-kal-elle
Deu efo ki lo yippol middevar Adonai artza asher-dibber Adonai al-bet achav va-Adonai asa et asher dibber beyad avdo eliyyahu
Vayyach yehu et kal-hannisharim levet-achav beyizreel vechal-gedolav umyuddaav vechohanav ad-bilti hishir-lo sarid
Vayyakam vayyavo vayyelech shomron hu bet-eked haroim baddarech
Veyehu matza et-ache achazyahu melech-yehuda vayyomer mi attem vayyomru ache achazyahu anachnu vannered lishlom bene-hammelech uvne haggevira
Vayyomer tifsum chayyim vayyitpesum chayyim vayyishchatum el-bor bet-eked arbaim ushnayim ish velo-hishir ish mehem

Vayyelech mishsham vayyimtza et-yehonadav ben-rechav likrato vayevarchehu vayyomer elav hayesh et-levavcha yashar kaasher levavi im-levavecha vayyomer yehonadav yesh vayesh tena et-yadecha vayyitten yado vayyaalehu elav el-hammerkava
Vayyomer lecha itti ure bekinati la-Adonai vayyarkivu oto berichbo
Vayyavo shomron vayyach et-kal-hannisharim leachav beshomron ad-hishmido kidvar Adonai asher dibber el-eliyyahu
Vayyikbotz yehu et-kal-haam vayyomer alehem achav avad et-habbaal meat yehu yaavdennu harbe
Veatta chal-nevie habbaal kal-ovdav vechal-kohanav kiru elay ish al-yippaked ki zevach gadol li labbaal kol asher-yippaked lo yichye veyehu asa veakba lemaan haavid et-ovde habbaal
Vayyomer yehu kaddeshu atzara labbaal vayyikrau
Vayyishlach yehu bechal-yisrael vayyavou kal-ovde habbaal velo-nishar ish asher lo-va vayyavou bet habbaal vayyimmale vet-habbaal pe lafe
Vayyomer laasher al-hammeltacha hotze levush lechol ovde habbaal vayyotze lahem hammalbush
Vayyavo yehu vihonadav ben-rechav bet habbaal vayyomer leovde habbaal chappesu uru pen-yesh-po immachem meavde Adonai ki im-ovde habbaal levaddam
Vayyavou laasot zevachim veolot veyehu sam-lo vachutz shemonim ish vayyomer haish asher-yimmalet min-haanashim asher ani mevi al-yedechem nafsho tachat nafsho
Vayehi kechalloto laasot haola vayyomer yehu laratzim velashshalishim bou hakkum ish al-yetze vayyakkum lefi-charev vayyashlichu haratzim vehashshalishim vayyelchu ad-ir bet-habbaal
Vayyotziu et-matztzevot bet-habbaal vayyisrefuha
Vayyittetzu et matztzevat habbaal vayyittetzu et-bet habbaal vayesimuhu lemotzaot ad-hayyom
Vayyashmed yehu et-habbaal miyyisrael
Rak chatae yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael lo-sar yehu meacharehem egle hazzahav asher bet-el vaasher bedan
Vayyomer Adonai el-yehu yaan asher-hetivota laasot hayyashar beenay kechol asher bilvavi asita levet achav bene reviim yeshvu lecha al-kisse yisrael
Veyehu lo shamar lalechet betorat-Adonai elohe-yisrael bechal-levavo lo sar meal chattot yaravam asher hecheti et-yisrael
Bayyamim hahem hechel Adonai lekatztzot beyisrael vayyakkem chazael bechal-gevul yisrael
Min-hayyarden mizrach hashshemesh et kal-eretz haggilad haggadi veharuveni vehamnashshi mearoer asher al-nachal arnon vehaggilad vehabbashan
Veyeter divre yehu vechal-asher asa vechal-gevurato halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav yehu im-avotav vayyikberu oto beshomron vayyimloch yehoachaz beno tachtav
Vehayyamim asher malach yehu al-yisrael esrim ushmone-shana beshomron
Vaatalya em achazyahu raata ki met benah vattakam vatteabbed et kal-zera hammamlacha

Vattikkach yehosheva bat-hammelech-yoram achot achazyahu et-yoash ben-achazya vattignov oto mittoch bene-hammelech hammumatim oto veet-menikto bachadar hammittot vayyastiru oto mippene atalyahu velo humat
Vayehi ittah bet Adonai mitchabbe shesh shanim vaatalya molechet al-haaretz
Uvashshana hashsheviit shalach yehoyada vayyikkach et-sare hammeot lakkari velaratzim vayyave otam elav bet Adonai vayyichrot lahem berit vayyashba otam bevet Adonai vayyar otam et-ben-hammelech
Vayetzavem lemor ze haddavar asher taasun hashshelishit mikkem bae hashshabbat veshomre mishmeret bet hammelech
Vehashshelishit beshaar sur vehashshelishit bashshaar achar haratzim ushmartem et-mishmeret habbayit massach
Ushte hayyadot bachem kol yotze hashshabbat veshamru et-mishmeret bet-Adonai el-hammelech
Vehikkaftem al-hammelech saviv ish vechelav beyado vehabba el-hassederot yumat vihu et-hammelech betzeto uvvoo
Vayyaasu sare hammeot kechol asher-tziva yehoyada hakkohen vayyikchu ish et-anashav bae hashshabbat im yotze hashshabbat vayyavou el-yehoyada hakkohen
Vayyitten hakkohen lesare hammeot et-hachanit veet-hashshelatim asher lammelech david asher bevet Adonai
Vayyaamdu haratzim ish vechelav beyado mikketef habbayit hayemanit ad-ketef habbayit hassemalit lammizbeach velabbayit al-hammelech saviv
Vayyotzi et-ben-hammelech vayyitten alav et-hannezer veet-haedut vayyamlichu oto vayyimshachuhu vayyakku-chaf vayyomru yechi hammelech
Vattishma atalya et-kol haratzin haam vattavo el-haam bet Adonai
Vattere vehinne hammelech omed al-haammud kammishpat vehassarim vehachatzotzrot el-hammelech vechal-am haaretz sameach vetokea bachatzotzrot vattikra atalya et-begadeha vattikra kesher kasher
Vayetzav yehoyada hakkohen et-sare hammeot pekude hachayil vayyomer alehem hotziu otah el-mibbet lassederot vehabba achareha hamet becharev ki amar hakkohen al-tumat bet Adonai
Vayyasimu lah yadayim vattavo derech-mevo hassusim bet hammelech vattumat sham
Vayyichrot yehoyada et-habberit ben Adonai uven hammelech uven haam lihot leam la-Adonai uven hammelech uven haam
Vayyavou chal-am haaretz bet-habbaal vayyittetzuhu mizbechotav veet-tzelamav shibberu hetev veet mattan kohen habbaal hargu lifne hammizbechot vayyasem hakkohen pekuddot al-bet Adonai
Vayyikkach et-sare hammeot veet-hakkari veet-haratzim veet kal-am haaretz vayyoridu et-hammelech mibbet Adonai vayyavou derech-shaar haratzim bet hammelech vayyeshev al-kisse hammelachim
Vayyismach kal-am-haaretz vehair shakata veet-atalyahu hemitu vacherev bet hammelech
Ben-sheva shanim yehoash bemalcho
Bishnat-sheva leyehu malach yehoash vearbaim shana malach birushalam veshem immo tzivya mibbeer shava
Vayyaas yehoash hayyashar beene Adonai kal-yamav asher horahu yehoyada hakkohen
Rak habbamot lo-saru od haam mezabbechim umkatterim babbamot
Vayyomer yehoash el-hakkohanim kol kesef hakkodashim asher-yuva vet-Adonai kesef over ish kesef nafshot erko kal-kesef asher yaale al lev-ish lehavi bet Adonai
Yikchu lahem hakkohanim ish meet makkaro vehem yechazzeku et-bedek habbayit lechol asher-yimmatze sham badek
Vayehi bishnat esrim veshalosh shana lammelech yehoash lo-chizzeku hakkohanim et-bedek habbayit
Vayyikra hammelech yehoash lihoyada hakkohen velakkohanim vayyomer alehem maddua enchem mechazzekim et-bedek habbayit veatta al-tikchu-chesef meet makkarechem ki-levedek habbayit tittenuhu
Vayyeotu hakkohanim levilti kechat-kesef meet haam ulvilti chazzek et-bedek habbayit
Vayyikkach yehoyada hakkohen aron echad vayyikkov chor bedalto vayyitten oto etzel hammizbeach miyyamin bevo-ish bet Adonai venatnu-shamma hakkohanim shomre hassaf et-kal-hakkesef hammuva vet-Adonai
Vayehi kirotam ki-rav hakkesef baaron vayyaal sofer hammelech vehakkohen haggadol vayyatzuru vayyimnu et-hakkesef hannimtza vet-Adonai
Venatnu et-hakkesef hamtukkan yede ose hammelacha hammufkadim bet Adonai vayyotziuhu lecharashe haetz velabbonim haosim bet Adonai
Velaggodrim ulchotzve haeven veliknot etzim veavne machtzev lechazzek et-bedek bet-Adonai ulchol asher-yetze al-habbayit lechazka
Ach lo yease bet Adonai sippot kesef mezammerot mizrakot chatzotzrot kal-keli zahav uchli-chasef min-hakkesef hammuva vet-Adonai
Ki-leose hammelacha yittenuhu vechizzeku-vo et-bet Adonai
Velo yechashshevu et-haanashim asher yittenu et-hakkesef al-yadam latet leose hammelacha ki veemuna hem osim
Kesef asham vechesef chattaot lo yuva bet Adonai lakkohanim yihu
Az yaale chazael melech aram vayyillachem al-gat vayyilkedah vayyasem chazael panav laalot al-yerushalam

Vayyikkach yehoash melech-yehuda et kal-hakkodashim asher-hikdishu yehoshafat vihoram vaachazyahu avotav malche yehuda veet-kodashav veet kal-hazzahav hannimtza beotzrot bet-Adonai uvet hammelech vayyishlach lachazael melech aram vayyaal meal yerushalam
Veyeter divre yoash vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyakumu avadav vayyiksheru-kasher vayyakku et-yoash bet millo hayyored silla
Veozavad ben-shimat vihozavad ben-shomer avadav hikkuhu vayyamot vayyikberu oto im-avotav beir david vayyimloch amatzya veno tachtav
Bishnat esrim veshalosh shana leoash ben-achazyahu melech yehuda malach yehoachaz ben-yehu al-yisrael beshomron sheva esre shana
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai vayyelech achar chattot yaravam ben-nevat asher-hecheti et-yisrael lo-sar mimmenna
Vayyichar-af Adonai beyisrael vayyittenem beyad chazael melech-aram uvyad ben-hadad ben-chazael kal-hayyamim
Vayechal yehoachaz et-pene Adonai vayyishma elav Adonai ki raa et-lachatz yisrael ki-lachatz otam melech aram
Vayyitten Adonai leyisrael moshia vayyetzu mittachat yad-aram vayyeshvu vene-yisrael beaholehem kitmol shilshom
Ach lo-saru mechattot bet-yaravam hecheti et-yisrael bah halach vegam haashera amda beshomron
Ki lo hishir lihoachaz am ki im-chamishshim parashim vaasara rechev vaaseret alafim ragli ki ibbedam melech aram vayesimem keafar ladush
Veyeter divre yehoachaz vechal-asher asa ugvurato halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav yehoachaz im-avotav vayyikberuhu beshomron vayyimloch yoash beno tachtav
Bishnat sheloshim vasheva shana leoash melech yehuda malach yehoash ben-yehoachaz al-yisrael beshomron shesh esre shana
Vayyaase hara beene Adonai lo sar mikkal-chattot yaravam ben-nevat asher-hecheti et-yisrael bah halach
Veyeter divre yoash vechal-asher asa ugvurato asher nilcham im amatzya melech-yehuda halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav yoash im-avotav veyaravam yashav al-kiso vayyikkaver yoash beshomron im malche yisrael
Veelisha chala et-chalo asher yamut bo vayyered elav yoash melech-yisrael vayyevke al-panav vayyomar avi avi rechev yisrael ufarashav
Vayyomer lo elisha kach keshet vechitztzim vayyikkach elav keshet vechitztzim
Vayyomer lemelech yisrael harkev yadcha al-hakkeshet vayyarkev yado vayyasem elisha yadav al-yede hammelech
Vayyomer petach hachallon kedma vayyiftach vayyomer elisha yere vayyor vayyomer chetz-teshua la-Adonai vechetz teshua vaaram vehikkita et-aram baafek ad-kalle
Vayyomer kach hachitztzim vayyikkach vayyomer lemelech-yisrael hach-artza vayyach shalosh-peamim vayyaamod
Vayyiktzof alav ish haelohim vayyomer lehakkot chamesh o-shesh peamim az hikkita et-aram ad-kalle veatta shalosh peamim takke et-aram
Vayyamat elisha vayyikberuhu ugdude moav yavou vaaretz ba shana
Vayehi hem kovrim ish vehinne rau et-haggedud vayyashlichu et-haish bekever elisha vayyelech vayyigga haish beatzmot elisha vayechi vayyakam al-raglav
Vachazael melech aram lachatz et-yisrael kol yeme yehoachaz
Vayyachan Adonai otam vayerachamem vayyifen alehem lemaan berito et-avraham yitzchak veyaakov velo ava hashchitam velo-hishlicham meal-panav ad-atta
Vayyamat chazael melech-aram vayyimloch ben-hadad beno tachtav
Vayyashav yehoash ben-yehoachaz vayyikkach et-hearim miyyad ben-hadad ben-chazael asher lakach miyyad yehoachaz aviv bammilchama shalosh peamim hikkahu yoash vayyashev et-are yisrael
Bishnat shettayim leoash ben-yoachaz melech yisrael malach amatzyahu ven-yoash melech yehuda
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana haya vemalcho veesrim vatesha shana malach birushalam veshem immo yehoaddan min-yerushalam
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai rak lo kedavid aviv kechol asher-asa yoash aviv asa
Rak habbamot lo-saru od haam mezabbechim umkatterim babbamot
Vayehi kaasher chazka hammamlacha beyado vayyach et-avadav hammakkim et-hammelech aviv
Veet-bene hammakkim lo hemit kakkatuv besefer torat-moshe asher-tziva Adonai lemor lo-yumtu avot al-banim uvanim lo-yumtu al-avot ki im-ish becheto yumat
Hu-hikka et-edom melach aseret alafim vetafas et-hassela bammilchama vayyikra et-shemah yakteel ad hayyom hazze
Az shalach amatzya malachim el-yehoash ben-yehoachaz ben-yehu melech yisrael lemor lecha nitrae fanim

Vayyishlach yehoash melech-yisrael el-amatzyahu melech-yehuda lemor hachoach asher ballevanon shalach el-haerez asher ballevanon lemor tena-et-bittecha livni leishsha vattaavor chayyat hassade asher ballevanon vattirmos et-hachoach
Hakke hikkita et-edom unsaacha libbecha hikkaved veshev bevetecha velamma titgare beraa venafalta atta vihuda immach
Velo-shama amatzyahu vayyaal yehoash melech-yisrael vayyitrau fanim hu vaamatzyahu melech-yehuda bevet shemesh asher lihuda
Vayyinnagef yehuda lifne yisrael vayyanusu ish leohalav
Veet amatzyahu melech-yehuda ben-yehoash ben-achazyahu tafas yehoash melech-yisrael bevet shamesh vayyavo yerushalam vayyifrotz bechomat yerushalam beshaar efrayim ad-shaar happinna arba meot amma
Velakach et-kal-hazzahav-vehakkesef veet kal-hakkelim hannimtzeim bet-Adonai uvotzrot bet hammelech veet bene hattaaruvot vayyashav shomrona
Veyeter divre yehoash asher asa ugvurato vaasher nilcham im amatzyahu melech-yehuda halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav yehoash im-avotav vayyikkaver beshomron im malche yisrael vayyimloch yaravam beno tachtav
Vayechi amatzyahu ven-yoash melech yehuda achare mot yehoash ben-yehoachaz melech yisrael chamesh esre shana
Veyeter divre amatzyahu halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyiksheru alav kesher birushalam vayyanas lachisha vayyishlechu acharav lachisha vayemituhu sham
Vayyisu oto al-hassusim vayyikkaver birushalam im-avotav beir david
Vayyikchu kal-am yehuda et-azarya vehu ben-shesh esre shana vayyamlichu oto tachat aviv amatzyahu
Hu bana et-elat vayeshiveha lihuda achare shechav-hammelech im-avotav
Bishnat chamesh-esre shana laamatzyahu ven-yoash melech yehuda malach yaravam ben-yoash melech-yisrael beshomron arbaim veachat shana
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai lo sar mikkal-chattot yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael
Hu heshiv et-gevul yisrael millevo chamat ad-yam haarava kidvar Adonai elohe yisrael asher dibber beyad-avdo yona ven-amittay hannavi asher miggat hachefer
Ki-raa Adonai et-oni yisrael more meod veefes atzur veefes azuv veen ozer leyisrael
Velo-dibber Adonai limchot et-shem yisrael mittachat hashshamayim vayyoshiem beyad yaravam ben-yoash
Veyeter divre yaravam vechal-asher asa ugvurato asher-nilcham vaasher heshiv et-dammesek veet-chamat lihuda beyisrael halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav yaravam im-avotav im malche yisrael vayyimloch zecharya veno tachtav
Bishnat esrim vasheva shana leyaravam melech yisrael malach azarya ven-amatzya melech yehuda
Ben-shesh esre shana haya vemalcho vachamishshim ushtayim shana malach birushalam veshem immo yechalyahu mirushalam
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa amatzyahu aviv
Rak habbamot lo-saru od haam mezabbechim umkatterim babbamot
Vayenagga Adonai et-hammelech vayehi metzora ad-yom moto vayyeshev bevet hachafshit veotam ben-hammelech al-habbayit shofet et-am haaretz
Veyeter divre azaryahu vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav azarya im-avotav vayyikberu oto im-avotav beir david vayyimloch yotam beno tachtav
Bishnat sheloshim ushmone shana laazaryahu melech yehuda malach zecharyahu ven-yaravam al-yisrael beshomron shishsha chodashim
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kaasher asu avotav lo sar mechattot yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael
Vayyikshor alav shallum ben-yavesh vayyakkehu kaval-am vayemitehu vayyimloch tachtav
Veyeter divre zecharya hinnam ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Hu devar-Adonai asher dibber el-yehu lemor bene reviim yeshvu lecha al-kisse yisrael vayehi-chen
Shallum ben-yavesh malach bishnat sheloshim vatesha shana leuziyya melech yehuda vayyimloch yerach-yamim beshomron
Vayyaal menachem ben-gadi mittirtza vayyavo shomron vayyach et-shallum ben-yavesh beshomron vayemitehu vayyimloch tachtav
Veyeter divre shallum vekishro asher kashar hinnam ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Az yakke-menachem et-tifsach veet-kal-asher-bah veet-gevuleha mittirtza ki lo fatach vayyach et kal-heharoteha bikkea
Bishnat sheloshim vatesha shana laazarya melech yehuda malach menachem ben-gadi al-yisrael eser shanim beshomron
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai lo sar meal chattot yaravam ben-nevat asher-hecheti et-yisrael kal-yamav
Ba ful melech-ashshur al-haaretz vayyitten menachem leful elef kikkar-kasef lihot yadav itto lehachazik hammamlacha beyado
Vayyotze menachem et-hakkesef al-yisrael al kal-gibbore hachayil latet lemelech ashshur chamishshim shekalim kesef leish echad vayyashav melech ashshur velo-amad sham baaretz
Veyeter divre menachem vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Vayyishkav menachem im-avotav vayyimloch pekachya veno tachtav
Bishnat chamishshim shana laazarya melech yehuda malach pekachya ven-menachem al-yisrael beshomron shenatayim
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai lo sar mechattot yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael
Vayyikshor alav pekach ben-remalyahu shalisho vayyakkehu veshomron bearmon hammelech et-argov veet-haarye veimmo chamishshim ish mibbene giladim vayemitehu vayyimloch tachtav
Veyeter divre fekachya vechal-asher asa hinnam ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Bishnat chamishshim ushtayim shana laazarya melech yehuda malach pekach ben-remalyahu al-yisrael beshomron esrim shana
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai lo sar min-chattot yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael

Bime pekach melech-yisrael ba tiglat pileser melech ashshur vayyikkach et-iyyon veet-avel bet-maacha veet-yanoach veet-kedesh veet-chatzor veet-haggilad veet-haggalila kol eretz naftali vayyaglem ashshura
Vayyikshar-kesher hoshea ben-ela al-pekach ben-remalyahu vayyakkehu vayemitehu vayyimloch tachtav bishnat esrim leotam ben-uziyya
Veyeter divre-fekach vechal-asher asa hinnam ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yisrael
Bishnat shettayim lefekach ben-remalyahu melech yisrael malach yotam ben-uziyyahu melech yehuda
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana haya vemalcho veshesh-esre shana malach birushalam veshem immo yerusha bat-tzadok
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa uziyyahu aviv asa
Rak habbamot lo saru od haam mezabbechim umkatterim babbamot hu bana et-shaar bet-Adonai haelon
Veyeter divre yotam asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Bayyamim hahem hechel Adonai lehashliach bihuda retzin melech aram veet pekach ben-remalyahu
Vayyishkav yotam im-avotav vayyikkaver im-avotav beir david aviv vayyimloch achaz beno tachtav
Bishnat sheva-esre shana lefekach ben-remalyahu malach achaz ben-yotam melech yehuda
Ben-esrim shana achaz bemalcho veshesh-esre shana malach birushalam velo-asa hayyashar beene Adonai elohav kedavid aviv
Vayyelech bederech malche yisrael vegam et-beno heevir baesh ketoavot haggoyim asher horish Adonai otam mippene bene yisrael
Vayezabbeach vayekatter babbamot veal-haggevaot vetachat kal-etz raanan
Az yaale retzin melech-aram ufekach ben-remalyahu melech-yisrael yerushalam lammilchama vayyatzuru al-achaz velo yachlu lehillachem
Baet hahi heshiv retzin melech-aram et-elat laaram vayenashshel et-hayehudim meelot vaadomim bau elat vayyeshvu sham ad hayyom hazze
Vayyishlach achaz malachim el-tiglat peleser melech-ashshur lemor avdecha uvincha ani ale vehoshieni mikkaf melech-aram umikkaf melech yisrael hakkomim alay
Vayyikkach achaz et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav hannimtza bet Adonai uvotzrot bet hammelech vayyishlach lemelech-ashshur shochad
Vayyishma elav melech ashshur vayyaal melech ashshur el-dammesek vayyitpeseha vayyagleha kira veet-retzin hemit

Vayyelech hammelech achaz likrat tiglat pileser melech-ashshur dummesek vayyar et-hammizbeach asher bedammasek vayyishlach hammelech achaz el-uriyya hakkohen et-demut hammizbeach veet-tavnito lechal-maasehu
Vayyiven uriyya hakkohen et-hammizbeach kechol asher-shalach hammelech achaz middammesek ken asa uriyya hakkohen ad-bo hammelech-achaz middammasek
Vayyavo hammelech middammesek vayyar hammelech et-hammizbeach vayyikrav hammelech al-hammizbeach vayyaal alav
Vayyakter et-olato veet-minchato vayyassech et-nisko vayyizrok et-dam-hashshelamim asher-lo al-hammizbeach
Veet hammizbach hannechoshet asher lifne Adonai vayyakrev meet pene habbayit mibben hammizbeach umibben bet Adonai vayyitten oto al-yerech hammizbeach tzafona

Vayetzave hammelech-achaz et-uriyya hakkohen lemor al hammizbeach haggadol hakter et-olat-habboker veet-minchat haerev veet-olat hammelech veet-minchato veet olat kal-am haaretz uminchatam veniskehem vechal-dam ola vechal-dam-zevach alav tizrok umizbach hannechoshet yihye-li levakker
Vayyaas uriyya hakkohen kechol asher-tziva hammelech achaz
Vayekatztzetz hammelech achaz et-hammisgerot hammechonot vayyasar mealehem vt-et- hakkiyyor veet-hayyam horid meal habbakar hannechoshet asher tachteha vayyitten oto al martzefet avanim
Musach hashshabbat asher-banu vabbayit veet-mevo hammelech hachitzona hesev bet Adonai mippene melech ashshur
Veyeter divre achaz asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav achaz im-avotav vayyikkaver im-avotav beir david vayyimloch chizkiyyahu veno tachtav
Bishnat shettem esre leachaz melech yehuda malach hoshea ben-ela veshomron al-yisrael tesha shanim
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai rak lo kemalche yisrael asher hau lefanav
Alav ala shalmaneser melech ashshur vayehi-lo hoshea eved vayyashev lo mincha
Vayyimtza melech-ashshur behoshea kesher asher shalach malachim el-so melech-mitzrayim velo-heela mincha lemelech ashshur keshana veshana vayyaatzrehu melech ashshur vayyaasrehu bet kele
Vayyaal melech-ashshur bechal-haaretz vayyaal shomron vayyatzar aleha shalosh shanim
Bishnat hatteshiit lehoshea lachad melech-ashshur et-shomron vayyegel et-yisrael ashshura vayyoshev otam bachlach uvchavor nehar gozan veare maday
Vayehi ki-chatu vene-yisrael la-Adonai elohehem hammaale otam meeretz mitzrayim mittachat yad paro melech-mitzrayim vayyiru elohim acherim
Vayyelchu bechukkot haggoyim asher horish Adonai mippene bene yisrael umalche yisrael asher asu
Vayechappeu vene-yisrael devarim asher lo-chen al-Adonai elohehem vayyivnu lahem bamot bechal-arehem mimmigdal notzrim ad-ir mivtzar
Vayyatztzivu lahem matztzevot vaasherim al kal-giva gevoha vetachat kal-etz raanan
Vayekatteru-sham bechal-bamot kaggoyim asher-hegla Adonai mippenehem vayyaasu devarim raim lehachis et-Adonai
Vayyaavdu haggillulim asher amar Adonai lahem lo taasu et-haddavar hazze

Vayyaad Adonai beyisrael uvihuda beyad nevie chal-choze lemor shuvu middarchechem haraim veshimru mitzotay chukkotay kechal-hattora asher tziviti et-avotechem vaasher shalachti alechem beyad avaday hanneviim
Velo shameu vayyakshu et-arpam keoref avotam asher lo heeminu ba-Adonai elohehem
Vayyimasu et-chukkav veet-berito asher karat et-avotam veet edotav asher heid bam vayyelchu achare hahevel vayyehbalu veachare haggoyim asher sevivotam asher tziva Adonai otam levilti asot kahem
Vayyaazvu et-kal-mitzot Adonai elohehem vayyaasu lahem massecha shene agalim vayyaasu ashera vayyishtachau lechal-tzeva hashshamayim vayyaavdu et-habbaal
Vayyaaviru et-benehem veet-benotehem baesh vayyiksemu kesamim vayenacheshu vayyitmakkeru laasot hara beene Adonai lehachiso
Vayyitannaf Adonai meod beyisrael vayesirem meal panav lo nishar rak shevet yehuda levaddo
Gam-yehuda lo shamar et-mitzot Adonai elohehem vayyelchu bechukkot yisrael asher asu
Vayyimas Adonai bechal-zera yisrael vayeannem vayyittenem beyad-shosim ad asher hishlicham mippanav
Ki-kara yisrael meal bet david vayyamlichu et-yaravam ben-nevat vayyaddach yaravam et-yisrael meachare Adonai vehecheteam chataa gedola
Vayyelchu bene yisrael bechal-chattot yaravam asher asa lo-saru mimmenna
Ad asher-hesir Adonai et-yisrael meal panav kaasher dibber beyad kal-avadav hanneviim vayyigel yisrael meal admato ashshura ad hayyom hazze
Vayyave melech-ashshur mibbavel umikkuta umeava umechamat usfarvayim vayyoshev beare shomron tachat bene yisrael vayyirshu et-shomron vayyeshvu beareha
Vayehi bitchillat shivtam sham lo yaru et-Adonai vayeshallach Adonai bahem et-haaraot vayyihu horgim bahem

Vayyomru lemelech ashshur lemor haggoyim asher higlita vattoshev beare shomron lo yadu et-mishpat elohe haaretz vayeshallach-bam et-haaraot vehinnam memitim otam kaasher enam yodim et-mishpat elohe haaretz
Vayetzav melech-ashshur lemor holichu shamma echad mehakkohanim asher higlitem mishsham veyelchu veyeshvu sham veyorem et-mishpat elohe haaretz
Vayyavo echad mehakkohanim asher higlu mishshomron vayyeshev bevet-el vayehi more otam ech yiru et-Adonai
Vayyihu osim goy goy elohav vayyannichu bevet habbamot asher asu hashshomronim goy goy bearehem asher hem yoshvim sham
Veanshe vavel asu et-sukkot benot veanshe-chut asu et-nergal veanshe chamat asu et-ashima
Vehaavim asu nivchaz veet-tartak vehasfarvim sorfim et-benehem baesh leadrammelech vaanammelech elohe sefarvayim
Vayyihu yereim et-Adonai vayyaasu lahem miktzotam kohane vamot vayyihu osim lahem bevet habbamot
Et-Adonai hau yereim veet-elohehem hau ovdim kemishpat haggoyim asher-higlu otam mishsham
Ad hayyom hazze hem osim kammishpatim harishonim enam yereim et-Adonai veenam osim kechukkotam uchmishpatam vechattora vechammitzva asher tziva Adonai et-bene yaakov asher-sam shemo yisrael
Vayyichrot Adonai ittam berit vayetzavem lemor lo tiru elohim acherim velo-tishtachau lahem velo taavdum velo tizbechu lahem
Ki im-et-Adonai asher heela etchem meeretz mitzrayim bechoach gadol uvizroa netuya oto tirau velo tishtachau velo tizbachu
Veet-hachukkim veet-hammishpatim vehattora vehammitzva asher katav lachem tishmerun laasot kal-hayyamim velo tiru elohim acherim
Vehabberit asher-karatti ittechem lo tishkachu velo tiru elohim acherim
Ki im-et-Adonai elohechem tirau vehu yatztzil etchem miyyad kal-oyevechem
Velo shameu ki im-kemishpatam harishon hem osim
Vayyihu haggoyim haelle yereim et-Adonai veet-pesilehem hau ovdim gam-benehem uvne venehem kaasher asu avotam hem osim ad hayyom hazze
Vayehi bishnat shalosh lehoshea ben-ela melech yisrael malach chizkiyya ven-achaz melech yehuda
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana haya vemalcho veesrim vatesha shana malach birushalam veshem immo avi bat-zecharya
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai kechol asher-asa david aviv
Hu hesir et-habbamot veshibbar et-hammatztzevot vecharat et-haashera vechittat nechash hannechoshet asher-asa moshe ki ad-hayyamim hahemma hau vene-yisrael mekatterim lo vayyikra-lo nechushtan
Ba-Adonai elohe-yisrael batach veacharav lo-haya chamohu bechol malche yehuda vaasher hau lefanav
Vayyidbak ba-Adonai lo-sar meacharav vayyishmor mitzotav asher-tziva Adonai et-moshe
Vehaya Adonai immo bechol asher-yetze yaskil vayyimrod bemelech-ashshur velo avado
Hu-hikka et-pelishtim ad-azza veet-gevuleha mimmigdal notzrim ad-ir mivtzar
Vayehi bashshana harviit lammelech chizkiyyahu hi hashshana hashsheviit lehoshea ben-ela melech yisrael ala shalmaneser melech-ashshur al-shomron vayyatzar aleha
Vayyilkeduha miktze shalosh shanim bishnat-shesh lechizkiyya hi shenat-tesha lehoshea melech yisrael nilkeda shomron
Vayyegel melech-ashshur et-yisrael ashshura vayyanchem bachlach uvchavor nehar gozan veare maday
Al asher lo-shamu bekol Adonai elohehem vayyaavru et-berito et kal-asher tziva moshe eved Adonai velo shamu velo asu
Uvarba esre shana lammelech chizkiyya ala sancheriv melech-ashshur al kal-are yehuda habbetzurot vayyitpesem

Vayyishlach chizkiyya melech-yehuda el-melech-ashshur lachisha lemor chatati shuv mealay et asher-titten alay essa vayyasem melech-ashshur al-chizkiyya melech-yehuda shelosh meot kikkar-kesef ushloshim kikkar zahav
Vayyitten chizkiyya et-kal-hakkesef hannimtza vet-Adonai uvotzrot bet hammelech
Baet hahi kitztzatz chizkiyya et-daltot hechal Adonai veet-haomnot asher tzippa chizkiyya melech yehuda vayyittenem lemelech ashshur

Vayyishlach melech-ashshur et-tartan veet-rav-saris veet-rav-shake min-lachish el-hammelech chizkiyyahu bechel kaved yerushalam vayyaalu vayyavou yerushalam vayyaalu vayyavou vayyaamdu bitalat habberecha haelona asher bimsillat sede choves
Vayyikreu el-hammelech vayyetze alehem elyakim ben-chilkiyyahu asher al-habbayit veshevna hassofer veoach ben-asaf hammazkir
Vayyomer alehem rav-shake imru-na el-chizkiyyahu ko-amar hammelech haggadol melech ashshur ma habbittachon hazze asher batachta
Amarta ach-devar-sefatayim etza ugvura lammilchama atta al-mi vatachta ki maradta bi
Atta hinne vatachta lecha al-mishenet hakkane haratzutz hazze al-mitzrayim asher yissamech ish alav uva vechappo unkavah ken paro melech-mitzrayim lechal-habbotchim alav
Vechi-tomrun elay el-Adonai elohenu batachnu halo-hu asher hesir chizkiyyahu et-bamotav veet-mizbechotav vayyomer lihuda velirushalam lifne hammizbeach hazze tishtachau birushalam
Veatta hitarev na et-adoni et-melech ashshur veettena lecha alpayim susim im-tuchal latet lecha rochvim alehem
Veech tashiv et pene fachat achad avde adoni hakketannim vattivtach lecha al-mitzrayim lerechev ulfarashim
Atta hamibbalade Adonai aliti al-hammakom hazze lehashchito Adonai amar elay ale al-haaretz hazzot vehashchitah
Vayyomer elyakim ben-chilkiyyahu veshevna veoach el-rav-shake dabber-na el-avadecha aramit ki shomim anachnu veal-tedabber immanu yehudit beazne haam asher al-hachoma
Vayyomer alehem rav-shake haal adonecha veelecha shelachani adoni ledabber et-haddevarim haelle halo al-haanashim hayyoshvim al-hachoma leechol et tzoatam velishtot mme raglehem immachem
Vayyaamod rav-shake vayyikra vekol-gadol yehudit vayedabber vayyomer shimu devar-hammelech haggadol melech ashshur
Ko amar hammelech al-yashshi lachem chizkiyyahu ki-lo yuchal lehatztzil etchem miyyado
Veal-yavtach etchem chizkiyyahu el-Adonai lemor hatztzel yatztzilenu Adonai velo tinnaten et-hair hazzot beyad melech ashshur
Al-tishmeu el-chizkiyyahu ki cho amar melech ashshur asu-itti veracha utzu elay veichlu ish-gafno veish teenato ushtu ish me-voro

Ad-boi velakachti etchem el-eretz keartzechem eretz dagan vetirosh eretz lechem uchramim eretz zet yitzhar udvash vichu velo tamutu veal-tishmeu el-chizkiyyahu ki-yassit etchem lemor Adonai yatztzilenu
Hahatztzel hitztzilu elohe haggoyim ish et-artzo miyyad melech ashshur
Ayye elohe chamat vearpad ayye elohe sefarvayim hena veiva ki-hitztzilu et-shomron miyyadi
Mi bechal-elohe haaratzot asher-hitztzilu et-artzam miyyadi ki-yatztzil Adonai et-yerushalam miyyadi
Vehecherishu haam velo-anu oto davar ki-mitzvat hammelech hi lemor lo taanuhu
Vayyavo elyakim ben-chilkiyya asher-al-habbayit veshevna hassofer veoach ben-asaf hammazkir el-chizkiyyahu kerue vegadim vayyaggidu lo divre rav-shake
Vayehi kishmoa hammelech chizkiyyahu vayyikra et-begadav vayyitkas bassak vayyavo bet Adonai
Vayyishlach et-elyakim asher-al-habbayit veshevna hassofer veet zikne hakkohanim mitkassim bassakkim el-yeshayahu hannavi ben-amotz
Vayyomru elav ko amar chizkiyyahu yom-tzara vetochecha unatza hayyom hazze ki vau vanim ad-mashber vechoach ayin leleda

Ulay yishma Adonai elohecha et kal-divre rav-shake asher shelacho melech-ashshur adonav lecharef elohim chay vehochiach baddevarim asher shama Adonai elohecha venasata tefilla bead hashsheerit hannimtzaa
Vayyavou avde hammelech chizkiyyahu el-yeshaayahu
Vayyomer lahem yeshayahu ko tomrun el-adonechem ko amar Adonai al-tira mippene haddevarim asher shamata asher giddefu naare melech-ashshur oti
Hinni noten bo ruach veshama shemua veshav leartzo vehippaltiv bacherev beartzo
Vayyashav rav-shake vayyimtza et-melech ashshur nilcham al-livna ki shama ki nasa millachish
Vayyishma el-tirhaka melech-kush lemor hinne yatza lehillachem ittach vayyashav vayyishlach malachim el-chizkiyyahu lemor
Ko tomrun el-chizkiyyahu melech-yehuda lemor al-yashshiacha elohecha asher atta boteach bo lemor lo tinnaten yerushalam beyad melech ashshur
Hinne atta shamata et asher asu malche ashshur lechal-haaratzot lehacharimam veatta tinnatzel
Hahitztzilu otam elohe haggoyim asher shichatu avotay et-gozan veet-charan veretzef uvne-eden asher bitlasar
Ayyo melech-chamat umelech arpad umelech lair sefarvayim hena veiva
Vayyikkach chizkiyyahu et-hassefarim miyyad hammalachim vayyikraem vayyaal bet Adonai vayyifresehu chizkiyyahu lifne Adonai
Vayyitpallel chizkiyyahu lifne Adonai vayyomar Adonai elohe yisrael yoshev hakkeruvim atta-hu haelohim levaddecha lechol mamlechot haaretz atta asita et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz
Hatte Adonai aznecha ushama pekach Adonai enecha ure ushma et divre sancheriv asher shelacho lecharef elohim chay
Amnam Adonai hecherivu malche ashshur et-haggoyim veet-artzam
Venatnu et-elohehem baesh ki lo elohim hemma ki im-maase yede-adam etz vaeven vayeabbedum
Veatta Adonai elohenu hoshienu na miyyado veyedu kal-mamlechot haaretz ki atta Adonai elohim levaddecha
Vayyishlach yeshayahu ven-amotz el-chizkiyyahu lemor ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael asher hitpallalta elay el-sancheriv melech-ashshur shamati
Ze haddavar asher-dibber Adonai alav baza lecha laaga lecha betulat bat-tziyyon acharecha rosh henia bat yerushalam
Et-mi cherafta vegiddafta veal-mi harimota kol vattissa marom enecha al-kedosh yisrael
Beyad malachecha cherafta adonay vattomer berov richbi ani aliti merom harim yarkete levanon veechrot komat arazav mivchor beroshav veavoa melon kitztzo yaar karmillo
Ani karti veshatiti mayim zarim veachriv bechaf-peamay kol yeore matzor
Halo-shamata lemerachok otah asiti lemime kedem vitzartiha atta havetiha uthi lahshot gallim nitztzim arim betzurot
Veyoshvehen kitzre-yad chattu vayyevoshu hau esev sade virak deshe chatzir gaggot ushdefa lifne kama
Veshivtecha vetzetcha uvoacha yadati veet hitraggezcha elay
Yaan hitraggezcha elay veshaanancha ala veaznay vesamti chachi beappecha umitgi bisfatecha vahashivoticha badderech asher-bata bah
Veze-lecha haot achol hashshana safiach uvashshana hashshenit sachish uvashshana hashshelishit ziru vekitzru venitu cheramim veichlu firyam
Veyasfa peletat bet-yehuda hannishara shoresh lematta veasa feri lemala
Ki mirushalam tetze sheerit ufleta mehar tziyyon kinat tzevaot taase-zot
Lachen ko-amar Adonai el-melech ashshur lo yavo el-hair hazzot velo-yore sham chetz velo-yekaddemenna magen velo-yishpoch aleha solla
Badderech asher-yavo bah yashuv veel-hair hazzot lo yavo neum-Adonai
Vegannoti el-hair hazzot lehoshiah lemaani ulmaan david avdi
Vayehi ballayela hahu vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachane ashshur mea shemonim vachamishsha alef vayyashkimu vabboker vehinne chullam pegarim metim
Vayyissa vayyelech vayyashav sancheriv melech-ashshur vayyeshev beninve
Vayehi hu mishtachave bet nisroch elohav veadrammelech banav hikkuhu vacherev vehemma nimletu eretz ararat vayyimloch esar-chaddon beno tachtav
Bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut vayyavo elav yeshayahu ven-amotz hannavi vayyomer elav ko-amar Adonai tzav levetecha ki met atta velo tichye
Vayyassev et-panav el-hakkir vayyitpallel el-Adonai lemor
Anna Adonai zechar-na et asher hithallachti lefanecha beemet uvlevav shalem vehattov beenecha asiti vayyevke chizkiyyahu bechi gadol
Vayehi yeshayahu lo yatza chatzer hattichona udvar-Adonai haya elav lemor
Shuv veamarta el-chizkiyyahu negid-ammi ko-amar Adonai elohe david avicha shamati et-tefillatecha raiti et-dimatecha hinni rofe lach bayyom hashshelishi taale bet Adonai
Vehosafti al-yamecha chamesh esre shana umikkaf melech-ashshur atztzilcha veet hair hazzot vegannoti al-hair hazzot lemaani ulmaan david avdi
Vayyomer yeshayahu kechu develet teenim vayyikchu vayyasimu al-hashshechin vayyechi
Vayyomer chizkiyyahu el-yeshayahu ma ot ki-yirpa Adonai li vealiti bayyom hashshelishi bet Adonai
Vayyomer yeshayahu ze-lecha haot meet Adonai ki yaase Adonai et-haddavar asher dibber halach hatztzel eser maalot im-yashuv eser maalot
Vayyomer yechizkiyyahu nakel latztzel lintot eser maalot lo chi yashuv hatztzel achorannit eser maalot
Vayyikra yeshayahu hannavi el-Adonai vayyashev et-hatztzel bammaalot asher yarda bemaalot achaz achorannit eser maalot
Baet hahi shalach berodach baladan ben-baladan melech-bavel sefarim umincha el-chizkiyyahu ki shama ki chala chizkiyyahu

Vayyishma alehem chizkiyyahu vayyarem et-kal-bet nechoto et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav veet-habbesamim veet shemen hattov veet bet kelav veet kal-asher nimtza beotzrotav lo-haya davar asher lo-heram chizkiyyahu beveto uvchal-memshalto
Vayyavo yeshayahu hannavi el-hammelech chizkiyyahu vayyomer elav ma amru haanashim haelle umeayin yavou elecha vayyomer chizkiyyahu meeretz rechoka bau mibbavel
Vayyomer ma rau bevetecha vayyomer chizkiyyahu et kal-asher beveti rau lo-haya davar asher lo-hiritim beotzrotay
Vayyomer yeshayahu el-chizkiyyahu shema devar-Adonai
Hinne yamim baim venissa kal-asher bevetecha vaasher atzru avotecha ad-hayyom hazze bavela lo-yivater davar amar Adonai
Umibbanecha asher yetzu mimmecha asher tolid yikkachu vehau sarisim behechal melech bavel
Vayyomer chizkiyyahu el-yeshayahu tov devar-Adonai asher dibbarta vayyomer halo im-shalom veemet yihye veyamay
Veyeter divre chizkiyyahu vechal-gevurato vaasher asa et-habberecha veet-hatteala vayyave et-hammayim haira halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav chizkiyyahu im-avotav vayyimloch menashshe veno tachtav
Ben-shettem esre shana menashshe vemalcho vachamishshim vechamesh shana malach birushalam veshem immo cheftzi-vah
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai ketoavot haggoyim asher horish Adonai mippene bene yisrael
Vayyashav vayyiven et-habbamot asher ibbad chizkiyyahu aviv vayyakem mizbechot labbaal vayyaas ashera kaasher asa achav melech yisrael vayyishtachu lechal-tzeva hashshamayim vayyaavod otam
Uvana mizbechot bevet Adonai asher amar Adonai birushalam asim et-shemi
Vayyiven mizbechot lechal-tzeva hashshamayim bishte chatzrot bet-Adonai
Veheevir et-beno baesh veonen venichesh veasa ov veyiddeonim hirba laasot hara beene Adonai lehachis
Vayyasem et-pesel haashera asher asa babbayit asher amar Adonai el-david veel-shelomo veno babbayit hazze uvirushalam asher bacharti mikkol shivte yisrael asim et-shemi leolam
Velo osif lehanid regel yisrael min-haadama asher natatti laavotam rak im-yishmeru laasot kechol asher tzivitim ulchal-hattora asher-tziva otam avdi moshe
Velo shameu vayyatem menashshe laasot et-hara min-haggoyim asher hishmid Adonai mippene bene yisrael
Vayedabber Adonai beyad-avadav hanneviim lemor
Yaan asher asa menashshe melech-yehuda hattoevot haelle hera mikkol asher-asu haemori asher lefanav vayyachati gam-et-yehuda begillulav
Lachen ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael hinni mevi raa al-yerushalam vihuda asher shomah titztzalna shette aznav
Venatiti al-yerushalam et kav shomron veet-mishkolet bet achav umachiti et-yerushalam kaasher-yimche et-hatztzallachat macha vehafach al-paneha
Venatashti et sheerit nachalati untattim beyad oyevehem vehau levaz velimshissa lechal-oyevehem
Yaan asher asu et-hara beenay vayyihu machisim oti min-hayyom asher yatzu avotam mimmitzrayim vead hayyom hazze
Vegam dam naki shafach menashshe harbe meod ad asher-mille et-yerushalam pe lafe levad mechattato asher hecheti et-yehuda laasot hara beene Adonai
Veyeter divre menashshe vechal-asher asa vechattato asher chata halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav menashshe im-avotav vayyikkaver began-beto began-uzza vayyimloch amon beno tachtav
Ben-esrim ushtayim shana amon bemalcho ushtayim shanim malach birushalam veshem immo meshullemet bat-charutz min-yatva
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kaasher asa menashshe aviv
Vayyelech bechal-hadderech asher-halach aviv vayyaavod et-haggillulim asher avad aviv vayyishtachu lahem
Vayyaazov et-Adonai elohe avotav velo halach bederech Adonai
Vayyiksheru avde-amon alav vayyamitu et-hammelech beveto
Vayyach am-haaretz et kal-hakkoshrim al-hammelech amon vayyamlichu am-haaretz et-yoshiyyahu veno tachtav
Veyeter divre amon asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyikbor oto bikvurato began-uzza vayyimloch yoshiyyahu veno tachtav
Ben-shemone shana yoshiyyahu vemalcho ushloshim veachat shana malach birushalam veshem immo yedida vat-adaya mibbatzkat
Vayyaas hayyashar beene Adonai vayyelech bechal-derech david aviv velo-sar yamin usmol
Vayehi bishmone esre shana lammelech yoshiyyahu shalach hammelech et-shafan ben-atzalyahu ven-meshullam hassofer bet Adonai lemor
Ale el-chilkiyyahu hakkohen haggadol veyattem et-hakkesef hammuva bet Adonai asher asfu shomre hassaf meet haam
Veyittenuhu al-yad ose hammelacha hammufkadim bet Adonai veyittenu oto leose hammelacha asher bevet Adonai lechazzek bedek habbayit
Lecharashim velabbonim velaggodrim veliknot etzim veavne machtzev lechazzek et-habbayit
Ach lo-yechashev ittam hakkesef hannittan al-yadam ki veemuna hem osim
Vayyomer chilkiyyahu hakkohen haggadol al-shafan hassofer sefer hattora matzati bevet Adonai vayyitten chilkiyya et-hassefer el-shafan vayyikraehu
Vayyavo shafan hassofer el-hammelech vayyashev et-hammelech davar vayyomer hittichu avadecha et-hakkesef hannimtza vabbayit vayyittenuhu al-yad ose hammelacha hammufkadim bet Adonai
Vayyagged shafan hassofer lammelech lemor sefer natan li chilkiyya hakkohen vayyikraehu shafan lifne hammelech
Vayehi kishmoa hammelech et-divre sefer hattora vayyikra et-begadav
Vayetzav hammelech et-chilkiyya hakkohen veet-achikam ben-shafan veet-achbor ben-michaya veet shafan hassofer veet asaya eved-hammelech lemor

Lechu dirshu et-Adonai baadi uvad-haam uvad kal-yehuda al-divre hassefer hannimtza hazze ki-gedola chamat Adonai asher-hi nitztzeta vanu al asher lo-shamu avotenu al-divre hassefer hazze laasot kechal-hakkatuv alenu
Vayyelech chilkiyyahu hakkohen vaachikam veachbor veshafan vaasaya el-chulda hannevia eshet shallum ben-tikva ben-charchas shomer habbegadim vehi yoshevet birushalam bammishne vayedabberu eleha
Vattomer alehem ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael imru laish asher-shalach etchem elay
Ko amar Adonai hinni mevi raa el-hammakom hazze veal-yoshvav et kal-divre hassefer asher kara melech yehuda
Tachat asher azavuni vayekatteru lelohim acherim lemaan hachiseni bechol maase yedehem venitztzeta chamati bammakom hazze velo tichbe
Veel-melech yehuda hashsholeach etchem lidrosh et-Adonai ko tomru elav ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael haddevarim asher shamata
Yaan rach-levavcha vattikkana mippene Adonai beshamacha asher dibbarti al-hammakom hazze veal-yoshvav lihot leshamma veliklala vattikra et-begadecha vattivke lefanay vegam anochi shamati neum-Adonai
Lachen hinni osifcha al-avotecha veneesafta el-kivrotecha beshalom velo-tirena enecha bechol haraa asher-ani mevi al-hammakom hazze vayyashivu et-hammelech davar
Vayyishlach hammelech vayyaasfu elav kal-zikne yehuda virushalam

Vayyaal hammelech bet-Adonai vechal-ish yehuda vechal-yoshve yerushalam itto vehakkohanim vehanneviim vechal-haam lemikkaton vead-gadol vayyikra veaznehem et-kal-divre sefer habberit hannimtza bevet Adonai

Vayyaamod hammelech al-haammud vayyichrot et-habberit lifne Adonai lalechet achar Adonai velishmor mitzotav veet-edotav veet-chukkotav bechal-lev uvchal-nefesh lehakim et-divre habberit hazzot hakketuvim al-hassefer hazze vayyaamod kal-haam babberit

Vayetzav hammelech et-chilkiyyahu hakkohen haggadol veet-kohane hammishne veet-shomre hassaf lehotzi mehechal Adonai et kal-hakkelim haasuyim labbaal velaashera ulchol tzeva hashshamayim vayyisrefem michutz lirushalam beshadmot kidron venasa et-afaram bet-el
Vehishbit et-hakkemarim asher natnu malche yehuda vayekatter babbamot beare yehuda umsibbe yerushalam veet-hamkatterim labbaal lashshemesh velayyareach velammazzalot ulchol tzeva hashshamayim
Vayyotze et-haashera mibbet Adonai michutz lirushalam el-nachal kidron vayyisrof otah benachal kidron vayyadek leafar vayyashlech et-afarah al-kever bene haam
Vayyittotz et-batte hakkedeshim asher bevet Adonai asher hannashim orgot sham battim laashera

Vayyave et-kal-hakkohanim meare yehuda vayetamme et-habbamot asher kitteru-shamma hakkohanim miggeva ad-beer shava venatatz et-bamot hashshearim asher-petach shaar yehoshua sar-hair asher-al-semol ish beshaar hair
Ach lo yaalu kohane habbamot el-mizbach Adonai birushalam ki im-achlu matztzot betoch achehem
Vetimme et-hattofet asher bege vny-ven- hinnom levilti lehaavir ish et-beno veet-bitto baesh lammolech
Vayyashbet et-hassusim asher natnu malche yehuda lashshemesh mibbo vet-Adonai el-lishkat netan-melech hassaris asher bapparvarim veet-markevot hashshemesh saraf baesh

Veet-hammizbechot asher al-haggag aliyyat achaz asher-asu malche yehuda veet-hammizbechot asher-asa menashshe bishte chatzrot bet-Adonai natatz hammelech vayyaratz mishsham vehishlich et-afaram el-nachal kidron
Veet-habbamot asher al-pene yerushalam asher mimin lehar-hammashchit asher bana shelomo melech-yisrael leashtoret shikkutz tzidonim velichmosh shikkutz moav ulmilkom toavat bene-ammon timme hammelech
Veshibbar et-hammatztzevot vayyichrot et-haasherim vayemalle et-mekomam atzmot adam
Vegam et-hammizbeach asher bevet-el habbama asher asa yaravam ben-nevat asher hecheti et-yisrael gam et-hammizbeach hahu veet-habbama natatz vayyisrof et-habbama hedak leafar vesaraf ashera

Vayyifen yoshiyyahu vayyar et-hakkevarim asher-sham bahar vayyishlach vayyikkach et-haatzamot min-hakkevarim vayyisrof al-hammizbeach vayetammeehu kidvar Adonai asher kara ish haelohim asher kara et-haddevarim haelle
Vayyomer ma hatztziyyun hallaz asher ani roe vayyomru elav anshe hair hakkever ish-haelohim asher-ba mihuda vayyikra et-haddevarim haelle asher asita al hammizbach bet-el
Vayyomer hannichu lo ish al-yana atzmotav vayemalletu atzmotav et atzmot hannavi asher-ba mishshomron
Vegam et-kal-batte habbamot asher beare shomron asher asu malche yisrael lehachis hesir yoshiyyahu vayyaas lahem kechal-hammaasim asher asa bevet-el
Vayyizbach et-kal-kohane habbamot asher-sham al-hammizbechot vayyisrof et-atzmot adam alehem vayyashav yerushalam
Vayetzav hammelech et-kal-haam lemor asu fesach la-Adonai elohechem kakkatuv al sefer habberit hazze
Ki lo naasa kappesach hazze mime hashshoftim asher shaftu et-yisrael vechol yeme malche yisrael umalche yehuda
Ki im-bishmone esre shana lammelech yoshiyyahu naasa happesach hazze la-Adonai birushalam

Vegam et-haovot veet-hayyiddeonim veet-hatterafim veet-haggillulim veet kal-hashshikkutzim asher niru beeretz yehuda uvirushalam bier yoshiyyahu lemaan hakim et-divre hattora hakketuvim al-hassefer asher matza chilkiyyahu hakkohen bet Adonai
Vechamohu lo-haya lefanav melech asher-shav el-Adonai bechal-levavo uvchal-nafsho uvchal-meodo kechol torat moshe veacharav lo-kam kamohu
Ach lo-shav Adonai mecharon appo haggadol asher-chara appo bihuda al kal-hakkeasim asher hichiso menashshe
Vayyomer Adonai gam et-yehuda asir meal panay kaasher hasiroti et-yisrael umaasti et-hair hazzot asher-bacharti et-yerushalam veet-habbayit asher amarti yihye shemi sham
Veyeter divre yoshiyyahu vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Beyamav ala faro necho melech-mitzrayim al-melech ashshur al-nehar-perat vayyelech hammelech yoshiyyahu likrato vayemitehu bimgiddo kiroto oto
Vayyarkivuhu avadav met mimmegiddo vayeviuhu yerushalam vayyikberuhu bikvurato vayyikkach am-haaretz et-yehoachaz ben-yoshiyyahu vayyimshechu oto vayyamlichu oto tachat aviv
Ben-esrim veshalosh shana yehoachaz bemalcho ushlosha chodashim malach birushalam veshem immo chamutal bat-yirmeyahu millivna
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kechol asher-asu avotav
Vayyaasrehu faro necho verivla beeretz chamat mimmeloch birushalam vayyitten-onesh al-haaretz mea chikkar-kesef vechikkar zahav
Vayyamlech paro necho et-elyakim ben-yoshiyyahu tachat yoshiyyahu aviv vayyassev et-shemo yehoyakim veet-yehoachaz lakach vayyavo mitzrayim vayyamat sham
Vehakkesef vehazzahav natan yehoyakim lefaro ach heerich et-haaretz latet et-hakkesef al-pi faro ish keerko nagas et-hakkesef veet-hazzahav et-am haaretz latet lefaro necho
Ben-esrim vechamesh shana yehoyakim bemalcho veachat esre shana malach birushalam veshem immo zevudda vat-pedaya min-ruma
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kechol asher-asu avotav
Beyamav ala nevuchadnetzar melech bavel vayehi-lo yehoyakim eved shalosh shanim vayyashav vayyimrad-bo
Vayeshallach Adonai bo et-gedude chasdim veet-gedude aram veet gedude moav veet gedude vene-ammon vayeshallechem bihuda lehaavido kidvar Adonai asher dibber beyad avadav hanneviim
Ach al-pi Adonai hayeta bihuda lehasir meal panav bechattot menashshe kechol asher asa
Vegam dam-hannaki asher shafach vayemalle et-yerushalam dam naki velo-ava Adonai lisloach
Veyeter divre yehoyakim vechal-asher asa halo-hem ketuvim al-sefer divre hayyamim lemalche yehuda
Vayyishkav yehoyakim im-avotav vayyimloch yehoyachin beno tachtav
Velo-hosif od melech mitzrayim latzet meartzo ki-lakach melech bavel minnachal mitzrayim ad-nehar-perat kol asher hayeta lemelech mitzrayim
Ben-shemone esre shana yehoyachin bemalcho ushlosha chodashim malach birushalam veshem immo nechushta vat-elnatan mirushalam
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kechol asher-asa aviv
Baet hahi alu avde nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel yerushalam vattavo hair bammatzor
Vayyavo nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel al-hair vaavadav tzarim aleha
Vayyetze yehoyachin melech-yehuda al-melech bavel hu veimmo vaavadav vesarav vesarisav vayyikkach oto melech bavel bishnat shemone lemalcho
Vayyotze mishsham et-kal-otzrot bet Adonai veotzrot bet hammelech vayekatztzetz et-kal-kele hazzahav asher asa shelomo melech-yisrael behechal Adonai kaasher dibber Adonai
Vehigla et-kal-yerushalam veet-kal-hassarim veet kal-gibbore hachayil aseret alafim gole vechal-hecharash vehammasger lo nishar zulat dallat am-haaretz
Vayyegel et-yehoyachin bavela veet-em hammelech veet-neshe hammelech veet-sarisav veet ele haaretz holich gola mirushalam bavela
Veet kal-anshe hachayil shivat alafim vehecharash vehammasger elef hakkol gibborim ose milchama vayeviem melech-bavel gola bavela
Vayyamlech melech-bavel et-mattanya dodo tachtav vayyassev et-shemo tzidkiyyahu
Ben-esrim veachat shana tzidkiyyahu vemalcho veachat esre shana malach birushalam veshem immo chamutal bat-yirmeyahu millivna
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kechol asher-asa yehoyakim
Ki al-af Adonai hayeta virushalam uvihuda ad-hishlicho otam meal panav vayyimrod tzidkiyyahu bemelech bavel
Vayehi vishnat hatteshiit lemalcho bachodesh haasiri beasor lachodesh ba nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel hu vechal-chelo al-yerushalam vayyichan aleha vayyivnu aleha dayek saviv
Vattavo hair bammatzor ad ashte esre shana lammelech tzidkiyyahu
Betisha lachodesh vayyechezak haraav bair velo-haya lechem leam haaretz
Vattibbaka hair vechal-anshe hammilchama hallayela derech shaar ben hachomotayim asher al-gan hammelech vechasdim al-hair saviv vayyelech derech haarava
Vayyirdefu chel-kasdim achar hammelech vayyassigu oto bearvot yerecho vechal-chelo nafotzu mealav
Vayyitpesu et-hammelech vayyaalu oto el-melech bavel rivlata vayedabberu itto mishpat
Veet-bene tzidkiyyahu shachatu leenav veet-ene tzidkiyyahu iver vayyaasrehu vanchushtayim vayeviehu bavel
Uvachodesh hachamishi beshiva lachodesh hi shenat tesha-esre shana lammelech nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel ba nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim eved melech-bavel yerushalam
Vayyisrof et-bet-Adonai veet-bet hammelech veet kal-batte yerushalam veet-kal-bet gadol saraf baesh
Veet-chomot yerushalam saviv nattzu kal-chel kasdim asher rav-tabbachim
Veet yeter haam hannisharim bair veet-hannoflim asher naflu al-hammelech bavel veet yeter hehamon hegla nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim
Umiddallat haaretz hishir rav-tabbachim lechormim ulyogvim
Veet-ammude hannechoshet asher bet-Adonai veet-hammechonot veet-yam hannechoshet asher bevet-Adonai shibberu chasdim vayyisu et-nechushtam bavela
Veet-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hamzammerot veet-hakkappot veet kal-kele hannechoshet asher yeshartu-vam lakachu
Veet-hammachtot veet-hammizrakot asher zahav zahav vaasher-kesef kasef lakach rav-tabbachim
Haammudim shenayim hayyam haechad vehammechonot asher-asa shelomo levet Adonai lo-haya mishkal linchoshet kal-hakkelim haelle
Shemone esre amma komat haammud haechad vechoteret alav nechoshet vekomat hakkoteret shalosh ammot usvacha verimmonim al-hakkoteret saviv hakkol nechoshet vechaelle laammud hashsheni al-hassevacha
Vayyikkach rav-tabbachim et-seraya kohen harosh veet-tzefanyahu kohen mishne veet-sheloshet shomre hassaf

Umin-hair lakach saris echad asher-hu fakid al-anshe hammilchama vachamishsha anashim meroe fene-hammelech asher nimtzeu vair veet hassofer sar hatztzava hammatzbi et-am haaretz veshishshim ish meam haaretz hannimtzeim bair
Vayyikkach otam nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim vayyolech otam al-melech bavel rivlata
Vayyach otam melech bavel vayemitem berivla beeretz chamat vayyigel yehuda meal admato
Vehaam hannishar beeretz yehuda asher hishir nevuchadnetzar melech bavel vayyafked alehem et-gedalyahu ben-achikam ben-shafan

Vayyishmeu chal-sare hachayalim hemma vehaanashim ki-hifkid melech-bavel et-gedalyahu vayyavou el-gedalyahu hammitzpa veyishmael ben-netanya veochanan ben-kareach usraya ven-tanchumet hannetofati veyaazanyahu ben-hammaachati hemma veanshehem
Vayyishshava lahem gedalyahu ulanshehem vayyomer lahem al-tiru meavde hakkasdim shevu vaaretz veivdu et-melech bavel veyitav lachem
Vayehi bachodesh hashshevii ba yishmael ben-netanya ben-elishama mizzera hammelucha vaasara anashim itto vayyakku et-gedalyahu vayyamot veet-hayehudim veet-hakkasdim asher-hau itto bammitzpa
Vayyakumu chal-haam mikkaton vead-gadol vesare hachayalim vayyavou mitzrayim ki yaru mippene chasdim

Vayehi vishloshim vasheva shana legalut yehoyachin melech-yehuda bishnem asar chodesh beesrim veshiva lachodesh nasa evil merodach melech bavel bishnat malcho et-rosh yehoyachin melech-yehuda mibbet kele
Vayedabber itto tovot vayyitten et-kiso meal kisse hammelachim asher itto bevavel
Veshinna et bigde chilo veachal lechem tamid lefanav kal-yeme chayyav
Vaaruchato aruchat tamid nittena-lo meet hammelech devar-yom beomo kol yeme chayyav
Isaiah: Chazon yeshayahu ven-amotz asher chaza al-yehuda virushalam bime uzziyyahu yotam achaz yechizkiyyahu malche yehuda
Shimu shamayim vehaazini eretz ki Adonai dibber banim giddalti veromamti vehem pashu vi
Yada shor konehu vachamor evus bealav yisrael lo yada ammi lo hitbonan
Hoy goy chote am keved aon zera mereim banim mashchitim azvu et-Adonai niatzu et-kedosh yisrael nazoru achor
Al me tukku od tosifu sara kal-rosh lacholi vechal-levav davay
Mikkaf-regel vead-rosh en-bo metom petza vechabbura umakka teriyya lo-zoru velo chubbashu velo rukkecha bashshamen
Artzechem shemama arechem serufot esh admatchem lenegdechem zarim ochlim otah ushmama kemahpechat zarim
Venotra vat-tziyyon kesukka vecharem kimluna vemiksha keir netzura
Lule Adonai tzevaot hotir lanu sarid kimat kisdom hayinu laamora daminu
Shimu devar-Adonai ketzine sedom haazinu torat elohenu am amora
Lamma-li rov-zivchechem yomar Adonai savati olot elim vechelev meriim vedam parim uchvasim veattudim lo chafatzti
Ki tavou leraot panay mi-vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray
Lo tosifu havi minchat-shave ketoret toeva hi li chodesh veshabbat kero mikra lo-uchal aven vaatzara
Chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hau alay latorach nileti neso
Uvfarischem kappechem alim enay mikkem gam ki-tarbu tefilla enenni shomea yedechem damim maleu
Rachatzu hizzakku hasiru roa maallechem minneged enay chidlu harea
Limdu hetev dirshu mishpat ashsheru chamotz shiftu yatom rivu almana
Lechu-na venivachcha yomar Adonai im-yihu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu im-yadimu chattola katztzemer yihu
Im-tovu ushmatem tuv haaretz tochelu
Veim-temaanu umritem cherev teukkelu ki pi Adonai dibber
Echa hayeta lezona kirya neemana meleati mishpat tzedek yalin bah veatta meratztzechim
Kaspech haya lesigim savech mahul bammayim
Sarayich sorrim vechavre gannavim kullo ohev shochad verodef shalmonim yatom lo yishpotu veriv almana lo-yavo alehem
Lachen neum haadon Adonai tzevaot avir yisrael hoy ennachem mitztzaray veinnakma meoyevay
Veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich veasira kal-bedilayich
Veashiva shoftayich kevarishona veyoatzayich kevattechilla achare-chen yikkare lach ir hatztzedek kirya neemana
Tziyyon bemishpat tippade veshaveha bitzdaka
Veshever poshim vechattaim yachdav veozve Adonai yichlu
Ki yevoshu meelim asher chamadtem vetachperu mehaggannot asher bechartem
Ki tihu keela novelet aleha uchganna asher-mayim en lah
Vehaya hechason linoret ufoalo lenitzotz uvaaru shenehem yachdav veen mechabbe
Haddavar asher chaza yeshayahu ben-amotz al-yehuda virushalam
Vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet-Adonai berosh heharim venissa miggevaot venaharu elav kal-haggoyim
Vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el-har-Adonai el-bet elohe yaakov veyorenu midderachav venelcha beorchotav ki mitztziyyon tetze tora udvar-Adonai mirushalam
Veshafat ben haggoyim vehochiach leammim rabbim vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot lo-yissa goy el-goy cherev velo-yilmedu od milchama
Bet yaakov lechu venelcha beor Adonai
Ki natashta ammecha bet yaakov ki malu mikkedem veonnim kappelishtim uvyalde nachrim yaspiku
Vattimmale artzo kesef vezahav veen ketze leotzrotav vattimmale artzo susim veen ketze lemarkevotav
Vattimmale artzo elilim lemaase yadav yishtachau laasher asu etzbeotav
Vayyishshach adam vayyishpal-ish veal-tissa lahem
Bo vatztzur vehittamen beafar mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono
Ene gavhut adam shafel veshach rum anashim venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu
Ki yom la-Adonai tzevaot al kal-gee varam veal kal-nissa veshafel
Veal kal-arze hallevanon haramim vehannissaim veal kal-allone habbashan
Veal kal-heharim haramim veal kal-haggevaot hannissaot
Veal kal-migdal gavoha veal kal-choma vetzura
Veal kal-oniyyot tarshish veal kal-sechiyyot hachemda
Veshach gavhut haadam veshafel rum anashim venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu
Vehaelilim kalil yachalof
Uvau bimarot tzurim uvimchillot afar mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono bekumo laarotz haaretz
Bayyom hahu yashlich haadam et elile chaspo veet elile zehavo asher asu-lo lehishtachaot lachpor perot velaatallefim
Lavo benikrot hatztzurim uvisife hasselaim mippene pachad Adonai umehadar geono bekumo laarotz haaretz
Chidlu lachem min-haadam asher neshama beappo ki-vamme nechshav hu
Ki hinne haadon Adonai tzevaot mesir mirushalam umihuda mashen umashena kol mishan-lechem vechol mishan-mayim
Gibbor veish milchama shofet venavi vekosem vezaken
Sar-chamishshim unsu fanim veoetz vachacham charashim unvon lachash
Venatatti nearim sarehem vetaalulim yimshelu-vam
Veniggas haam ish beish veish bereehu yirhavu hannaar bazzaken vehannikle bannichbad
Ki-yitpos ish beachiv bet aviv simla lecha katzin tihye-lanu vehammachshela hazzot tachat yadecha
Yissa vayyom hahu lemor lo-ehye chovesh uvveti en lechem veen simla lo tesimuni ketzin am
Ki chashla yerushalam vihuda nafal ki-leshonam umaallehem el-Adonai lamrot ene chevodo
Hakkarat penehem anta bam vechattatam kisdom higgidu lo chichedu oy lenafsham ki-gamlu lahem raa
Imru tzaddik ki-tov ki-feri maallehem yochelu
Oy lerasha ra ki-gemul yadav yease lo
Ammi nogsav meolel venashim mashlu vo ammi meashsherecha matim vederech orchotecha billeu
Nitztzav lariv Adonai veomed ladin ammim
Adonai bemishpat yavo im-zikne ammo vesarav veattem biartem hakkerem gezelat heani bevattechem
Ma- lachem tedakkeu ammi ufne aniyyim titchanu neum-adonay Adonai tzevaot
Vayyomer Adonai yaan ki gavhu benot tziyyon vattelachna netuot garon umsakkerot enayim haloch vetafof telachna uvraglehem teakkasna
Vesippach adonay kadkod benot tziyyon va-Adonai pathen yeare
Bayyom hahu yasir adonay et tiferet haachasim vehashshevisim vehassaharonim
Hannetifot vehashsherot veharalot
Happeerim vehatztzeadot vehakkishshurim uvatte hannefesh vehallechashim
Hattabbaot venizme haaf
Hammachalatzot vehammaatafot vehammitpachot vehacharitim
Vehaggilyonim vehassedinim vehatztzenifot vehardidim
Vehaya tachat bosem mak yihye vetachat chagora nikpa vetachat maase mikshe karcha vetachat petigil machagoret sak ki-tachat yofi
Metayich bacherev yippolu ugvuratech bammilchama
Veanu veavlu petacheha venikkata laaretz teshev
Vehecheziku sheva nashim beish echad bayyom hahu lemor lachmenu nochel vesimlatenu nilbash rak yikkare shimcha alenu esof cherpatenu
Bayyom hahu yihye tzemach Adonai litzvi ulchavod ufri haaretz legaon ultiferet lifletat yisrael
Vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar birushalam kadosh yeamer lo kal-hakkatuv lachayyim birushalam
Im rachatz adonay et tzoat benot-tziyyon veet-deme yerushalam yadiach mikkirbah beruach mishpat uvruach baer
Uvara Adonai al kal-mechon har-tziyyon veal-mikraeha anan yomam veashan venogah esh lehava layela ki al-kal-kavod chuppa
Vesukka tihye letzel-yomam mechorev ulmachse ulmistor mizzerem umimmatar
Ashira na lididi shirat dodi lecharmo kerem haya lididi bekeren ben-shamen
Vayeazzekehu vayesakkelehu vayyittaehu sorek vayyiven migdal betocho vegam-yekev chatzev bo vayekav laasot anavim vayyaas beushim
Veatta yoshev yerushalam veish yehuda shiftu-na beni uven karmi
Ma-laasot od lecharmi velo asiti bo maddua kiveti laasot anavim vayyaas beushim
Veatta odia-na etchem et asher-ani ose lecharmi haser mesukkato vehaya levaer parotz gedero vehaya lemirmas
Vaashitehu vata lo yizzamer velo yeader veala shamir vashayit veal heavim atzave mehamtir alav matar
Ki cherem Adonai tzevaot bet yisrael veish yehuda neta shaashuav vayekav lemishpat vehinne mispach litzdaka vehinne tzeaka
Hoy maggie vayit bevayit sade vesade yakrivu ad efes makom vehushavtem levaddechem bekerev haaretz
Beaznay Adonai tzevaot im-lo battim rabbim leshamma yihu gedolim vetovim meen yoshev
Ki aseret tzimde-cherem yaasu bat echat vezera chomer yaase efa
