Derech shalom lo yadau veen mishpat bemagelotam netivotehem ikkeshu lahem kol dorech bah lo yada shalom
Al-ken rachak mishpat mimmennu velo tassigenu tzedaka nekave laor vehinne-choshech lingohot baafelot nehallech
Negashsha chaiverim kir uchen enayim negashshesha kashalnu vatztzahorayim kanneshef baashmannim kammetim
Neheme chaddubbim kullanu vechayyonim hago nehge nekave lammishpat vaayin lishua rachaka mimmennu
Ki-rabbu feshaenu negdecha vechattotenu anta banu ki-feshaenu ittanu vaaonotenu yedaanum
Pashoa vechachesh ba-Adonai venasog meachar elohenu dabber-oshek vesara horo vehogo millev divre-shaker
Vehussag achor mishpat utzdaka merachok taamod ki-chashla varchov emet unchocha lo-tuchal lavo
Vattehi haemet nederet vesar mera mishtolel vayyar Adonai vayyera beenav ki-en mishpat
Vayyar ki-en ish vayyishtomem ki en mafgia vattosha lo zeroo vetzidkato hi semachathu
Vayyilbash tzedaka kashshiryan vechova yeshua berosho vayyilbash bigde nakam tilboshet vayyaat kamil kina
Keal gemulot keal yeshallem chema letzarav gemul leoyevav laiyyim gemul yeshallem
Veyiru mimmaarav et-shem Adonai umimmizrach-shemesh et-kevodo ki-yavo channahar tzar ruach Adonai nossa vo
Uva letziyyon goel ulshave fesha beyaakov neum Adonai
Vaani zot beriti otam amar Adonai ruchi asher alecha udvaray asher-samti beficha lo-yamushu mippicha umippi zaracha umippi zera zaracha amar Adonai meatta vead-olam
Kumi ori ki va orech uchvod Adonai alayich zarach
Ki-hinne hachoshech yechasse-eretz vaarafel leummim vealayich yizrach Adonai uchvodo alayich yerae
Vehalchu goyim leorech umlachim lenogah zarchech
Sei-saviv enayich uri kullam nikbetzu vau-lach banayich merachok yavou uvnotayich al-tzad teamana
Az tiri venaharte ufachad verachav levavech ki-yehafech alayich hamon yam chel goyim yavou lach
Shifat gemallim techassech bichre midyan veefa kullam mishsheva yavou zahav ulvona yissau uthillot Adonai yevasseru
Kal-tzon kedar yikkavtzu lach ele nevaot yeshartunech yaalu al-ratzon mizbechi uvet tifarti afaer
Mi-elle kaav teufena vechayyonim el-arubbotehem
Ki-li iyyim yekauu vaoniyyot tarshish barishona lehavi vanayich merachok kaspam uzhavam ittam leshem Adonai elohayich velikdosh yisrael ki fearach
Uvanu vene-nechar chomotayich umalchehem yeshartunech ki vekitzpi hikkitich uvirtzoni richamtich
Ufittechu shearayich tamid yomam valayela lo yissageru lehavi elayich chel goyim umalchehem nehugim
Ki-haggoy vehammamlacha asher lo-yaavduch yovedu vehaggoyim charov yecheravu
Kevod hallevanon elayich yavo berosh tidhar utashshur yachdav lefaer mekom mikdashi umkom raglay achabbed
Vehalchu elayich shechoach bene meannayich vehishtachau al-kappot raglayich kal-menaatzayich vekaru lach ir Adonai tziyyon kedosh yisrael
Tachat heotech azuva usnua veen over vesamtich ligon olam mesos dor vador
Veyanakte chalev goyim veshod melachim tinaki veyadaatte ki ani Adonai moshiech vegoalech avir yaakov
Tachat hannechoshet avi zahav vetachat habbarzel avi chesef vetachat haetzim nechoshet vetachat haavanim barzel vesamti fekuddatech shalom venogsayich tzedaka
Lo-yishshama od chamas beartzech shod vashever bigvulayich vekarat yeshua chomotayich usharayich tehilla
Lo-yihye-lach od hashshemesh leor yomam ulnogah hayyareach lo-yair lach vehaya-lach Adonai leor olam velohayich letifartech
Lo-yavo od shimshech virechech lo yeasef ki Adonai yihye-lach leor olam veshalmu yeme evlech
Veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer
Hakkaton yihye laelef vehatztzair legoy atzum ani Adonai beittah achishenna
Ruach adonay Adonai alay yaan mashach Adonai oti levasser anavim shelachani lachavosh lenishbere-lev likro lishvuyim deror velaasurim pekach-koach
Likro shenat-ratzon la-Adonai veom nakam lelohenu lenachem kal-avelim
Lasum laavele tziyyon latet lahem peer tachat efer shemen sason tachat evel maate tehilla tachat ruach keha vekora lahem ele hatztzedek matta Adonai lehitpaer
Uvanu charvot olam shommot rishonim yekomemu vechiddeshu are chorev shommot dor vador
Veamdu zarim verau tzonchem uvne nechar ikkarechem vechormechem
Veattem kohane Adonai tikkareu mesharte elohenu yeamer lachem chel goyim tochelu uvichvodam tityammaru
Tachat bashtechem mishne uchlimma yaronnu chelkam lachen beartzam mishne yirashu simchat olam tihye lahem
Ki ani Adonai ohev mishpat sone gazel beola venatatti feullatam beemet uvrit olam echrot lahem
Venoda baggoyim zaram vetzeetzaehem betoch haammim kal-roehem yakkirum ki hem zera berach Adonai
Sos asis ba-Adonai tagel nafshi belohay ki hilbishani bigde-yesha meil tzedaka yeatani kechatan yechahen peer vechakkalla tade cheleha
Ki chaaretz totzi tzimchah uchganna zerueha tatzmiach ken adonay Adonai yatzmiach tzedaka uthilla neged kal-haggoyim
Lemaan tziyyon lo echeshe ulmaan yerushalam lo eshkot ad-yetze channogah tzidkah vishuatah kelappid yivar
Verau goyim tzidkech vechal-melachim kevodech vekora lach shem chadash asher pi Adonai yikkovennu
Vehayit ateret tiferet beyad-Adonai utznif melucha bechaf-elohayich
Lo-yeamer lach od azuva ulartzech lo-yeamer od shemama ki lach yikkare cheftzi-vah ulartzech beula ki-chafetz Adonai bach veartzech tibbael
Ki-yival bachur betula yivaluch banayich umsos chatan al-kalla yasis alayich elohayich
Al-chomotayich yerushalam hifkadti shomrim kal-hayyom vechal-hallayela tamid lo yecheshu hammazkirim et-Adonai al-domi lachem
Veal-tittenu domi lo ad-yechonen vead-yasim et-yerushalam tehilla baaretz
Nishba Adonai bimino uvizroa uzzo im-etten et-deganech od maachal leoyevayich veim-yishtu vene-nechar tiroshech asher yagaatte bo
Ki measfav yochluhu vehillu et-Adonai umkabbetzav yishtuhu bechatzrot kadshi
Ivru ivru bashshearim pannu derech haam sollu sollu hamsilla sakkelu meeven harimu nes al-haammim
Hinne Adonai hishmia el-ketze haaretz imru levat-tziyyon hinne yishech ba hinne secharo itto ufullato lefanav
Vekaru lahem am-hakkodesh geule Adonai velach yikkare derusha ir lo neezava
Mi-ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra ze hadur bilvusho tzoe berov kocho ani medabber bitzdaka rav lehoshia
Maddua adom lilvushecha uvgadecha kedorech begat
Pura darachti levaddi umeammim en-ish itti veedrechem beappi veermesem bachamati veyez nitzcham al-begaday vechal-malbushay egalti
Ki yom nakam belibbi ushnat geulay baa
Veabbit veen ozer veeshtomem veen somech vattosha li zeroi vachamati hi semachatni
Veavus ammim beappi vaashakkerem bachamati veorid laaretz nitzcham
Chasde Adonai azkir tehillot Adonai keal kol asher-gemalanu Adonai verav-tuv levet yisrael asher-gemalam kerachamav uchrov chasadav
Vayyomer ach-ammi hemma banim lo yeshakkeru vayehi lahem lemoshia
Bechal-tzaratam lo tzar umalach panav hoshiam beahavato uvchemlato hu gealam vayenattelem vayenasseem kal-yeme olam
Vehemma maru veitztzevu et-ruach kadsho vayyehafech lahem leoyev hu nilcham-bam
Vayyizkor yeme-olam moshe ammo ayye hammaalem miyyam et roe tzono ayye hassam bekirbo et-ruach kadsho
Molich limin moshe zeroa tifarto bokea mayim mippenehem laasot lo shem olam
Molicham battehomot kassus bammidbar lo yikkashelu
Kabbehema babbika tered ruach Adonai tenichennu ken nihagta ammecha laasot lecha shem tifaret
Habbet mishshamayim ure mizzevul kadshecha vetifartecha ayye kinatcha ugvurotecha hamon meecha verachamecha elay hitappaku
Ki-atta avinu ki avraham lo yedaanu veyisrael lo yakkiranu atta Adonai avinu goalenu meolam shemecha
Lamma tatenu Adonai midderachecha takshiach libbenu miyyiratecha shuv lemaan avadecha shivte nachalatecha
Lammitzar yarshu am-kadshecha tzarenu bossu mikdashecha
Hayinu meolam lo-mashalta bam lo-nikra shimcha alehem lu-karata shamayim yaradta mippanecha harim nazollu
Kikdoach esh hamasim mayim tive-esh lehodia shimcha letzarecha mippanecha goyim yirgazu
Baasotcha noraot lo nekave yaradta mippanecha harim nazollu
Umeolam lo-shamu lo heezinu ayin lo-raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke-lo
Pagata et-sas veose tzedek bidrachecha yizkerucha hen-atta katzafta vannecheta bahem olam venivashea
Vannehi chattame kullanu uchveged iddim kal-tzidkotenu vannavel keale kullanu vaaonenu karuach yissaunu
Veen-kore veshimcha mitorer lehachazik bach ki-histarta fanecha mimmennu vattemugenu beyad-aonenu
Veatta Adonai avinu atta anachnu hachomer veatta yotzrenu umaase yadcha kullanu
Al-tiktzof Adonai ad-meod veal-laad tizkor aon hen habbet-na ammecha chullanu
Are kadshecha hau midbar tziyyon midbar hayata yerushalam shemama
Bet kadshenu vetifartenu asher hillucha avotenu haya lisrefat esh vechal-machamaddenu haya lecharba
Haal-elle titappak Adonai techeshe utannenu ad-meod
Nidrashti lelo shaalu nimtzeti lelo vikshuni amarti hinneni hinneni el-goy lo-kora vishmi
Perasti yaday kal-hayyom el-am sorer haholchim hadderech lo-tov achar machshevotehem
Haam hammachisim oti al-panay tamid zovchim baggannot umkatterim al-hallevenim
Hayyoshvim bakkevarim uvannetzurim yalinu haochlim besar hachazir umrak piggulim kelehem
Haomrim kerav elecha al-tiggash-bi ki kedashticha elle ashan beappi esh yokedet kal-hayyom
Hinne chetuva lefanay lo echese ki im-shillamti veshillamti al-chekam
Aonotechem vaaonot avotechem yachdav amar Adonai asher kitteru al-heharim veal-haggevaot cherfuni umaddoti feullatam rishona l-el- chekam
Ko amar Adonai kaasher yimmatze hattirosh baeshkol veamar al-tashchitehu ki veracha bo ken eese lemaan avaday levilti hashchit hakkol
Vehotzeti miyyaakov zera umihuda yoresh haray vireshuha vechiray vaavaday yishkenu-shamma
Vehaya hashsharon linve-tzon veemek achor lerevetz bakar leammi asher derashuni
Veattem ozve Adonai hashshechechim et-har kadshi haorchim laggad shulchan vehammalim lamni mimsach
Umaniti etchem lacherev vechullechem lattevach tichrau yaan karati velo anitem dibbarti velo shematem vattaasu hara beenay uvaasher lo-chafatzti bechartem
Lachen ko-amar adonay Adonai hinne avaday yochelu veattem tiravu hinne avaday yishtu veattem titzmau hinne avaday yismachu veattem tevoshu
Hinne avaday yaronnu mittuv lev veattem titzaku mikkeev lev umishshever ruach teyelilu
Vehinnachtem shimchem lishvua livchiray vehemitcha adonay Adonai velaavadav yikra shem acher
Asher hammitbarech baaretz yitbarech belohe amen vehannishba baaretz yishshava belohe amen ki nishkechu hatztzarot harishonot vechi nisteru meenay
Ki-hinni vore shamayim chadashim vaaretz chadasha velo tizzacharna harishonot velo taalena al-lev
Ki-im-sisu vegilu ade-ad asher ani vore ki hinni vore et-yerushalam gila veammah masos
Vegalti virushalam vesasti veammi velo-yishshama bah od kol bechi vekol zeaka
Lo-yihye mishsham od ul yamim vezaken asher lo-yemalle et-yamav ki hannaar ben-mea shana yamut vehachote ben-mea shana yekullal
Uvanu vattim veyashavu venatu cheramim veachlu piryam
Lo yivnu veacher yeshev lo yitteu veacher yochel ki-chime haetz yeme ammi umaase yedehem yevallu vechiray
Lo yigu larik velo yeldu labbehala ki zera beruche Adonai hemma vetzeetzaehem ittam
Vehaya terem-yikrau vaani eene od hem medabberim vaani eshma
Zeev vetale yiru cheechad vearye kabbakar yochal-teven venachash afar lachmo lo-yareu velo-yashchitu bechal-har kadshi amar Adonai
Ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay e-ze vayit asher tivnu-li vee-ze makom menuchati
Veet-kal-elle yadi asata vayyihu chal-elle neum-Adonai veel-ze abbit el-ani unche-ruach vechared al-devari
Shochet hashshor makke-ish zoveach hasse oref kelev maale mincha dam-chazir mazkir levona mevarech aven gam-hemma bacharu bedarchehem uvshikkutzehem nafsham chafetza
Gam-ani evchar betaalulehem umgurotam avi lahem yaan karati veen one dibbarti velo shameu vayyaasu hara beenay uvaasher lo-chafatzti bacharu
Shimu devar-Adonai hacharedim el-devaro amru achechem sonechem menaddechem lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai venire vesimchatchem vehem yevoshu
Kol shaon meir kol mehechal kol Adonai meshallem gemul leoyevav
Beterem tachil yalada beterem yavo chevel lah vehimlita zachar
Mi-shama kazot mi raa kaelle hauchal eretz beom echad im-yivaled goy paam echat ki-chala gam-yalda tziyyon et-baneha
Haani ashbir velo olid yomar Adonai im-ani hammolid veatzarti amar elohayich
Simchu et-yerushalam vegilu vah kal-ohaveha sisu ittah masos kal-hammitabbelim aleha
Lemaan tinku usvatem mishshod tanchumeha lemaan tamotztzu vehitannagtem mizziz kevodah
Ki-cho amar Adonai hinni note-eleha kenahar shalom uchnachal shotef kevod goyim vinaktem al-tzad tinnaseu veal-birkayim teshaoshau
Keish asher immo tenachamennu ken anochi anachemchem uvirushalam tenuchamu
Uritem vesas libbechem veatzmotechem kaddeshe tifrachna venoda yad-Adonai et-avadav vezaam et-oyevav
Ki-hinne Adonai baesh yavo vechassufa markevotav lehashiv bechema appo vegaarato belahave-esh
Ki vaesh Adonai nishpat uvcharbo et-kal-basar verabbu challe Adonai
Hammitkaddeshim vehammittaharim el-haggannot achar achat battavech ochle besar hachazir vehashsheketz vehaachbar yachdav yasufu neum-Adonai
Veanochi maasehem umachshevotehem baa lekabbetz et-kal-haggoyim vehalleshonot uvau verau et-kevodi
Vesamti vahem ot veshillachti mehem peletim el-haggoyim tarshish pul velud moshche keshet tuval veyavan haiyyim harchokim asher lo-shamu et-shimi velo-rau et-kevodi vehiggidu et-kevodi baggoyim

Veheviu et-kal-achechem mikkal-haggoyim mincha la-Adonai bassusim uvarechev uvatztzabbim uvapperadim uvakkirkarot al har kadshi yerushalam amar Adonai kaasher yaviu vene yisrael et-hammincha bichli tahor bet Adonai
Vegam-mehem ekkach lakkohanim lalviyyim amar Adonai
Ki chaasher hashshamayim hachodashim vehaaretz hachadasha asher ani ose omdim lefanay neum-Adonai ken yaamod zarachem veshimchem
Vehaya midde-chodesh bechadsho umidde shabbat beshabbatto yavo chal-basar lehishtachaot lefanay amar Adonai
Veyatzu verau befigre haanashim happoshim bi ki tolatam lo tamut veishsham lo tichbe vehau deraon lechal-basar
Jeremiah: Divre yirmeyahu ben-chilkiyyahu min-hakkohanim asher baanatot beeretz binyamin
Asher haya devar-Adonai elav bime yoshiyyahu ven-amon melech yehuda bishlosh-esre shana lemalcho
Vayehi bime yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda ad-tom ashte esre shana letzidkiyyahu ven-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda ad-gelot yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi
Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor
Beterem etztzarcha vabbeten yedaticha uvterem tetze merechem hikdashticha navi laggoyim netatticha
Vaomar ahah adonay Adonai hinne lo-yadati dabber ki-naar anochi
Vayyomer Adonai elay al-tomar naar anochi ki al-kal-asher eshlachacha telech veet kal-asher atzavvecha tedabber
Al-tira mippenehem ki-ittecha ani lehatztzilecha neum-Adonai
Vayyishlach Adonai et-yado vayyagga al-pi vayyomer Adonai elay hinne natatti devaray beficha
Ree hifkadticha hayyom hazze al-haggoyim veal-hammamlachot lintosh velintotz ulhaavid velaharos livnot velintoa
Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor ma-atta roe yirmeyahu vaomar makkel shaked ani roe
Vayyomer Adonai elay hetavta lirot ki-shoked ani al-devari laasoto
Vayehi devar-Adonai elay shenit lemor ma atta roe vaomar sir nafuach ani roe ufanav mippene tzafona
Vayyomer Adonai elay mitztzafon tippatach haraa al kal-yoshve haaretz
Ki hinni kore lechal-mishpechot mamlechot tzafona neum-Adonai uvau venatnu ish kiso petach shaare yerushalam veal kal-chomoteha saviv veal kal-are yehuda
Vedibbarti mishpatay otam al kal-raatam asher azavuni vayekatteru lelohim acherim vayyishtachau lemaase yedehem
Veatta tezor matnecha vekamta vedibbarta alehem et kal-asher anochi atzavekka al-techat mippenehem pen-achittecha lifnehem
Vaani hinne netatticha hayyom leir mivtzar ulammud barzel ulchomot nechoshet al-kal-haaretz lemalche yehuda lesareha lechohaneha ulam haaretz
Venilchamu elecha velo-yuchlu lach ki-ittecha ani neum-Adonai lehatztzilecha
Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor
Haloch vekarata veazne yerushalam lemor ko amar Adonai zacharti lach chesed neurayich ahavat kelulotayich lechtech acharay bammidbar beeretz lo zerua
Kodesh yisrael la-Adonai reshit tevuato kal-ochlav yeshamu raa tavo alehem neum-Adonai
Shimu devar-Adonai bet yaakov vechal-mishpechot bet yisrael
Ko amar Adonai ma-matzu avotechem bi avel ki rachaku mealay vayyelchu achare hahevel vayyehbalu
Velo amru ayye Adonai hammaale otanu meeretz mitzrayim hammolich otanu bammidbar beeretz arava veshucha beeretz tziyya vetzalmavet beeretz lo-avar bah ish velo-yashav adam sham
Vaavi etchem el-eretz hakkarmel leechol piryah vetuvah vattavou vattetammeu et-artzi venachalati samtem letoeva
Hakkohanim lo amru ayye Adonai vetofse hattora lo yedauni veharoim pashu vi vehanneviim nibbeu vabbaal veachare lo-yoilu halachu
Lachen od ariv ittechem neum-Adonai veet-bene venechem ariv
Ki ivru iyye chittiyyim uru vekedar shilchu vehitbonnu meod uru hen hayeta kazot
Hahemir goy elohim vehemma lo elohim veammi hemir kevodo belo yoil
Shommu shamayim al-zot vesaaru charvu meod neum-Adonai
Ki-shettayim raot asa ammi oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim lachtzov lahem borot borot nishbarim asher lo-yachilu hammayim
Haeved yisrael im-yelid bayit hu maddua haya lavaz
Alav yishagu chefirim natnu kolam vayyashitu artzo leshamma arav nitztzetu mibbeli yoshev
Gam-bene-nof vetachpanches yiruch kadkod
Halo-zot taase-lach azvech et-Adonai elohayich beet molichech baddarech
Veatta ma-lach lederech mitzrayim lishtot me shichor uma-lach lederech ashshur lishtot me nahar
Teyasserech raatech umshuvotayich tochichuch udi uri ki-ra vamar azvech et-Adonai elohayich velo fachdati elayich neum-adonay Adonai tzevaot
Ki meolam shavarti ullech nittakti mosrotayich vattomri lo eevor ki al-kal-giva gevoha vetachat kal-etz raanan atte tzoa zona
Veanochi netatich sorek kullo zera emet veech nehpachte li sure haggefen nachriyya
Ki im-techabbesi banneter vetarbi-lach borit nichtam aonech lefanay neum adonay Adonai
Ech tomri lo nitmeti achare habbealim lo halachti rei darkech baggaye dei me asit bichra kalla mesarechet deracheha
Pere limmud midbar beavat nafshah shaafa ruach taanatah mi yeshivenna kal-mevaksheha lo yiafu bechadshah yimtzaunha
Mini raglech miyyachef ugronech mitztzima vattomri noash lo ki-ahavti zarim veacharehem elech
Kevoshet gannav ki yimmatze ken hovishu bet yisrael hemma malchehem sarehem vechohanehem unviehem
Omrim laetz avi atta velaeven atte yelidtanu ki-fanu elay oref velo fanim uvet raatam yomru kuma vehoshienu
Veayye elohecha asher asita lach yakumu im-yoshiucha beet raatecha ki mispar arecha hau elohecha yehuda
Lamma tarivu elay kullechem peshatem bi neum-Adonai
Lashshave hikketi et-benechem musar lo lakachu achla charbechem neviechem kearye mashchit
Haddor attem reu devar-Adonai hamidbar hayiti leyisrael im eretz mapelya maddua amru ammi radnu lo-navo od elecha
Hatishkach betula edyah kalla kishshureha veammi shechechuni yamim en mispar
Ma-tetivi darkech levakkesh ahava lachen gam et-haraot limmadte et-derachayich
Gam bichnafayich nimtzeu dam nafshot evonim nekiyyim lo-vammachteret metzatim ki al-kal-elle
Vattomri ki nikketi ach shav appo mimmenni hinni nishpat otach al-amrech lo chatati
Ma-tezli meod leshannot et-darkech gam mimmitzrayim tevoshi kaasher-boshte meashshur
Gam meet ze tetzi veyadayich al-roshech ki-maas Adonai bemivtachayich velo tatzlichi lahem
