Hachayyotzer hazze lo-uchal laasot lachem bet yisrael neum-Adonai hinne chachomer beyad hayyotzer ken-attem beyadi bet yisrael
Rega adabber al-goy veal-mamlacha lintosh velintotz ulhaavid
Veshav haggoy hahu meraato asher dibbarti alav venichamti al-haraa asher chashavti laasot lo
Verega adabber al-goy veal-mamlacha livnot velintoa
Veasa hara beenay levilti shemoa bekoli venichamti al-hattova asher amarti lehetiv oto
Veatta emar-na el-ish-yehuda veal-yoshve yerushalam lemor ko amar Adonai hinne anochi yotzer alechem raa vechoshev alechem machashava shuvu na ish middarko haraa vehetivu darchechem umaallechem
Veamru noash ki-achare machshevotenu nelech veish sherirut libbo-hara naase
Lachen ko amar Adonai shaalu-na baggoyim mi shama kaelle shaarurit asta meod betulat yisrael
Hayaazov mitztzur saday sheleg levanon im-yinnatshu mayim zarim karim nozlim
Ki-shechechuni ammi lashshave yekatteru vayyachshilum bedarchehem shevile olam lalechet netivot derech lo selula
Lasum artzam leshamma sherikot olam kol over aleha yishshom veyanid berosho
Keruach-kadim afitzem lifne oyev oref velo-fanim erem beom edam
Vayyomru lechu venachsheva al-yirmeyahu machashavot ki lo-tovad tora mikkohen veetza mechacham vedavar minnavi lechu venakkehu vallashon veal-nakshiva el-kal-devarav
Hakshiva Adonai elay ushma lekol yerivay
Hayeshullam tachat-tova raa ki-charu shucha lenafshi zechor amdi lefanecha ledabber alehem tova lehashiv et-chamatcha mehem
Lachen ten et-benehem laraav vehaggirem al-yede-cherev vetihyena neshehem shakkulot vealmanot veanshehem yihu haruge mavet bachurehem mukke-cherev bammilchama
Tishshama zeaka mibbattehem ki-tavi alehem gedud pitom ki-charu shucha lelachdeni ufachim tamnu leraglay
Veatta Adonai yadata et-kal-atzatam alay lammavet al-techapper al-aonam vechattatam millefanecha al-temchi veyihu muchshalim lefanecha beet appecha ase vahem
Ko amar Adonai haloch vekanita vakbuk yotzer chares umizzikne haam umizzikne hakkohanim
Veyatzata el-ge ven-hinnom asher petach shaar hacharsit vekarata sham et-haddevarim asher-adabber elecha
Veamarta shimu devar-Adonai malche yehuda veyoshve yerushalam ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni mevi raa al-hammakom hazze asher kal-shomah titztzalna aznav
Yaan asher azavuni vayenakkeru et-hammakom hazze vayekatteru-vo lelohim acherim asher lo-yedaum hemma vaavotehem umalche yehuda umalu et-hammakom hazze dam nekiyyim
Uvanu et-bamot habbaal lisrof et-benehem baesh olot labbaal asher lo-tziviti velo dibbarti velo alta al-libbi
Lachen hinne-yamim baim neum-Adonai velo-yikkare lammakom hazze od hattofet vege ven-hinnom ki im-ge haharega
Uvakkoti et-atzat yehuda virushalam bammakom hazze vehippaltim bacherev lifne oyevehem uvyad mevakshe nafsham venatatti et-nivlatam lemaachal leof hashshamayim ulvehemat haaretz
Vesamti et-hair hazzot leshamma velishreka kol over aleha yishshom veyishrok al-kal-makkoteha
Vehaachaltim et-besar benehem veet besar benotehem veish besar-reehu yochelu bematzor uvmatzok asher yatziku lahem oyevehem umvakshe nafsham
Veshavarta habbakbuk leene haanashim haholchim otach
Veamarta alehem ko-amar Adonai tzevaot kacha eshbor et-haam hazze veet-hair hazzot kaasher yishbor et-keli hayyotzer asher lo-yuchal leherafe od uvtofet yikberu meen makom likbor
Ken-eese lammakom hazze neum-Adonai uloshvav velatet et-hair hazzot ketofet
Vehau batte yerushalam uvatte malche yehuda kimkom hattofet hattemeim lechol habbattim asher kitteru al-gaggotehem lechol tzeva hashshamayim vehassech nesachim lelohim acherim
Vayyavo yirmeyahu mehattofet asher shelacho Adonai sham lehinnave vayyaamod bachatzar bet-Adonai vayyomer el-kal-haam
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni mevi el-hair hazzot veal-kal-areha et kal-haraa asher dibbarti aleha ki hikshu et-arpam levilti shemoa et-devaray
Vayyishma pashchur ben-immer hakkohen vehu-fakid nagid bevet Adonai et-yirmeyahu nibba et-haddevarim haelle
Vayyakke fashchur et yirmeyahu hannavi vayyitten oto al-hammahpechet asher beshaar binyamin haelon asher bevet Adonai
Vayehi mimmachorat vayyotze fashchur et-yirmeyahu min-hammahpachet vayyomer elav yirmeyahu lo fashchur kara Adonai shemecha ki im-magor missaviv
Ki cho amar Adonai hinni notencha lemagor lecha ulchal-ohavecha venaflu becherev oyevehem veenecha root veet-kal-yehuda etten beyad melech-bavel vehiglam bavela vehikkam becharev
Venatatti et-kal-chosen hair hazzot veet-kal-yegiah veet-kal-yekarah veet kal-otzrot malche yehuda etten beyad oyevehem uvzazum ulkachum vehevium bavela
Veatta fashchur vechol yoshve vetecha telchu bashshevi uvavel tavo vesham tamut vesham tikkaver atta vechal-ohavecha asher-nibbeta lahem bashshaker
Pittitani Adonai vaeppat chazaktani vattuchal hayiti lischok kal-hayyom kullo loeg li
Ki-midde adabber ezak chamas vashod ekra ki-haya devar-Adonai li lecherpa ulkeles kal-hayyom
Veamarti lo-ezkerennu velo-adabber od bishmo vehaya velibbi keesh boeret atzur beatzmotay venileti kalchel velo uchal
Ki shamati dibbat rabbim magor missaviv haggidu venaggidennu kol enosh shelomi shomre tzali ulay yefutte venuchla lo venikcha nikmatenu mimmennu
Va-Adonai oti kegibbor aritz al-ken rodfay yikkashlu velo yuchalu boshu meod ki-lo hiskilu kelimmat olam lo tishshacheach
Va-Adonai tzevaot bochen tzaddik roe chelaot valev ere nikmatcha mehem ki elecha gilliti et-rivi
Shiru la-Adonai hallu et-Adonai ki hitztzil et-nefesh evon miyyad mereim
Arur hayyom asher yulladti bo yom asher-yeladatni immi al-yehi varuch
Arur haish asher bissar et-avi lemor yullad-lecha ben zachar sammeach simmochahu
Vehaya haish hahu kearim asher-hafach Adonai velo nicham veshama zeaka babboker utrua beet tzahorayim
Asher lo-mottani merachem vattehi-li immi kivri verachma harat olam
Lamma ze merechem yatzati lirot amal veyagon vayyichlu bevoshet yamay
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai bishloach elav hammelech tzidkiyyahu et-pashchur ben-malkiyya veet-tzefanya ven-maaseya hakkohen lemor
Derash-na vaadenu et-Adonai ki nevuchadretzar melech-bavel nilcham alenu ulay yaase Adonai otanu kechal-nifleotav veyaale mealenu
Vayyomer yirmeyahu alehem ko tomrun el-tzidkiyyahu

Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael hinni mesev et-kele hammilchama asher beyedchem asher attem nilchamim bam et-melech bavel veet-hakkasdim hatztzarim alechem michutz lachoma veasafti otam el-toch hair hazzot
Venilchamti ani ittechem beyad netuya uvizroa chazaka uvaf uvchema uvketzef gadol
Vehikketi et-yoshve hair hazzot veet-haadam veet-habbehema bedever gadol yamutu

Veachare-chen neum-Adonai etten et-tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda veet-avadav veet-haam veet-hannisharim bair hazzot min-haddever min-hacherev umin-haraav beyad nevuchadretzar melech-bavel uvyad oyevehem uvyad mevakshe nafsham vehikkam lefi-cherev lo-yachus alehem velo yachmol velo yerachem
Veel-haam hazze tomar ko amar Adonai hinni noten lifnechem et-derech hachayyim veet-derech hammavet
Hayyoshev bair hazzot yamut bacherev uvaraav uvaddaver vehayyotze venafal al-hakkasdim hatztzarim alechem vechaya vehayeta-lo nafsho leshalal
Ki samti fanay bair hazzot leraa velo letova neum-Adonai beyad-melech bavel tinnaten usrafah baesh
Ulvet melech yehuda shimu devar-Adonai
Bet david ko amar Adonai dinu labboker mishpat vehatztzilu gazul miyyad oshek pen-tetze chaesh chamati uvaara veen mechabbe mippene roa maallechem
Hinni elayich yoshevet haemek tzur hammishor neum-Adonai haomrim mi-yechat alenu umi yavo bimonotenu
Ufakadti alechem kifri maallechem neum-Adonai vehitztzatti esh beyarah veachla kal-seviveha
Ko amar Adonai red bet-melech yehuda vedibbarta sham et-haddavar hazze
Veamarta shema devar-Adonai melech yehuda hayyoshev al-kisse david atta vaavadecha veammecha habbaim bashshearim haelle
Ko amar Adonai asu mishpat utzdaka vehatztzilu gazul miyyad ashok veger yatom vealmana al-tonu al-tachmosu vedam naki al-tishpechu bammakom hazze
Ki im-aso taasu et-haddavar hazze uvau veshaare habbayit hazze melachim yoshvim ledavid al-kiso rochvim barechev uvassusim hu vaavadav veammo
Veim lo tishmeu et-haddevarim haelle bi nishbati neum-Adonai ki-lecharba yihye habbayit hazze
Ki-cho amar Adonai al-bet melech yehuda gilad atta li rosh hallevanon im-lo ashitcha midbar arim lo noshavu
Vekiddashti alecha mashchitim ish vechelav vechartu mivchar arazecha vehippilu al-haesh
Veavru goyim rabbim al hair hazzot veamru ish el-reehu al-me asa Adonai kacha lair haggedola hazzot
Veamru al asher azvu et-berit Adonai elohehem vayyishtachau lelohim acherim vayyaavdum
Al-tivku lemet veal-tanudu lo bechu vacho laholech ki lo yashuv od veraa et-eretz moladto
Ki cho amar-Adonai el-shallum ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda hammolech tachat yoshiyyahu aviv asher yatza min-hammakom hazze lo-yashuv sham od
Ki bimkom asher-higlu oto sham yamut veet-haaretz hazzot lo-yire od
Hoy bone veto belo-tzedek vaaliyyotav belo mishpat bereehu yaavod chinnam ufoalo lo yitten-lo
Haomer evne-li bet middot vaaliyyot meruvachim vekara lo challonay vesafun baarez umashoach bashshashar
Hatimloch ki atta metachare vaarez avicha halo achal veshata veasa mishpat utzdaka az tov lo
Dan din-ani veevon az tov halo-hi haddaat oti neum-Adonai
Ki en enecha velibbecha ki im-al-bitzecha veal dam-hannaki lishpoch veal-haoshek veal-hammerutza laasot
Lachen ko-amar Adonai el-yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda lo-yispedu lo hoy achi vehoy achot lo-yispedu lo hoy adon vehoy hodo
Kevurat chamor yikkaver sachov vehashlech mehala leshaare yerushalam
Ali hallevanon utzaki uvabbashan teni kolech vetzaaki meavarim ki nishberu kal-meahavayich
Dibbarti elayich beshalotayich amarte lo eshma ze darkech minneurayich ki lo-shamaatte bekoli
Kal-roayich tire-ruach umahavayich bashshevi yelechu ki az tevoshi venichlamte mikkol raatech
Yoshavte ballevanon mekunnante baarazim ma-nechante bevo-lach chavalim chil kayyoleda
Chay-ani neum-Adonai ki im-yihye kanyahu ven-yehoyakim melech yehuda chotam al-yad yemini ki mishsham ettekenka
Untatticha beyad mevakshe nafshecha uvyad asher-atta yagor mippenehem uvyad nevuchadretzar melech-bavel uvyad hakkasdim
Vehetalti otcha veet-immecha asher yeladatcha al haaretz acheret asher lo-yulladtem sham vesham tamutu
Veal-haaretz asher-hem menasseim et-nafsham lashuv sham shamma lo yashuvu
Haetzev nivze nafutz haish hazze kanyahu im-keli en chefetz bo maddua hutalu hu vezaro vehushlechu al-haaretz asher lo-yadau
Eretz eretz aretz shimi devar-Adonai
Ko amar Adonai kitvu et-haish hazze ariri gever lo-yitzlach beyamav ki lo yitzlach mizzaro ish yoshev al-kisse david umoshel od bihuda
Hoy roim meabbedim umfitzim et-tzon mariti neum-Adonai
Lachen ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael al-haroim haroim et-ammi attem hafitzotem et-tzoni vattaddichum velo fekadtem otam hinni foked alechem et-roa maallechem neum-Adonai
Vaani akabbetz et-sheerit tzoni mikkol haaratzot asher-hiddachti otam sham vahashivoti ethen al-nevehen ufaru veravu
Vahakimoti alehem roim veraum velo-yiru od velo-yechattu velo yippakedu neum-Adonai
Hinne yamim baim neum-Adonai vahakimoti ledavid tzemach tzaddik umalach melech vehiskil veasa mishpat utzdaka baaretz
Beyamav tivasha yehuda veyisrael yishkon lavetach veze-shemo asher-yikreo Adonai tzidkenu
Lachen hinne-yamim baim neum-Adonai velo-yomru od chay-Adonai asher heela et-bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim
Ki im-chay-Adonai asher heela vaasher hevi et-zera bet yisrael meeretz tzafona umikkol haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham veyashvu al-admatam
Lanneviim nishbar libbi vekirbi rachafu kal-atzmotay hayiti keish shikkor uchgever avaro yayin mippene Adonai umippene divre kadsho
Ki menaafim mala haaretz ki-mippene ala avla haaretz yavshu neot midbar vattehi merutzatam raa ugvuratam lo-chen
Ki-gam-navi gam-kohen chanefu gam-beveti matzati raatam neum-Adonai
Lachen yihye darkam lahem kachalaklakkot baafela yiddachu venaflu vah ki-avi alehem raa shenat pekuddatam neum-Adonai
Uvinvie shomron raiti tifla hinnabbeu vabbaal vayyatu et-ammi et-yisrael
Uvinvie yerushalam raiti shaarura naof vehaloch bashsheker vechizzeku yede mereim levilti-shavu ish meraato hau-li chullam kisdom veyoshveha kaamora
Lachen ko-amar Adonai tzevaot al-hanneviim hinni maachil otam laana vehishkitim me-rosh ki meet nevie yerushalam yatza chanuppa lechal-haaretz
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot al-tishmeu al-divre hanneviim hannibbeim lachem mahbilim hemma etchem chazon libbam yedabberu lo mippi Adonai
Omrim amor limnaatzay dibber Adonai shalom yihye lachem vechol holech bishrirut libbo amru lo-tavo alechem raa
Ki mi amad besod Adonai veyere veyishma et-devaro mi-hikshiv devaro vayyishma
Hinne saarat Adonai chema yatza vesaar mitcholel al rosh reshaim yachul
Lo yashuv af-Adonai ad-asoto vead-hakimo mezimmot libbo beacharit hayyamim titbonnu vah bina
Lo-shalachti et-hanneviim vehem ratzu lo-dibbarti alehem vehem nibbau
Veim-amdu besodi veyashmiu devaray et-ammi vishivum middarkam hara umeroa maallehem
Haelohe mikkarov ani neum-Adonai velo elohe merachok
Im-yissater ish bammistarim vaani lo-erennu neum-Adonai halo et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz ani male neum-Adonai
Shamati et asher-amru hanneviim hannibbeim bishmi sheker lemor chalamti chalamti
Ad-matay hayesh belev hanneviim nibbee hashshaker unvie tarmit libbam
Hachoshvim lehashkiach et-ammi shemi bachalomotam asher yesapperu ish lereehu kaasher shachchu avotam et-shemi babbaal
Hannavi asher-itto chalom yesapper chalom vaasher devari itto yedabber devari emet ma-latteven et-habbar neum-Adonai
Halo cho devari kaesh neum-Adonai uchfattish yefotzetz sala
Lachen hinni al-hanneviim neum-Adonai meganneve devaray ish meet reehu
Hinni al-hanneviim neum-Adonai hallokchim leshonam vayyinamu neum
Hinni al-nibbee chalomot sheker neum-Adonai vayesapperum vayyatu et-ammi beshikrehem uvfachazutam veanochi lo-shelachtim velo tzivitim vehoel lo-yoilu laam-hazze neum-Adonai
Vechi-yishalcha haam hazze o-hannavi o-chohen lemor ma-massa Adonai veamarta alehem et-ma-massa venatashti etchem neum-Adonai
Vehannavi vehakkohen vehaam asher yomar massa Adonai ufakadti al-haish hahu veal-beto
Ko tomru ish al-reehu veish el-achiv me-ana Adonai uma-dibber Adonai
Umassa Adonai lo tizkeru-od ki hammassa yihye leish devaro vahafachtem et-divre elohim chayyim Adonai tzevaot elohenu
Ko tomar el-hannavi me-anach Adonai uma-dibber Adonai
Veim-massa Adonai tomeru lachen ko amar Adonai yaan amarchem et-haddavar hazze massa Adonai vaeshlach alechem lemor lo tomru massa Adonai
Lachen hinni venashiti etchem nasho venatashti etchem veet-hair asher natatti lachem velaavotechem meal panay
Venatatti alechem cherpat olam uchlimmut olam asher lo tishshacheach

Hirani Adonai vehinne shene dudae teenim muadim lifne hechal Adonai achare haglot nevuchadretzar melech-bavel et-yechanyahu ven-yehoyakim melech-yehuda veet-sare yehuda veet-hecharash veet-hammasger mirushalam vayeviem bavel
Haddud echad teenim tovot meod kitene habbakkurot vehaddud echad teenim raot meod asher lo-teachalna meroa
Vayyomer Adonai elay ma-atta roe yirmeyahu vaomar teenim hatteenim hattovot tovot meod veharaot raot meod asher lo-teachalna meroa
Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael katteenim hattovot haelle ken-akkir et-galut yehuda asher shillachti min-hammakom hazze eretz kasdim letova
Vesamti eni alehem letova vahashivotim al-haaretz hazzot uvnitim velo eheros untatim velo ettosh
Venatatti lahem lev ladaat oti ki ani Adonai vehau-li leam veanochi ehye lahem lelohim ki-yashuvu elay bechal-libbam
Vechatteenim haraot asher lo-teachalna meroa ki-cho amar Adonai ken etten et-tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda veet-sarav veet sheerit yerushalam hannisharim baaretz hazzot vehayyoshvim beeretz mitzrayim
Untattim lezaava leraa lechol mamlechot haaretz lecherpa ulmashal lishnina veliklala bechal-hammekomot asher-addichem sham
Veshillachti vam et-hacherev et-haraav veet-haddaver ad-tummam meal haadama asher-natatti lahem velaavotehem
Haddavar asher-haya al-yirmeyahu al-kal-am yehuda bashshana harviit lihoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda hi hashshana harishonit linvuchadretzar melech bavel
Asher dibber yirmeyahu hannavi al-kal-am yehuda veel kal-yoshve yerushalam lemor
Min-shelosh esre shana leyoshiyyahu ven-amon melech yehuda vead hayyom hazze ze shalosh veesrim shana haya devar-Adonai elay vaadabber alechem ashkem vedabber velo shematem
Veshalach Adonai alechem et-kal-avadav hanneviim hashkem veshaloach velo shematem velo-hittitem et-aznechem lishmoa
Lemor shuvu-na ish middarko haraa umeroa maallechem ushvu al-haadama asher natan Adonai lachem velaavotechem lemin-olam vead-olam
Veal-telchu achare elohim acherim leavdam ulhishtachaot lahem velo-tachisu oti bemaase yedechem velo ara lachem
Velo-shematem elay neum-Adonai lemaan hachiseni bemaase yedechem lera lachem
Lachen ko amar Adonai tzevaot yaan asher lo-shematem et-devaray

Hinni sholeach velakachti et-kal-mishpechot tzafon neum-Adonai veel-nevuchadretzar melech-bavel avdi vahaviotim al-haaretz hazzot veal-yoshveha veal kal-haggoyim haelle saviv vehacharamtim vesamtim leshamma velishreka ulcharvot olam
Vehaavadti mehem kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol rechayim veor ner
Vehayeta kal-haaretz hazzot lecharba leshamma veavdu haggoyim haelle et-melech bavel shivim shana
Vehaya chimlot shivim shana efkod al-melech-bavel veal-haggoy hahu neum-Adonai et-aonam veal-eretz kasdim vesamti oto leshimmot olam
Veheveti al-haaretz hahi et-kal-devaray asher-dibbarti aleha et kal-hakkatuv bassefer hazze asher-nibba yirmeyahu al-kal-haggoyim
Ki avdu-vam gam-hemma goyim rabbim umlachim gedolim veshillamti lahem kefaolam uchmaase yedehem
Ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael elay kach et-kos hayyayin hachema hazzot miyyadi vehishkita oto et-kal-haggoyim asher anochi sholeach otcha alehem
Veshatu vehitgoashu vehitholalu mippene hacherev asher anochi sholeach benotam
Vaekkach et-hakkos miyyad Adonai vaashke et-kal-haggoyim asher-shelachani Adonai alehem
Et-yerushalam veet-are yehuda veet-melacheha et-sareha latet otam lecharba leshamma lishreka veliklala kayyom hazze
Et-paro melech-mitzrayim veet-avadav veet-sarav veet-kal-ammo
Veet kal-haerev veet kal-malche eretz hautz veet kal-malche eretz pelishtim veet-ashkelon veet-azza veet-ekron veet sheerit ashdod
Et-edom veet-moav veet-bene ammon
Veet kal-malche-tzor veet kal-malche tzidon veet malche hai asher beever hayyam
Veet-dedan veet-tema veet-buz veet kal-ketzutze fea
Veet kal-malche arav veet kal-malche haerev hashshochnim bammidbar
Veet kal-malche zimri veet kal-malche elam veet kal-malche maday
Veet kal-malche hatztzafon hakkerovim veharchokim ish el-achiv veet kal-hammamlechot haaretz asher al-pene haadama umelech sheshach yishte acharehem
Veamarta alehem s ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael shetu veshichru uku veniflu velo takumu mippene hacherev asher anochi sholeach benechem
Vehaya ki yemaanu lakachat-hakkos miyyadcha lishtot veamarta alehem ko amar Adonai tzevaot shato tishtu
Ki hinne vair asher nikra-shemi aleha anochi mechel lehara veattem hinnake tinnaku lo tinnaku ki cherev ani kore al-kal-yoshve haaretz neum Adonai tzevaot
Veatta tinnave alehem et kal-haddevarim haelle veamarta alehem Adonai mimmarom yishag umimmeon kadsho yitten kolo shaog yishag al-navehu hedad kedorchim yaane el kal-yoshve haaretz
Ba shaon ad-ketze haaretz ki riv la-Adonai baggoyim nishpat hu lechal-basar harshaim netanam lacherev neum-Adonai
Ko amar Adonai tzevaot hinne raa yotzet miggoy el-goy vesaar gadol yeor miyyarkete-aretz
Vehau challe Adonai bayyom hahu miktze haaretz vead-ketze haaretz lo yissafdu velo yeasfu velo yikkaveru ledomen al-pene haadama yihu
Helilu haroim vezaaku vehitpalleshu addire hatztzon ki-malu yemechem litvoach utfotzotichem unfaltem kichli chemda
Veavad manos min-haroim ufleta meaddire hatztzon
Kol tzaakat haroim villat addire hatztzon ki-shoded Adonai et-maritam
Venadammu neot hashshalom mippene charon af-Adonai
Azav kakkefir sukko ki-hayeta artzam leshamma mippene charon hayyona umippene charon appo
Bereshit mamlechut yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda haya haddavar hazze meet Adonai lemor
Ko amar Adonai amod bachatzar bet-Adonai vedibbarta al-kal-are yehuda habbaim lehishtachaot bet-Adonai et kal-haddevarim asher tziviticha ledabber alehem al-tigra davar
Ulay yishmeu veyashuvu ish middarko haraa venichamti el-haraa asher anochi choshev laasot lahem mippene roa maallehem
Veamarta alehem ko amar Adonai im-lo tishmeu elay lalechet betorati asher natatti lifnechem
Lishmoa al-divre avaday hanneviim asher anochi sholeach alechem vehashkem veshaloach velo shematem
Venatatti et-habbayit hazze keshilo veet-hair hazzot etten liklala lechol goye haaretz
Vayyishmeu hakkohanim vehanneviim vechal-haam et-yirmeyahu medabber et-haddevarim haelle bevet Adonai
Vayehi kechallot yirmeyahu ledabber et kal-asher-tziva Adonai ledabber el-kal-haam vayyitpesu oto hakkohanim vehanneviim vechal-haam lemor mot tamut
Maddua nibbeta veshem-Adonai lemor keshilo yihye habbayit hazze vehair hazzot techerav meen yoshev vayyikkahel kal-haam el-yirmeyahu bevet Adonai
Vayyishmeu sare yehuda et haddevarim haelle vayyaalu mibbet-hammelech bet Adonai vayyeshvu befetach shaar-Adonai hechadash
Vayyomru hakkohanim vehanneviim el-hassarim veel-kal-haam lemor mishpat-mavet laish hazze ki nibba el-hair hazzot kaasher shematem beaznechem
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-kal-hassarim veel-kal-haam lemor Adonai shelachani lehinnave el-habbayit hazze veel-hair hazzot et kal-haddevarim asher shematem
Veatta hetivu darchechem umaallechem veshimu bekol Adonai elohechem veyinnachem Adonai el-haraa asher dibber alechem
Vaani hinni veyedchem asu-li kattov vechayyashar beenechem
Ach yadoa tedu ki im-memitim attem oti ki-dam naki attem notnim alechem veel-hair hazzot veel-yoshveha ki veemet shelachani Adonai alechem ledabber beaznechem et kal-haddevarim haelle
Vayyomru hassarim vechal-haam el-hakkohanim veel-hanneviim en-laish hazze mishpat-mavet ki beshem Adonai elohenu dibber elenu
Vayyakumu anashim mizzikne haaretz vayyomru el-kal-kehal haam lemor
Micha hammorashti haya nibba bime chizkiyyahu melech-yehuda vayyomer el-kal-am yehuda lemor ko-amar Adonai tzevaot tziyyon sade techaresh virushalayim iyyim tihye vehar habbayit levamot yaar
Hehamet hemituhu chizkiyyahu melech-yehuda vechal-yehuda halo yare et-Adonai vayechal et-pene Adonai vayyinnachem Adonai el-haraa asher-dibber alehem vaanachnu osim raa gedola al-nafshotenu
Vegam-ish haya mitnabbe beshem Adonai uriyyahu ben-shemayahu mikkiryat hayearim vayyinnave al-hair hazzot veal-haaretz hazzot kechol divre yirmeyahu
Vayyishma hammelech-yehoyakim vechal-gibborav vechal-hassarim et-devarav vayevakkesh hammelech hamito vayyishma uriyyahu vayyira vayyivrach vayyavo mitzrayim
Vayyishlach hammelech yehoyakim anashim mitzrayim et elnatan ben-achbor vaanashim itto el-mitzrayim
Vayyotziu et-uriyyahu mimmitzrayim vayeviuhu el-hammelech yehoyakim vayyakkehu becharev vayyashlech et-nivlato el-kivre bene haam
Ach yad achikam ben-shafan hayeta et-yirmeyahu levilti tet-oto veyad-haam lahamito
Bereshit mamlechet yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda haya haddavar hazze el-yirmeya meet Adonai lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elay ase lecha moserot umotot untattam al-tzavarecha
Veshillachtam el-melech edom veel-melech moav veel-melech bene ammon veel-melech tzor veel-melech tzidon beyad malachim habbaim yerushalam el-tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda
Vetzivita otam el-adonehem lemor ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael ko tomru el-adonechem
Anochi asiti et-haaretz et-haadam veet-habbehema asher al-pene haaretz bechochi haggadol uvizroi hannetuya untattiha laasher yashar beenay
Veatta anochi natatti et-kal-haaratzot haelle beyad nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel avdi vegam et-chayyat hassade natatti lo leavdo
Veavdu oto kal-haggoyim veet-beno veet-ben-beno ad bo-et artzo gam-hu veavdu vo goyim rabbim umlachim gedolim

Vehaya haggoy vehammamlacha asher lo-yaavdu oto et-nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel veet asher lo-yitten et-tzavaro beol melech bavel bacherev uvaraav uvaddever efkod al-haggoy hahu neum-Adonai ad-tummi otam beyado
Veattem al-tishmeu el-neviechem veel-kosmechem veel chalomotechem veel-onnechem veel-kashshafechem asher-hem omrim alechem lemor lo taavdu et-melech bavel
Ki sheker hem nibbeim lachem lemaan harchik etchem meal admatchem vehiddachti etchem vaavadtem
Vehaggoy asher yavi et-tzavaro beol melech-bavel vaavado vehinnachtiv al-admato neum-Adonai vaavadah veyashav bah
Veel-tzidkiyya melech-yehuda dibbarti kechal-haddevarim haelle lemor haviu et-tzavverechem beol melech-bavel veivdu oto veammo vichu
Lamma tamutu atta veammecha bacherev baraav uvaddaver kaasher dibber Adonai el-haggoy asher lo-yaavod et-melech bavel
Veal-tishmeu el-divre hanneviim haomrim alechem lemor lo taavdu et-melech bavel ki sheker hem nibbeim lachem
Ki lo shelachtim neum-Adonai vehem nibbeim bishmi lashshaker lemaan haddichi etchem vaavadtem attem vehanneviim hannibbeim lachem

Veel-hakkohanim veel-kal-haam hazze dibbarti lemor ko amar Adonai al-tishmeu el-divre neviechem hannibbeim lachem lemor hinne chele vet-Adonai mushavim mibbavela atta mehera ki sheker hemma nibbeim lachem
Al-tishmeu alehem ivdu et-melech-bavel vichu lamma tihye hair hazzot charba
Veim-neviim hem veim-yesh devar-Adonai ittam yifgeu-na ba-Adonai tzevaot levilti-vou hakkelim hannotarim bevet-Adonai uvet melech yehuda uvirushalam bavela
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot el-haammudim veal-hayyam veal-hammechonot veal yeter hakkelim hannotarim bair hazzot
Asher lo-lekacham nevuchadnetzar melech bavel bagloto et-yechanya ven-yehoyakim melech-yehuda mirushalam bavela veet kal-chore yehuda virushalam
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael al-hakkelim hannotarim bet Adonai uvet melech-yehuda virushalam
Bavela yuvau veshamma yihu ad yom pakdi otam neum-Adonai vehaalitim vahashivotim el-hammakom hazze

Vayehi bashshana hahi bereshit mamlechet tzidkiyya melech-yehuda bashshana harviit bachodesh hachamishi amar elay chananya ven-azzur hannavi asher miggivon bevet Adonai leene hakkohanim vechal-haam lemor
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lemor shavarti et-ol melech bavel
Beod shenatayim yamim ani meshiv el-hammakom hazze et-kal-kele bet Adonai asher lakach nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel min-hammakom hazze vayeviem bavel
Veet-yechanya ven-yehoyakim melech-yehuda veet-kal-galut yehuda habbaim bavela ani meshiv el-hammakom hazze neum-Adonai ki eshbor et-ol melech bavel
Vayyomer yirmeya hannavi el-chananya hannavi leene hakkohanim ulene chal-haam haomdim bevet Adonai
Vayyomer yirmeya hannavi amen ken yaase Adonai yakem Adonai et-devarecha asher nibbeta lehashiv kele vet-Adonai vechal-haggola mibbavel el-hammakom hazze
Ach-shema-na haddavar hazze asher anochi dover beaznecha uvazne kal-haam
Hanneviim asher hau lefanay ulfanecha min-haolam vayyinnavu el-aratzot rabbot veal-mamlachot gedolot lemilchama ulraa uldaver
Hannavi asher yinnave leshalom bevo devar hannavi yivada hannavi asher-shelacho Adonai beemet
Vayyikkach chananya hannavi et-hammota meal tzavar yirmeya hannavi vayyishberehu
Vayyomer chananya leene chal-haam lemor ko amar Adonai kacha eshbor et-ol nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel beod shenatayim yamim meal tzavar kal-haggoyim vayyelech yirmeya hannavi ledarko
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeya achare shevor chananya hannavi et-hammota meal tzavar yirmeya hannavi lemor
Haloch veamarta el-chananya lemor ko amar Adonai motot etz shavarta veasita tachtehen motot barzel
Ki cho-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael ol barzel natatti al-tzavar kal-haggoyim haelle laavod et-nevuchadnetzar melech-bavel vaavaduhu vegam et-chayyat hassade natatti lo
Vayyomer yirmeya hannavi el-chananya hannavi shema-na chananya lo-shelachacha Adonai veatta hivtachta et-haam hazze al-shaker
Lachen ko amar Adonai hinni meshallechacha meal pene haadama hashshana atta met ki-sara dibbarta el-Adonai
Vayyamat chananya hannavi bashshana hahi bachodesh hashshevii
Veelle divre hassefer asher shalach yirmeya hannavi mirushalam el-yeter zikne haggola veel-hakkohanim veel-hanneviim veel-kal-haam asher hegla nevuchadnetzar mirushalam bavela
Achare tzet yechanya-hammelech vehaggevira vehassarisim sare yehuda virushalam vehecharash vehammasger mirushalam
Beyad elasa ven-shafan ugmarya ben-chilkiyya asher shalach tzidkiyya melech-yehuda el-nevuchadnetzar melech bavel bavela lemor
Ko amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lechal-haggola asher-higleti mirushalam bavela
Benu vattim veshevu venitu gannot veichlu et-piryan
Kechu nashim veholidu banim uvanot ukchu livnechem nashim veet-benotechem tenu laanashim veteladna banim uvanot urvu-sham veal-timatu
Vedirshu et-shelom hair asher higleti etchem shamma vehitpallu vaadah el-Adonai ki vishlomah yihye lachem shalom
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael al-yashshiu lachem neviechem asher-bekirbechem vekosmechem veal-tishmeu el-chalomotechem asher attem machlemim
Ki vesheker hem nibbeim lachem bishmi lo shelachtim neum-Adonai
Ki-cho amar Adonai ki lefi melot levavel shivim shana efkod etchem vahakimoti alechem et-devari hattov lehashiv etchem el-hammakom hazze
Ki anochi yadati et-hammachashavot asher anochi choshev alechem neum-Adonai machshevot shalom velo leraa latet lachem acharit vetikva
Ukratem oti vahalachtem vehitpallaltem elay veshamati alechem
Uvikkashtem oti umtzatem ki tidreshuni bechal-levavchem

Venimtzeti lachem neum-Adonai veshavti shevutchem vekibbatzti etchem mikkal-haggoyim umikkal-hammekomot asher hiddachti etchem sham neum-Adonai vahashivoti etchem el-hammakom asher-higleti etchem mishsham
Ki amartem hekim lanu Adonai neviim bavela
Ki-cho amar Adonai el-hammelech hayyoshev el-kisse david veel-kal-haam hayyoshev bair hazzot achechem asher lo-yatzu ittechem baggola
Ko amar Adonai tzevaot hinni meshalleach bam et-hacherev et-haraav veet-haddaver venatatti otam katteenim hashshoarim asher lo-teachalna meroa
Veradafti acharehem bacherev baraav uvaddaver untattim lezaava lechol mamlechot haaretz leala ulshamma velishreka ulcherpa bechal-haggoyim asher-hiddachtim sham
Tachat asher-lo-shamu el-devaray neum-Adonai asher shalachti alehem et-avaday hanneviim hashkem veshaloach velo shematem neum-Adonai
Veattem shimu devar-Adonai kal-haggola asher-shillachti mirushalam bavela
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael el-achav ben-kolaya veel-tzidkiyyahu ven-maaseya hannibbeim lachem bishmi shaker hinni noten otam beyad nevuchadretzar melech-bavel vehikkam leenechem
Velukkach mehem kelala lechol galut yehuda asher bevavel lemor yesimcha Adonai ketzidkiyyahu uchechav asher-kalam melech-bavel baesh
Yaan asher asu nevala beyisrael vayenaafu et-neshe reehem vayedabberu davar bishmi sheker asher lo tzivitim veanochi hayyodea vaed neum-Adonai
Veel-shemayahu hannechelami tomar lemor
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lemor yaan asher atta shalachta veshimcha sefarim el-kal-haam asher birushalam veel-tzefanya ven-maaseya hakkohen veel kal-hakkohanim lemor
Adonai netancha chohen tachat yehoyada hakkohen lihot pekidim bet Adonai lechal-ish meshugga umitnabbe venatatta oto el-hammahpechet veel-hatztzinok
Veatta lamma lo gaarta beyirmeyahu haannetoti hammitnabbe lachem
Ki al-ken shalach elenu bavel lemor arukka hi benu vattim veshevu venitu gannot veichlu et-perihen
Vayyikra tzefanya hakkohen et-hassefer hazze beazne yirmeyahu hannavi
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu lemor
Shelach al-kal-haggola lemor ko amar Adonai el-shemaya hannechelami yaan asher nibba lachem shemaya vaani lo shelachtiv vayyavtach etchem al-shaker
Lachen ko-amar Adonai hinni foked al-shemaya hannechelami veal-zaro lo-yihye lo ish yoshev betoch-haam hazze velo-yire vattov asher-ani ose-leammi neum-Adonai ki-sara dibber al-Adonai
Haddavar asher haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael lemor ketav-lecha et kal-haddevarim asher-dibbarti elecha el-sefer
Ki hinne yamim baim neum-Adonai veshavti et-shevut ammi yisrael vihuda amar Adonai vahashivotim el-haaretz asher-natatti laavotam vireshuha
Veelle haddevarim asher dibber Adonai el-yisrael veel-yehuda
Ki-cho amar Adonai kol charada shamanu pachad veen shalom
Shaalu-na uru im-yoled zachar maddua raiti chal-gever yadav al-chalatzav kayyoleda venehefchu chal-panim leyerakon
Hoy ki gadol hayyom hahu meayin kamohu veet-tzara hi leyaakov umimmenna yivashea
Vehaya vayyom hahu neum Adonai tzevaot eshbor ullo meal tzavarecha umosrotecha anattek velo-yaavdu-vo od zarim
Veavdu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam asher akim lahem
Veatta al-tira avdi yaakov neum-Adonai veal-techat yisrael ki hinni moshiacha merachok veet-zaracha meeretz shivyam veshav yaakov veshakat veshaanan veen macharid
Ki-ittecha ani neum-Adonai lehoshiecha ki eese chala bechal-haggoyim asher hafitzoticha sham ach otcha lo-eese chala veyissarticha lammishpat venakke lo anakkekka
Ki cho amar Adonai anush leshivrech nachla makkatech
En-dan dinech lemazor refuot teala en lach
Kal-meahavayich shechechuch otach lo yidroshu ki makkat oyev hikkitich musar achzari al rov aonech atzmu chattotayich
Ma-tizak al-shivrech anush machovech al rov aonech atzmu chattotayich asiti elle lach
Lachen kal-ochlayich yeachelu vechal-tzarayich kullam bashshevi yelechu vehau shosayich limshissa vechal-bozzayich etten lavaz
Ki aale arucha lach umimmakkotayich erpaech neum-Adonai ki niddacha karu lach tziyyon hi doresh en lah
Ko amar Adonai hinni-shav shevut ahole yaakov umishkenotav arachem venivneta ir al-tillah vearmon al-mishpato yeshev
Veyatza mehem toda vekol mesachakim vehirbitim velo yimatu vehichbadtim velo yitzaru
Vehau vanav kekedem vaadato lefanay tikkon ufakadti al kal-lochatzav
Vehaya addiro mimmennu umoshlo mikkirbo yetze vehikravtiv veniggash elay ki mi hu-ze arav et-libbo lageshet elay neum-Adonai
Vihyitem li leam veanochi ehye lachem lelohim
Hinne saarat Adonai chema yatza saar mitgorer al rosh reshaim yachul
Lo yashuv charon af-Adonai ad-asoto vead-hakimo mezimmot libbo beacharit hayyamim titbonnu vah
Baet hahi neum-Adonai ehye lelohim lechol mishpechot yisrael vehemma yihu-li leam
Ko amar Adonai matza chen bammidbar am seride charev haloch lehargio yisrael
Merachok Adonai nira li veahavat olam ahavtich al-ken meshachtich chased
Od evnech venivnet betulat yisrael od tadi tuppayich veyatzat bimchol mesachakim
Od tittei cheramim behare shomron natu notim vechillelu
Ki yesh-yom karu notzrim behar efrayim kumu venaale tziyyon el-Adonai elohenu
Ki-cho amar Adonai rannu leyaakov simcha vetzahalu berosh haggoyim hashmiu hallu veimru hosha Adonai et-ammecha et sheerit yisrael
Hinni mevi otam meeretz tzafon vekibbatztim miyyarkete-aretz bam iver ufisseach hara veyoledet yachdav kahal gadol yashuvu henna
Bivchi yavou uvtachanunim ovilem olichem el-nachale mayim bederech yashar lo yikkashlu bah ki-hayiti leyisrael leav veefrayim bechori hu
Shimu devar-Adonai goyim vehaggidu vaiyyim mimmerchak veimru mezare yisrael yekabbetzennu ushmaro keroe edro
Ki-fada Adonai et-yaakov ugalo miyyad chazak mimmennu
Uvau verinnenu vimrom-tziyyon venaharu el-tuv Adonai al-dagan veal-tirosh veal-yitzhar veal-bene-tzon uvakar vehayeta nafsham kegan rave velo-yosifu ledaava od
Az tismach betula bemachol uvachurim uzkenim yachdav vehafachti evlam lesason venichamtim vesimmachtim migonam
Veriveti nefesh hakkohanim dashen veammi et-tuvi yisbau neum-Adonai
Ko amar Adonai kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al-baneha meana lehinnachem al-baneha ki enennu
Ko amar Adonai mini kolech mibbechi veenayich middima ki yesh sachar lifullatech neum-Adonai veshavu meeretz oyev
Veyesh-tikva leacharitech neum-Adonai veshavu vanim ligvulam
Shamoa shamati efrayim mitnoded yissartani vaivaser keegel lo lummad hashiveni veashuva ki atta Adonai elohay
Ki-achare shuvi nichamti veachare hivadi safakti al-yarech boshti vegam-nichlamti ki nasati cherpat neuray
Haven yakkir li efrayim im yeled shaashuim ki-midde dabberi bo zachor ezkerennu od al-ken hamu meay lo rachem arachamennu neum-Adonai
Hatztzivi lach tziyyunim simi lach tamrurim shiti libbech lamsilla derech halachte shuvi betulat yisrael shuvi el-arayich elle
Ad-matay titchammakin habbat hashshoveva ki-vara Adonai chadasha baaretz nekeva tesovev gaver
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael od yomru et-haddavar hazze beeretz yehuda uvarav beshuvi et-shevutam yevarechcha Adonai neve-tzedek har hakkodesh
Veyashvu vah yehuda vechal-arav yachdav ikkarim venasu baeder
Ki hirveti nefesh ayefa vechal-nefesh daava milleti
Al-zot hekitzoti vaere ushnati arva li
Hinne yamim baim neum-Adonai vezarati et-bet yisrael veet-bet yehuda zera adam vezera behema
Vehaya kaasher shakadti alehem lintosh velintotz velaharos ulhaavid ulharea ken eshkod alehem livnot velintoa neum-Adonai
Bayyamim hahem lo-yomru od avot achlu voser veshinne vanim tikhena
Ki im-ish baaono yamut kal-haadam haochel habboser tikhena shinnav
Hinne yamim baim neum-Adonai vecharatti et-bet yisrael veet-bet yehuda berit chadasha
Lo chabberit asher karatti et-avotam beom hecheziki veyadam lehotziam meeretz mitzrayim asher-hemma heferu et-beriti veanochi baalti vam neum-Adonai
Ki zot habberit asher echrot et-bet yisrael achare hayyamim hahem neum-Adonai natatti et-torati bekirbam veal-libbam echtavenna vehayiti lahem lelohim vehemma yihu-li leam
Velo yelammedu od ish et-reehu veish et-achiv lemor deu et-Adonai ki-chullam yedu oti lemiktannam vead-gedolam neum-Adonai ki eslach laaonam ulchattatam lo ezkar-od
Ko amar Adonai noten shemesh leor yomam chukkot yareach vechochavim leor layela roga hayyam vayyehemu gallav Adonai tzevaot shemo
Im-yamushu hachukkim haelle millefanay neum-Adonai gam zera yisrael yishbetu mihot goy lefanay kal-hayyamim
Ko amar Adonai im-yimmaddu shamayim milmala veyechakru mosde-eretz lematta gam-ani emas bechal-zera yisrael al-kal-asher asu neum-Adonai
Hinne baim neum-Adonai venivneta hair la-Adonai mimmigdal chananel shaar happinna
Veyatza od kav hammidda negdo al givat garev venasav goata
Vechal-haemek happegarim vehaddeshen hashshedemot ad-nachal kidron ad-pinnat shaar hassusim mizracha kodesh la-Adonai lo-yinnatesh velo-yehares od leolam
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai bashshana haasirit letzidkiyyahu melech yehuda hi hashshana shemone-esre shana linvuchadretzar
Veaz chel melech bavel tzarim al-yerushalam veyirmeyahu hannavi haya chalu bachatzar hammattara asher bet-melech yehuda
Asher kelao tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda lemor maddua atta nibba lemor ko amar Adonai hinni noten et-hair hazzot beyad melech-bavel ulchadah
Vetzidkiyyahu melech yehuda lo yimmalet miyyad hakkasdim ki hinnaton yinnaten beyad melech-bavel vedibber-piv im-piv veenav enav tirena
Uvavel yolich et-tzidkiyyahu vesham yihye ad-pakdi oto neum-Adonai ki tillachamu et-hakkasdim lo tatzlichu
Vayyomer yirmeyahu haya devar-Adonai elay lemor
Hinne chanamel ben-shallum dodcha ba elecha lemor kene lecha et-sadi asher baanatot ki lecha mishpat haggeulla liknot

Vayyavo elay chanamel ben-dodi kidvar Adonai el-chatzar hammattara vayyomer elay kene na et-sadi asher-baanatot asher beeretz binyamin ki-lecha mishpat hayerushsha ulcha haggeulla kene-lach vaeda ki devar-Adonai hu
Vaekne et-hassade meet chanamel ben-dodi asher baanatot vaeshkala-lo et-hakkesef shiva shekalim vaasara hakkasef
Vaechtov bassefer vaechtom vaaed edim vaeshkol hakkesef bemoznayim
Vaekkach et-sefer hammikna et-hechatum hammitzva vehachukkim veet-haggaluy
Vaetten et-hassefer hammikna el-baruch ben-neriyya ben-machseya leene chanamel dodi ulene haedim hakkotvim besefer hammikna leene kal-hayehudim hayyoshvim bachatzar hammattara
Vaatzave et baruch leenehem lemor
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lakoach et-hassefarim haelle et sefer hammikna hazze veet hechatum veet sefer haggaluy hazze untattam bichli-chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael od yikkanu vattim vesadot uchramim baaretz hazzot
Vaetpallel el-Adonai achare titti et-sefer hammikna el-baruch ben-neriyya lemor
Ahah adonay Adonai hinne atta asita et-hashshamayim veet-haaretz bechochacha haggadol uvizroacha hannetuya lo-yippale mimmecha kal-davar
Ose chesed laalafim umshallem aon avot el-chek benehem acharehem hael haggadol haggibbor Adonai tzevaot shemo
Gedol haetza verav haaliliyya asher-enecha fekuchot al-kal-darche bene adam latet leish kidrachav vechifri maalalav
Asher-samta otot umoftim beeretz-mitzrayim ad-hayyom hazze uvyisrael uvaadam vattaase-lecha shem kayyom hazze
Vattotze et-ammecha et-yisrael meeretz mitzrayim beotot uvmoftim uvyad chazaka uvezroa netuya uvmora gadol
Vattitten lahem et-haaretz hazzot asher-nishbata laavotam latet lahem eretz zavat chalav udvash
Vayyavou vayyirshu otah velo-shamu vekolecha uvtoratcha lo-halachu et kal-asher tzivita lahem laasot lo asu vattakre otam et kal-haraa hazzot
Hinne hassollot bau hair lelachdah vehair nittena beyad hakkasdim hannilchamim aleha mippene hacherev veharaav vehaddaver vaasher dibbarta haya vehinnecha roe
Veatta amarta elay adonay Adonai kene-lecha hassade bakkesef vehaed edim vehair nittena beyad hakkasdim
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu lemor
Hinne ani Adonai elohe kal-basar hamimmenni yippale kal-davar
Lachen ko amar Adonai hinni noten et-hair hazzot beyad hakkasdim uvyad nevuchadretzar melech-bavel ulchadah
Uvau hakkasdim hannilchamim al-hair hazzot vehitztzitu et-hair hazzot baesh usrafuha veet habbattim asher kitteru al-gaggotehem labbaal vehissichu nesachim lelohim acherim lemaan hachiseni
Ki-hau vene-yisrael uvne yehuda ach osim hara beenay minneurotehem ki vene-yisrael ach machisim oti bemaase yedehem neum-Adonai
Ki al-appi veal-chamati hayeta li hair hazzot lemin-hayyom asher banu otah vead hayyom hazze lahasirah meal panay
Al kal-raat bene-yisrael uvne yehuda asher asu lehachiseni hemma malchehem sarehem kohanehem unviehem veish yehuda veyoshve yerushalam
Vayyifnu elay oref velo fanim velammed otam hashkem velammed veenam shomim lakachat musar
Vayyasimu shikkutzehem babbayit asher-nikra-shemi alav letammeo
Vayyivnu et-bamot habbaal asher bege ven-hinnom lehaavir et-benehem veet-benotehem lammolech asher lo-tzivitim velo alta al-libbi laasot hattoeva hazzot lemaan hachati et-yehuda
Veatta lachen ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael el-hair hazzot asher attem omrim nittena beyad melech-bavel bacherev uvaraav uvaddaver
Hinni mekabbetzam mikkal-haaratzot asher hiddachtim sham beappi uvachamati uvketzef gadol vahashivotim el-hammakom hazze vehoshavtim lavetach
Vehau li leam vaani ehye lahem lelohim
Venatatti lahem lev echad vederech echad leyira oti kal-hayyamim letov lahem velivnehem acharehem
Vecharatti lahem berit olam asher lo-ashuv meacharehem lehetivi otam veet-yirati etten bilvavam levilti sur mealay
Vesasti alehem lehetiv otam untatim baaretz hazzot beemet bechal-libbi uvchal-nafshi
Ki-cho amar Adonai kaasher heveti el-haam hazze et kal-haraa haggedola hazzot ken anochi mevi alehem et-kal-hattova asher anochi dover alehem
Venikna hassade baaretz hazzot asher attem omrim shemama hi meen adam uvhema nittena beyad hakkasdim
Sadot bakkesef yiknu vechatov bassefer vechatom vehaed edim beeretz binyamin uvisvive yerushalam uvare yehuda uvare hahar uvare hashshefela uvare hannegev ki-ashiv et-shevutam neum-Adonai
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu shenit vehu odennu atzur bachatzar hammattara lemor
Ko-amar Adonai osah Adonai yotzer otah lahachinah Adonai shemo
Kera elay veeenekka veaggida lecha gedolot uvtzurot lo yedatam
Ki cho amar Adonai elohe yisrael al-batte hair hazzot veal-batte malche yehuda hannetutzim el-hassollot veel-hecharev
Baim lehillachem et-hakkasdim ulmalam et-pigre haadam asher-hikketi veappi uvachamati vaasher histarti fanay mehair hazzot al kal-raatam
Hinni maale-lah arucha umarpe urfatim vegilleti lahem ateret shalom veemet
Vahashivoti et-shevut yehuda veet shevut yisrael uvnitim kevarishona
Vetihartim mikkal-aonam asher chatu-li vesalachti lchl-lechal- aonotehem asher chatu-li vaasher pashu vi
Vehayeta li leshem sason lithilla ultiferet lechol goye haaretz asher yishmeu et-kal-hattova asher anochi ose otam ufachadu veragzu al kal-hattova veal kal-hashshalom asher anochi ose lah
Ko amar Adonai od yishshama bammakom-hazze asher attem omrim charev hu meen adam umeen behema beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalam hanshammot meen adam umeen yoshev umeen behema
Kol sason vekol simcha kol chatan vekol kalla kol omrim hodu et-Adonai tzevaot ki-tov Adonai ki-leolam chasdo meviim toda bet Adonai ki-ashiv et-shevut-haaretz kevarishona amar Adonai
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot od yihye bammakom hazze hecharev meen-adam vead-behema uvchal-arav neve roim marbitzim tzon
Beare hahar beare hashshefela uvare hannegev uveretz binyamin uvisvive yerushalam uvare yehuda od taavorna hatztzon al-yede mone amar Adonai
Hinne yamim baim neum-Adonai vahakimoti et-haddavar hattov asher dibbarti el-bet yisrael veal-bet yehuda
Bayyamim hahem uvaet hahi atzmiach ledavid tzemach tzedaka veasa mishpat utzdaka baaretz
Bayyamim hahem tivasha yehuda virushalam tishkon lavetach veze asher-yikra-lah Adonai tzidkenu
Ki-cho amar Adonai lo-yikkaret ledavid ish yoshev al-kisse vet-yisrael
Velakkohanim halviyyim lo-yikkaret ish millefanay maale ola umaktir mincha veose-zevach kal-hayyamim
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu lemor
Ko amar Adonai im-taferu et-beriti hayyom veet-beriti hallayela ulvilti heot yomam-valayela beittam
Gam-beriti tufar et-david avdi mihot-lo ven molech al-kiso veet-halviyyim hakkohanim meshartay
Asher lo-yissafer tzeva hashshamayim velo yimmad chol hayyam ken arbe et-zera david avdi veet-halviyyim mesharte oti
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu lemor
Halo raita ma-haam hazze dibberu lemor shette hammishpachot asher bachar Adonai bahem vayyimasem veet-ammi yinatzun mihot od goy lifnehem
Ko amar Adonai im-lo veriti yomam valayela chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo-samti
Gam-zera yaakov vedavid avdi emas mikkachat mizzaro moshlim el-zera avraham yischak veyaakov ashiv et-shevutam verichamtim
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai unvuchadretzar melech-bavel vechal-chelo vechal-mamlechot eretz memshelet yado vechal-haammim nilchamim al-yerushalam veal-kal-areha lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael haloch veamarta el-tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda veamarta elav ko amar Adonai hinni noten et-hair hazzot beyad melech-bavel usrafah baesh
Veatta lo timmalet miyyado ki tafos tittafes uvyado tinnaten veenecha et-ene melech-bavel tirena ufihu et-picha yedabber uvavel tavo
Ach shema devar-Adonai tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda ko-amar Adonai alecha lo tamut becharev
Beshalom tamut uchmisrefot avotecha hammelachim harishonim asher-hau lefanecha ken yisrefu-lach vehoy adon yispedu-lach ki-davar ani-dibbarti neum-Adonai
Vayedabber yirmeyahu hannavi el-tzidkiyyahu melech yehuda et kal-haddevarim haelle birushalam
Vechel melech-bavel nilchamim al-yerushalam veal kal-are yehuda hannotarot el-lachish veel-azeka ki henna nisharu beare yehuda are mivtzar
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai achare kerot hammelech tzidkiyyahu berit et-kal-haam asher birushalam likro lahem deror
Leshallach ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato haivri vehaivriyya chafshim levilti avad-bam bihudi achihu ish
Vayyishmeu chal-hassarim vechal-haam asher-bau vabberit leshallach ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato chafshim levilti avad-bam od vayyishmeu vayeshallechu
Vayyashuvu achare-chen vayyashivu et-haavadim veet-hashshefachot asher shillechu chafshim vayyichbeshum laavadim velishfachot
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael anochi karatti verit et-avotechem beom hotzii otam meeretz mitzrayim mibbet avadim lemor
Mikketz sheva shanim teshallechu ish et-achiv haivri asher-yimmacher lecha vaavadcha shesh shanim veshillachto chafshi meimmach velo-shamu avotechem elay velo hittu et-aznam
Vattashuvu attem hayyom vattaasu et-hayyashar beenay likro deror ish lereehu vattichretu verit lefanay babbayit asher-nikra shemi alav
Vattashuvu vattechallelu et-shemi vattashivu ish et-avdo veish et-shifchato asher-shillachtem chafshim lenafsham vattichbeshu otam lihot lachem laavadim velishfachot

Lachen ko-amar Adonai attem lo-shematem elay likro deror ish leachiv veish lereehu hinni kore lachem deror neum-Adonai el-hacherev el-haddever veel-haraav venatatti etchem lezaava lechol mamlechot haaretz
Venatatti et-haanashim haovrim et-beriti asher lo-hekimu et-divre habberit asher kartu lefanay haegel asher kartu lishnayim vayyaavru ben betarav
Sare yehuda vesare yerushalam hassarisim vehakkohanim vechol am haaretz haovrim ben bitre haegel
Venatatti otam beyad oyevehem uvyad mevakshe nafsham vehayeta nivlatam lemaachal leof hashshamayim ulvehemat haaretz
Veet-tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda veet-sarav etten beyad oyevehem uvyad mevakshe nafsham uvyad chel melech bavel haolim mealechem
Hinni metzave neum-Adonai vahashivotim el-hair hazzot venilchamu aleha ulchaduha usrafuha vaesh veet-are yehuda etten shemama meen yoshev
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai bime yehoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda lemor
Haloch el-bet harechavim vedibbarta otam vahaviotam bet Adonai el-achat halleshachot vehishkita otam yayin
Vaekkach et-yaazanya ven-yirmeyahu ben-chavatztzinya veet-echav veet-kal-banav veet kal-bet harechavim
Vaavi otam bet Adonai el-lishkat bene chanan ben-yigdalyahu ish haelohim asher-etzel lishkat hassarim asher mimmaal lelishkat maaseyahu ven-shallum shomer hassaf
Vaetten lifne bene vet-harechavim geviim meleim yayin vechosot vaomar alehem shetu-yayin
Vayyomru lo nishte-yayin ki yonadav ben-rechav avinu tziva alenu lemor lo tishtu-yayin attem uvnechem ad-olam
Uvayit lo-tivnu vezera lo-tizrau vecherem lo-tittau velo yihye lachem ki baohalim teshvu kal-yemechem lemaan tichu yamim rabbim al-pene haadama asher attem garim sham
Vannishma bekol yehonadav ben-rechav avinu lechol asher tzivanu levilti shetot-yayin kal-yamenu anachnu nashenu banenu uvnotenu
Ulvilti benot battim leshivtenu vecherem vesade vazera lo yihye-lanu
Vanneshev baohalim vannishma vannaas kechol asher-tzivanu yonadav avinu
Vayehi baalot nevuchadretzar melech-bavel el-haaretz vannomer bou venavo yerushalam mippene chel hakkasdim umippene chel aram vanneshev birushalam
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu lemor
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael haloch veamarta leish yehuda uloshve yerushalam halo tikchu musar lishmoa el-devaray neum-Adonai
Hukam et-divre yehonadav ben-rechav asher-tziva et-banav levilti shetot-yayin velo shatu ad-hayyom hazze ki shamu et mitzvat avihem veanochi dibbarti alechem hashkem vedabber velo shematem elay

Vaeshlach alechem et-kal-avaday hanneviim hashkem veshaloach lemor shuvu-na ish middarko haraa vehetivu maallechem veal-telchu achare elohim acherim leavdam ushvu el-haadama asher-natatti lachem velaavotechem velo hittitem et-aznechem velo shematem elay
Ki hekimu bene yehonadav ben-rechav et-mitzvat avihem asher tzivam vehaam hazze lo shamu elay
Lachen ko-amar Adonai elohe tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni mevi el-yehuda veel kal-yoshve yerushalam et kal-haraa asher dibbarti alehem yaan dibbarti alehem velo shameu vaekra lahem velo anu
Ulvet harechavim amar yirmeyahu ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael yaan asher shematem al-mitzvat yehonadav avichem vattishmeru et-kal-mitzotav vattaasu kechol asher-tziva etchem
Lachen ko amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael lo-yikkaret ish leonadav ben-rechav omed lefanay kal-hayyamim
Vayehi bashshana harviit lihoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech yehuda haya haddavar hazze el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai lemor
Kach-lecha megillat-sefer vechatavta eleha et kal-haddevarim asher-dibbarti elecha al-yisrael veal-yehuda veal-kal-haggoyim miyyom dibbarti elecha mime yoshiyyahu vead hayyom hazze
Ulay yishmeu bet yehuda et kal-haraa asher anochi choshev laasot lahem lemaan yashuvu ish middarko haraa vesalachti laaonam ulchattatam
Vayyikra yirmeyahu et-baruch ben-neriyya vayyichtov baruch mippi yirmeyahu et kal-divre Adonai asher-dibber elav al-megillat-sefer
Vayetzave yirmeyahu et-baruch lemor ani atzur lo uchal lavo bet Adonai
Uvata atta vekarata vammegilla asher-katavta-mippi et-divre Adonai beazne haam bet Adonai beom tzom vegam beazne chal-yehuda habbaim mearehem tikraem
Ulay tippol techinnatam lifne Adonai veyashuvu ish middarko haraa ki-gadol haaf vehachema asher-dibber Adonai el-haam hazze
Vayyaas baruch ben-neriyya kechol asher-tzivahu yirmeyahu hannavi likro vassefer divre Adonai bet Adonai
Vayehi vashshana hachamishit lihoyakim ben-yoshiyyahu melech-yehuda bachodesh hatteshii karu tzom lifne Adonai kal-haam birushalam vechal-haam habbaim meare yehuda birushalam
Vayyikra varuch bassefer et-divre yirmeyahu bet Adonai belishkat gemaryahu ven-shafan hassofer bechatzer haelon petach shaar bet-Adonai hechadash beazne kal-haam
Vayyishma michayehu ven-gemaryahu ven-shafan et-kal-divre Adonai meal hassefer

Vayyered bet-hammelech al-lishkat hassofer vehinne-sham kal-hassarim yoshvim elishama hassofer udlayahu ven-shemayahu veelnatan ben-achbor ugmaryahu ven-shafan vetzidkiyyahu ven-chananyahu vechal-hassarim
Vayyagged lahem michayehu et kal-haddevarim asher shamea bikro varuch bassefer beazne haam

Vayyishlechu chal-hassarim el-baruch et-yehudi ben-netanyahu ben-shelemyahu ven-kushi lemor hammegilla asher karata bah beazne haam kachenna veyadcha valech vayyikkach baruch ben-neriyyahu et-hammegilla beyado vayyavo alehem
Vayyomru elav shev na ukraenna beaznenu vayyikra varuch beaznehem
Vayehi keshamam et-kal-haddevarim pachadu ish el-reehu vayyomru el-baruch hagged naggid lammelech et kal-haddevarim haelle
Veet-baruch shaalu lemor hagged-na lanu ech katavta et-kal-haddevarim haelle mippiv
Vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et kal-haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al-hassefer baddeo
Vayyomru hassarim el-baruch lech hissater atta veyirmeyahu veish al-yeda efo attem
Vayyavou el-hammelech chatzera veet-hammegilla hifkidu belishkat elishama hassofer vayyaggidu beazne hammelech et kal-haddevarim
Vayyishlach hammelech et-yehudi lakachat et-hammegilla vayyikkacheha millishkat elishama hassofer vayyikraeha yehudi beazne hammelech uvazne kal-hassarim haomdim meal hammelech
Vehammelech yoshev bet hachoref bachodesh hatteshii veet-haach lefanav mevoaret
Vayehi kikro yehudi shalosh delatot vearbaa yikraeha betaar hassofer vehashlech el-haesh asher el-haach ad-tom kal-hammegilla al-haesh asher al-haach
Velo fachadu velo karu et-bigdehem hammelech vechal-avadav hashshomim et kal-haddevarim haelle
Vegam elnatan udlayahu ugmaryahu hifgiu vammelech levilti serof et-hammegilla velo shama alehem
Vayetzave hammelech et-yerachmeel ben-hammelech veet-serayahu ven-azriel veet-shelemyahu ben-avdeel lakachat et-baruch hassofer veet yirmeyahu hannavi vayyastirem Adonai
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu achare serof hammelech et-hammegilla veet-haddevarim asher katav baruch mippi yirmeyahu lemor
Shuv kach-lecha megilla acheret uchtov aleha et kal-haddevarim harishonim asher hau al-hammegilla harishona asher saraf yehoyakim melech-yehuda
Veal-yehoyakim melech-yehuda tomar ko amar Adonai atta sarafta et-hammegilla hazzot lemor maddua katavta aleha lemor bo-yavo melech-bavel vehishchit et-haaretz hazzot vehishbit mimmenna adam uvhema
Lachen ko-amar Adonai al-yehoyakim melech yehuda lo-yihye-lo yoshev al-kisse david venivlato tihye mushlechet lachorev bayyom velakkerach ballayela
Ufakadti alav veal-zaro veal-avadav et-aonam veheveti alehem veal-yoshve yerushalam veel-ish yehuda et kal-haraa asher-dibbarti alehem velo shameu

Veyirmeyahu lakach megilla acheret vayyittenah el-baruch ben-neriyyahu hassofer vayyichtov aleha mippi yirmeyahu et kal-divre hassefer asher saraf yehoyakim melech-yehuda baesh veod nosaf alehem devarim rabbim kahemma
Vayyimlach-melech tzidkiyyahu ben-yoshiyyahu tachat kanyahu ben-yehoyakim asher himlich nevuchadretzar melech-bavel beeretz yehuda
Velo shama hu vaavadav veam haaretz el-divre Adonai asher dibber beyad yirmeyahu hannavi
Vayyishlach hammelech tzidkiyyahu et-yehuchal ben-shelemya veet-tzefanyahu ven-maaseya hakkohen el-yirmeyahu hannavi lemor hitpallel-na vaadenu el-Adonai elohenu
Veyirmeyahu ba veyotze betoch haam velo-natnu oto bet hakkelu
Vechel paro yatza mimmitzrayim vayyishmeu hakkasdim hatztzarim al-yerushalam et-shimam vayyealu meal yerushalam
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu hannavi lemor
Ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael ko tomru el-melech yehuda hashsholeach etchem elay ledarsheni hinne chel paro hayyotze lachem leezra shav leartzo mitzrayim
Veshavu hakkasdim venilchamu al-hair hazzot ulchaduha usrafuha vaesh
Ko amar Adonai al-tashshiu nafshotechem lemor haloch yelchu mealenu hakkasdim ki-lo yelechu
Ki im-hikkitem kal-chel kasdim hannilchamim ittechem venisharu vam anashim medukkarim ish beaholo yakumu vesarfu et-hair hazzot baesh
Vehaya behealot chel hakkasdim meal yerushalam mippene chel paro
Vayyetze yirmeyahu mirushalam lalechet eretz binyamin lachalik mishsham betoch haam
Vayehi-hu beshaar binyamin vesham baal pekidut ushmo yiriyya ben-shelemya ben-chananya vayyitpos et-yirmeyahu hannavi lemor el-hakkasdim atta nofel
Vayyomer yirmeyahu sheker enenni nofel al-hakkasdim velo shama elav vayyitpos yiriyya beyirmeyahu vayeviehu el-hassarim
Vayyiktzefu hassarim al-yirmeyahu vehikku oto venatnu oto bet haesur bet yehonatan hassofer ki-oto asu levet hakkele
Ki va yirmeyahu el-bet habbor veel-hachanuot vayyeshev-sham yirmeyahu yamim rabbim
Vayyishlach hammelech tzidkiyyahu vayyikkachehu vayyishalehu hammelech beveto basseter vayyomer hayesh davar meet Adonai vayyomer yirmeyahu yesh vayyomer beyad melech-bavel tinnaten
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-hammelech tzidkiyyahu me chatati lecha velaavadecha velaam hazze ki-netattem oti el-bet hakkele
Veayye neviechem asher-nibbeu lachem lemor lo-yavo melech-bavel alechem veal haaretz hazzot
Veatta shema-na adoni hammelech tippal-na techinnati lefanecha veal-teshiveni bet yehonatan hassofer velo amut sham
Vayetzave hammelech tzidkiyyahu vayyafkidu et-yirmeyahu bachatzar hammattara venaton lo chikkar-lechem layyom michutz haofim ad-tom kal-hallechem min-hair vayyeshev yirmeyahu bachatzar hammattara
Vayyishma shefatya ven-mattan ugdalyahu ben-pashchur veuchal ben-shelemyahu ufashchur ben-malkiyya et-haddevarim asher yirmeyahu medabber el-kal-haam lemor
Ko amar Adonai hayyoshev bair hazzot yamut bacherev baraav uvaddaver vehayyotze el-hakkasdim vechaya vehayeta-lo nafsho leshalal vachay
Ko amar Adonai hinnaton tinnaten hair hazzot beyad chel melech-bavel ulchadah

Vayyomru hassarim el-hammelech yumat na et-haish hazze ki-al-ken hu-merappe et-yede anshe hammilchama hannisharim bair hazzot veet yede chal-haam ledabber alehem kaddevarim haelle ki haish hazze enennu doresh leshalom laam hazze ki im-leraa
Vayyomer hammelech tzidkiyyahu hinne-hu beyedchem ki-en hammelech yuchal etchem davar
Vayyikchu et-yirmeyahu vayyashlichu oto el-habbor malkiyyahu ven-hammelech asher bachatzar hammattara vayeshallechu et-yirmeyahu bachavalim uvabbor en-mayim ki im-tit vayyitba yirmeyahu battit
Vayyishma eved-melech hakkushi ish saris vehu bevet hammelech ki-natnu et-yirmeyahu el-habbor vehammelech yoshev beshaar binyamin
Vayyetze eved-melech mibbet hammelech vayedabber el-hammelech lemor
Adoni hammelech hereu haanashim haelle et kal-asher asu leyirmeyahu hannavi et asher-hishlichu el-habbor vayyamat tachtav mippene haraav ki en hallechem od bair
Vayetzave hammelech et eved-melech hakkushi lemor kach beyadcha mizze sheloshim anashim vehaalita et-yirmeyahu hannavi min-habbor beterem yamut
Vayyikkach eved-melech et-haanashim beyado vayyavo vet-hammelech el-tachat haotzar vayyikkach mishsham beloye sechavot uvloye melachim vayeshallechem el-yirmeyahu el-habbor bachavalim
Vayyomer eved-melech hakkushi el-yirmeyahu sim na beloe hassechavot vehammelachim tachat atztzilot yadecha mittachat lachavalim vayyaas yirmeyahu ken
Vayyimshechu et-yirmeyahu bachavalim vayyaalu oto min-habbor vayyeshev yirmeyahu bachatzar hammattara
Vayyishlach hammelech tzidkiyyahu vayyikkach et-yirmeyahu hannavi elav el-mavo hashshelishi asher bevet Adonai vayyomer hammelech el-yirmeyahu shoel ani otcha davar al-techached mimmenni davar
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-tzidkiyyahu ki aggid lecha halo hamet temiteni vechi iatzcha lo tishma elay
Vayyishshava hammelech tzidkiyyahu el-yirmeyahu basseter lemor chay-Adonai t asher asa-lanu et-hannefesh hazzot im-amitecha veim-ettencha beyad haanashim haelle asher mevakshim et-nafshecha
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-tzidkiyyahu ko-amar Adonai elohe tzevaot elohe yisrael im-yatzo tetze el-sare melech-bavel vechayeta nafshecha vehair hazzot lo tissaref baesh vechayita atta uvetecha
Veim lo-tetze el-sare melech bavel venittena hair hazzot beyad hakkasdim usrafuha baesh veatta lo-timmalet miyyadam
Vayyomer hammelech tzidkiyyahu el-yirmeyahu ani doeg et-hayehudim asher naflu el-hakkasdim pen-yittenu oti beyadam vehitallelu-vi
Vayyomer yirmeyahu lo yittenu shema-na bekol Adonai laasher ani dover elecha veyitav lecha utchi nafshecha
Veim-maen atta latzet ze haddavar asher hirani Adonai
Vehinne chal-hannashim asher nisharu bevet melech-yehuda mutzaot el-sare melech bavel vehenna omrot hissitucha veyachlu lecha anshe shelomecha hatbeu vabbotz raglecha nasogu achor
Veet-kal-nashecha veet-banecha motziim el-hakkasdim veatta lo-timmalet miyyadam ki veyad melech-bavel tittafes veet-hair hazzot tisrof baesh
Vayyomer tzidkiyyahu el-yirmeyahu ish al-yeda baddevarim-haelle velo tamut
Vechi-yishmeu hassarim ki-dibbarti ittach uvau elecha veamru elecha haggida-na lanu ma-dibbarta el-hammelech al-techached mimmennu velo nemitecha uma-dibber elecha hammelech
Veamarta alehem mappil-ani techinnati lifne hammelech levilti hashiveni bet yehonatan lamut sham
Vayyavou chal-hassarim el-yirmeyahu vayyishalu oto vayyagged lahem kechal-haddevarim haelle asher tziva hammelech vayyacharishu mimmennu ki lo-nishma haddavar
Vayyeshev yirmeyahu bachatzar hammattara ad-yom asher-nilkeda yerushalam s vehaya kaasher nilkeda yerushalam
Bashshana hatteshiit letzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda bachodesh haasiri ba nevuchadretzar melech-bavel vechal-chelo el-yerushalam vayyatzuru aleha
Beashte-esre shana letzidkiyyahu bachodesh harvii betisha lachodesh havkea hair
Vayyavou kol sare melech-bavel vayyeshvu beshaar hattavech nergal sar-etzer samgar-nevu sar-sechim rav-saris nergal sar-etzer rav-mag vechal-sheerit sare melech bavel
Vayehi kaasher raam tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda vechol anshe hammilchama vayyivrechu vayyetzu layela min-hair derech gan hammelech beshaar ben hachomotayim vayyetze derech haarava
Vayyirdefu chel-kasdim acharehem vayyassigu et-tzidkiyyahu bearvot yerecho vayyikchu oto vayyaaluhu el-nevuchadretzar melech-bavel rivlata beeretz chamat vayedabber itto mishpatim
Vayyishchat melech bavel et-bene tzidkiyyahu berivla leenav veet kal-chore yehuda shachat melech bavel
Veet-ene tzidkiyyahu iver vayyaasrehu banchushtayim lavi oto bavela
Veet-bet hammelech veet-bet haam sarfu hakkasdim baesh veet-chomot yerushalam natatzu
Veet yeter haam hannisharim bair veet-hannoflim asher naflu alav veet yeter haam hannisharim hegla nevuzar-adan rav-tabbachim bavel
Umin-haam haddallim asher en-lahem meuma hishir nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim beeretz yehuda vayyitten lahem keramim vigevim bayyom hahu
Vayetzav nevuchadretzar melech-bavel al-yirmeyahu beyad nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim lemor
Kachennu veenecha sim alav veal-taas lo meuma ra ki m kaasher yedabber elecha ken ase immo
Vayyishlach nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim unvushazban rav-saris venergal sar-etzer rav-mag vechol rabbe melech-bavel
Vayyishlechu vayyikchu et-yirmeyahu mechatzar hammattara vayyittenu oto el-gedalyahu ben-achikam ben-shafan lehotziehu el-habbayit vayyeshev betoch haam
Veel-yirmeyahu haya devar-Adonai bihyoto atzur bachatzar hammattara lemor
Haloch veamarta leeved-melech hakkushi lemor ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni mevi et-devaray el-hair hazzot leraa velo letova vehau lefanecha bayyom hahu
Vehitztzalticha vayyom-hahu neum-Adonai velo tinnaten beyad haanashim asher-atta yagor mippenehem
Ki mallet amalletcha uvacherev lo tippol vehayeta lecha nafshecha leshalal ki-vatachta bi neum-Adonai
Haddavar asher-haya el-yirmeyahu meet Adonai achar shallach oto nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim min-harama bekachto oto vehu-asur bazikkim betoch kal-galut yerushalam vihuda hammuglim bavela
Vayyikkach rav-tabbachim leyirmeyahu vayyomer elav Adonai elohecha dibber et-haraa hazzot el-hammakom hazze
Vayyave vayyaas Adonai kaasher dibber ki-chatatem la-Adonai velo-shematem bekolo vehaya lachem haddavar hazze

Veatta hinne fittachticha hayyom min-hazikkim asher al-yadecha im-tov beenecha lavo itti vavel bo veasim et-eni alecha veim-ra beenecha lavo-itti vavel chadal ree kal-haaretz lefanecha el-tov veel-hayyashar beenecha lalechet shamma lech

Veodennu lo-yashuv veshuva el-gedalya ven-achikam ben-shafan asher hifkid melech-bavel beare yehuda veshev itto betoch haam o el-kal-hayyashar beenecha lalechet lech vayyitten-lo rav-tabbachim arucha umaset vayeshallechehu
Vayyavo yirmeyahu el-gedalya ven-achikam hammitzpata vayyeshev itto betoch haam hannisharim baaretz

Vayyishmeu chal-sare hachayalim asher bassade hemma veanshehem ki-hifkid melech-bavel et-gedalyahu ven-achikam baaretz vechi hifkid itto anashim venashim vataf umiddallat haaretz measher lo-haglu bavela
Vayyavou el-gedalya hammitzpata veyishmael ben-netanyahu veochanan veonatan bene-kareach usraya ven-tanchumet uvne efay hannetofati vizanyahu ben-hammaachati hemma veanshehem
Vayyishshava lahem gedalyahu ven-achikam ben-shafan ulanshehem lemor al-tiru meavod hakkasdim shevu vaaretz veivdu et-melech bavel veyitav lachem
Vaani hinni yoshev bammitzpa laamod lifne hakkasdim asher yavou elenu veattem isfu yayin vekayitz veshemen vesimu bichlechem ushvu bearechem asher-tefastem
Vegam kal-hayehudim asher-bemoav uvivne-ammon uveedom vaasher bechal-haaratzot shamu ki-natan melech-bavel sheerit lihuda vechi hifkid alehem et-gedalyahu ben-achikam ben-shafan
Vayyashuvu chal-hayehudim mikkal-hammekomot asher niddechu-sham vayyavou eretz-yehuda el-gedalyahu hammitzpata vayyaasfu yayin vakayitz harbe meod
Veochanan ben-kareach vechal-sare hachayalim asher bassade bau el-gedalyahu hammitzpata
Vayyomru elav hayadoa teda ki baalis melech bene-ammon shalach et-yishmael ben-netanya lehakkotcha nafesh velo-heemin lahem gedalyahu ben-achikam

Veochanan ben-kareach amar el-gedalyahu vasseter bammitzpa lemor elcha na veakke et-yishmael ben-netanya veish lo yeda lamma yakkekka nefesh venafotzu kal-yehuda hannikbatzim elecha veavda sheerit yehuda
Vayyomer gedalyahu ven-achikam el-yochanan ben-kareach taase et-haddavar hazze ki-sheker atta dover el-yishmael
Vayehi bachodesh hashshevii ba yishmael ben-netanya ven-elishama mizzera hammelucha verabbe hammelech vaasara anashim itto el-gedalyahu ven-achikam hammitzpata vayyochlu sham lechem yachdav bammitzpa
Vayyakam yishmael ben-netanya vaaseret haanashim asher-hau itto vayyakku et-gedalyahu ven-achikam ben-shafan bacherev vayyamet oto asher-hifkid melech-bavel baaretz
Veet kal-hayehudim asher-hau itto et-gedalyahu bammitzpa veet-hakkasdim asher nimtzeu-sham et anshe hammilchama hikka yishmael
Vayehi bayyom hashsheni lehamit et-gedalyahu veish lo yada
Vayyavou anashim mishshechem mishshilo umishshomron shemonim ish megulleche zakan ukrue vegadim umitgoddim umincha ulvona beyadam lehavi bet Adonai
Vayyetze yishmael ben-netanya likratam min-hammitzpa holech haloch uvoche vayehi kifgosh otam vayyomer alehem bou el-gedalyahu ven-achikam
Vayehi kevoam el-toch hair vayyishchatem yishmael ben-netanya el-toch habbor hu vehaanashim asher-itto
Vaasara anashim nimtzeu-vam vayyomru el-yishmael al-temitenu ki-yesh-lanu matmonim bassade chittim usorim veshemen udvash vayyechdal velo hemitam betoch achehem
Vehabbor asher hishlich sham yishmael et kal-pigre haanashim asher hikka beyad-gedalyahu hu asher asa hammelech asa mippene basha melech-yisrael oto mille yishmael ben-netanyahu chalalim

Vayyishbe yishmael et-kal-sheerit haam asher bammitzpa et-benot hammelech veet-kal-haam hannisharim bammitzpa asher hifkid nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim et-gedalyahu ben-achikam vayyishbem yishmael ben-netanya vayyelech laavor el-bene ammon
Vayyishma yochanan ben-kareach vechal-sare hachayalim asher itto et kal-haraa asher asa yishmael ben-netanya
Vayyikchu et-kal-haanashim vayyelchu lehillachem im-yishmael ben-netanya vayyimtzeu oto el-mayim rabbim asher begivon
Vayehi kirot kal-haam asher et-yishmael et-yochanan ben-kareach veet kal-sare hachayalim asher itto vayyismachu
Vayyasobbu kal-haam asher-shava yishmael min-hammitzpa vayyashuvu vayyelchu el-yochanan ben-kareach
Veyishmael ben-netanya nimlat bishmona anashim mippene yochanan vayyelech el-bene ammon

Vayyikkach yochanan ben-kareach vechal-sare hachayalim asher-itto et kal-sheerit haam asher heshiv meet yishmael ben-netanya min-hammitzpa achar hikka et-gedalya ben-achikam gevarim anshe hammilchama venashim vetaf vesarisim asher heshiv miggivon
Vayyelchu vayyeshvu begerut kimham asher-etzel bet lachem lalechet lavo mitzrayim
Mippene hakkasdim ki yaru mippenehem ki-hikka yishmael ben-netanya et-gedalyahu ben-achikam asher-hifkid melech-bavel baaretz
Vayyiggeshu kal-sare hachayalim veochanan ben-kareach vizanya ben-hoshaya vechal-haam mikkaton vead-gadol
Vayyomru el-yirmeyahu hannavi tippal-na techinnatenu lefanecha vehitpallel baadenu el-Adonai elohecha bead kal-hashsheerit hazzot ki-nisharnu meat meharbe kaasher enecha root otanu
Veyagged-lanu Adonai elohecha et-hadderech asher nelech-bah veet-haddavar asher naase
Vayyomer alehem yirmeyahu hannavi shamati hinni mitpallel el-Adonai elohechem kedivrechem vehaya kal-haddavar asher-yaane Adonai etchem aggid lachem lo-emna mikkem davar
Vehemma amru el-yirmeyahu yehi Adonai banu leed emet veneeman im-lo kechal-haddavar asher yishlachacha Adonai elohecha elenu ken naase
Im-tov veim-ra bekol Adonai elohenu asher anachnu sholchim otcha elav nishma lemaan asher yitav-lanu ki nishma bekol Adonai elohenu
Vayehi mikketz aseret yamim vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu
Vayyikra el-yochanan ben-kareach veel kal-sare hachayalim asher itto ulchal-haam lemikkaton vead-gadol
Vayyomer alehem ko-amar Adonai elohe yisrael asher shelachtem oti elav lehappil techinnatchem lefanav
Im-shov teshvu baaretz hazzot uvaniti etchem velo eheros venatati etchem velo ettosh ki nichamti el-haraa asher asiti lachem
Al-tiru mippene melech bavel asher-attem yereim mippanav al-tiru mimmennu neum-Adonai ki-ittechem ani lehoshia etchem ulhatztzil etchem miyyado
Veetten lachem rachamim vericham etchem veheshiv etchem el-admatchem
Veim-omrim attem lo neshev baaretz hazzot levilti shemoa bekol Adonai elohechem
Lemor lo ki eretz mitzrayim navo asher lo-nire milchama vekol shofar lo nishma velallechem lo-nirav vesham neshev
Veatta lachen shimu devar-Adonai sheerit yehuda ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael im-attem som tesimun penechem lavo mitzrayim uvatem lagur sham
Vehayeta hacherev asher attem yereim mimmenna sham tassig etchem beeretz mitzrayim veharaav asher-attem doagim mimmennu sham yidbak acharechem mitzrayim vesham tamutu
Veyihu chal-haanashim asher-samu et-penehem lavo mitzrayim lagur sham yamutu bacherev baraav uvaddaver velo-yihye lahem sarid ufalit mippene haraa asher ani mevi alehem

Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael kaasher nittach appi vachamati al-yoshve yerushalam ken tittach chamati alechem bevoachem mitzrayim vihyitem leala ulshamma veliklala ulcherpa velo-tiru od et-hammakom hazze
Dibber Adonai alechem sheerit yehuda al-tavou mitzrayim yadoa tedu ki-haidoti vachem hayyom
Ki hitetem benafshotechem ki-attem shelachtem oti el-Adonai elohechem lemor hitpallel baadenu el-Adonai elohenu uchchol asher yomar Adonai elohenu ken hagged-lanu veasinu
Vaaggid lachem hayyom velo shematem bekol Adonai elohechem ulchol asher-shelachani alechem
Veatta yadoa tedu ki bacherev baraav uvaddever tamutu bammakom asher chafatztem lavo lagur sham
Vayehi kechallot yirmeyahu ledabber el-kal-haam et-kal-divre Adonai elohehem asher shelacho Adonai elohehem alehem et kal-haddevarim haelle
Vayyomer azarya ven-hoshaya veochanan ben-kareach vechal-haanashim hazzedim omrim el-yirmeyahu sheker atta medabber lo shelachacha Adonai elohenu lemor lo-tavou mitzrayim lagur sham
Ki baruch ben-neriyya massit otcha banu lemaan tet otanu veyad-hakkasdim lehamit otanu ulhaglot otanu bavel
Velo-shama yochanan ben-kareach vechal-sare hachayalim vechal-haam bekol Adonai lashevet beeretz yehuda
Vayyikkach yochanan ben-kareach vechal-sare hachayalim et kal-sheerit yehuda asher-shavu mikkal-haggoyim asher niddechu-sham lagur beeretz yehuda

Et-haggevarim veet-hannashim veet-hattaf veet-benot hammelech veet kal-hannefesh asher hinniach nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim et-gedalyahu ben-achikam ben-shafan veet yirmeyahu hannavi veet-baruch ben-neriyyahu
Vayyavou eretz mitzrayim ki lo shamu bekol Adonai vayyavou ad-tachpanches
Vayehi devar-Adonai el-yirmeyahu betachpanches lemor
Kach beyadcha avanim gedolot utmantam bammelet bammalben asher befetach bet-paro betachpanches leene anashim yehudim
Veamarta alehem ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni sholeach velakachti et-nevuchadretzar melech-bavel avdi vesamti chiso mimmaal laavanim haelle asher tamanti venata shafriro alehem
Uva vehikka et-eretz mitzrayim asher lammavet lammavet vaasher lashshevi lashshevi vaasher lacherev lecharev
Vehitztzatti esh bevatte elohe mitzrayim usrafam veshavam veata et-eretz mitzrayim kaasher-yate haroe et-bigdo veyatza mishsham beshalom
Veshibbar et-matztzevot bet shemesh asher beeretz mitzrayim veet-batte elohe-mitzrayim yisrof baesh
Haddavar asher haya el-yirmeyahu el kal-hayehudim hayyoshvim beeretz mitzrayim hayyoshvim bemigdol uvtachpanches uvnof uveretz patros lemor
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael attem reitem et kal-haraa asher heveti al-yerushalam veal kal-are yehuda vehinnam charba hayyom hazze veen bahem yoshev
Mippene raatam asher asu lehachiseni lalechet lekatter laavod lelohim acherim asher lo yedaum hemma attem vaavotechem
Vaeshlach alechem et-kal-avaday hanneviim hashkem veshaloach lemor al-na taasu et devar-hattoeva hazzot asher saneti
Velo shamu velo-hittu et-aznam lashuv meraatam levilti katter lelohim acherim
Vattittach chamati veappi vattivar beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalam vattihyena lecharba lishmama kayyom hazze
Veatta ko-amar Adonai elohe tzevaot elohe yisrael lama attem osim raa gedola el-nafshotechem lehachrit lachem ish-veishsha olel veonek mittoch yehuda levilti hotir lachem sheerit
Lehachiseni bemaase yedechem lekatter lelohim acherim beeretz mitzrayim asher-attem baim lagur sham lemaan hachrit lachem ulmaan heotchem liklala ulcherpa bechol goye haaretz
Hashchachtem et-raot avotechem veet-raot malche yehuda veet raot nashav veet raotechem veet raot neshechem asher asu beeretz yehuda uvchutzot yerushalam
Lo dukkeu ad hayyom hazze velo yaru velo-halchu vetorati uvchukkotay asher-natatti lifnechem velifne avotechem
Lachen ko-amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael hinni sam panay bachem leraa ulhachrit et-kal-yehuda

Velakachti et-sheerit yehuda asher-samu fenehem lavo eretz-mitzrayim lagur sham vetammu chol beeretz mitzrayim yippolu bacherev baraav yittammu mikkaton vead-gadol bacherev uvaraav yamutu vehau leala leshamma veliklala ulcherpa
Ufakadti al hayyoshvim beeretz mitzrayim kaasher pakadti al-yerushalam bacherev baraav uvaddaver
Velo yihye palit vesarid lisherit yehuda habbaim lagur-sham beeretz mitzrayim velashuv eretz yehuda asher-hemma menasseim et-nafsham lashuv lashevet sham ki lo-yashuvu ki im-peletim
Vayyaanu et-yirmeyahu kal-haanashim hayyodim ki-mekatterot neshehem lelohim acherim vechal-hannashim haomdot kahal gadol vechal-haam hayyoshvim beeretz-mitzrayim befatros lemor
Haddavar asher-dibbarta elenu beshem Adonai enennu shomim elecha

Ki aso naase et-kal-haddavar asher-yatza mippinu lekatter limlechet hashshamayim vehassech-lah nesachim kaasher asinu anachnu vaavotenu melachenu vesarenu beare yehuda uvchutzot yerushalam vannisba-lechem vannihye tovim veraa lo rainu
Umin-az chadalnu lekatter limlechet hashshamayim vehassech-lah nesachim chasarnu chol uvacherev uvaraav tamnu
Vechi-anachnu mekatterim limlechet hashshamayim ulhassech lah nesachim hamibbalade anashenu asinu lah kavanim lehaatziva vehassech lah nesachim
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-kal-haam al-haggevarim veal-hannashim veal-kal-haam haonim oto davar lemor
