Pitom nafla vavel vattishshaver helilu aleha kechu tzori lemachovah ulay terafe
Rippinu et-bavel velo nirpata izvuha venelech ish leartzo ki-naga el-hashshamayim mishpatah venissa ad-shechakim
Hotzi Adonai et-tzidkotenu bou unsappera vetziyyon et-maase Adonai elohenu
Haveru hachitztzim milu hashshelatim heir Adonai et-ruach malche maday ki-al-bavel mezimmato lehashchitah ki-nikmat Adonai hi nikmat hechalo
El-chomot bavel seu-nes hachaziku hammishmar hakimu shomrim hachinu haorvim ki gam-zamam Adonai gam-asa et asher-dibber el-yoshve vavel
Shochante al-mayim rabbim rabbat otzarot ba kitztzech ammat bitzech
Nishba Adonai tzevaot benafsho ki im-milletich adam kayyelek veanu alayich hedad
Ose eretz bechocho mechin tevel bechachmato uvitvunato nata shamayim
Lekol titto hamon mayim bashshamayim vayyaal nesiim miktze-aretz berakim lammatar asa vayyotze ruach meotzrotav
Nivar kal-adam middaat hovish kal-tzoref mippasel ki sheker nisko velo-ruach bam
Hevel hemma maase tatuim beet pekuddatam yovedu
Lo-cheelle chelek yaakov ki-yotzer hakkol hu veshevet nachalato Adonai tzevaot shemo
Mappetz-atta li kele milchama venippatzti vecha goyim vehishchatti vecha mamlachot
Venippatzti vecha sus verochvo venippatzti vecha rechev verochvo
Venippatzti vecha ish veishsha venippatzti vecha zaken vanaar venippatzti vecha bachur uvtula
Venippatzti vecha roe veedro venippatzti vecha ikkar vetzimdo venippatzti vecha pachot usganim
Veshillamti levavel ulchol yoshve chasdim et kal-raatam asher-asu vetziyyon leenechem neum Adonai
Hinni elecha har hammashchit neum-Adonai hammashchit et-kal-haaretz venatiti et-yadi alecha vegilgalticha min-hasselaim untatticha lehar serefa
Velo-yikchu mimmecha even lefinna veeven lemosadot ki-shimmot olam tihye neum-Adonai
Seu-nes baaretz tiku shofar baggoyim kaddeshu aleha goyim hashmiu aleha mamlechot ararat minni veashkenaz pikdu aleha tifsar haalu-sus keyelek samar
Kaddeshu aleha goyim et-malche maday et-pachoteha veet-kal-seganeha veet kal-eretz memshalto
Vattirash haaretz vattachol ki kama al-bavel machshevot Adonai lasum et-eretz bavel leshamma meen yoshev
Chadlu gibbore vavel lehillachem yashvu bammetzadot nashta gevuratam hau lenashim hitztzitu mishkenoteha nishberu vericheha
Ratz likrat-ratz yarutz umaggid likrat maggid lehaggid lemelech bavel ki-nilkeda iro mikkatze
Vehammabarot nitpasu veet-haagammim sarfu vaesh veanshe hammilchama nivhalu
Ki cho amar Adonai tzevaot elohe yisrael bat-bavel kegoren et hidrichah od meat uvaa et-hakkatzir lah
Achalani hamamani nevuchadretzar melech bavel hitztzigani keli rik belaani kattannin milla chereso meadanay hedichani
Chamasi usheri al-bavel tomar yoshevet tziyyon vedami el-yoshve chasdim tomar yerushalam
Lachen ko amar Adonai hinni-rav et-rivech venikkamti et-nikmatech vehacharavti et-yammah vehovashti et-mekorah
Vehayeta vavel legallim meon-tannim shamma ushreka meen yoshev
Yachdav kakkefirim yishagu naaru kegore araot
Bechummam ashit et-mishtehem vehishkartim lemaan yaalozu veyashnu shenat-olam velo yakitzu neum Adonai
Oridem kecharim litvoach keelim im-attudim
Ech nilkeda sheshach vattittafes tehillat kal-haaretz ech hayeta leshamma bavel baggoyim
Ala al-bavel hayyam bahamon gallav nichsata
Hau areha leshamma eretz tziyya vaarava eretz lo-yeshev bahen kal-ish velo-yaavor bahen ben-adam
Ufakadti al-bel bevavel vehotzeti et-bilo mippiv velo-yinharu elav od goyim gam-chomat bavel nafala
Tzeu mittochah ammi umalletu ish et-nafsho mecharon af-Adonai
Ufen-yerach levavchem vetiru bashshemua hannishmaat baaretz uva vashshana hashshemua veacharav bashshana hashshemua vechamas baaretz umoshel al-moshel
Lachen hinne yamim baim ufakadti al-pesile vavel vechal-artzah tevosh vechal-chalaleha yippelu vetochah
Verinnenu al-bavel shamayim vaaretz vechol asher bahem ki mitztzafon yavo-lah hashshoddim neum-Adonai
Gam-bavel linpol challe yisrael gam-levavel naflu challe chal-haaretz
Peletim mecherev hilchu al-taamodu zichru merachok et-Adonai virushalam taale al-levavchem
Boshnu ki-shamanu cherpa kisseta chelimma panenu ki bau zarim al-mikdeshe bet Adonai
Lachen hinne-yamim baim neum-Adonai ufakadti al-pesileha uvchal-artzah yeenok chalal
Ki-taale vavel hashshamayim vechi tevatztzer merom uzzah meitti yavou shoddim lah neum-Adonai
Kol zeaka mibbavel veshever gadol meeretz kasdim
Ki-shoded Adonai et-bavel veibbad mimmenna kol gadol vehamu gallehem kemayim rabbim nittan sheon kolam
Ki va aleha al-bavel shoded venilkedu gibboreha chitteta kashshetotam ki el gemulot Adonai shallem yeshallem
Vehishkarti sareha vachachameha pachoteha usganeha vegibboreha veyashnu shenat-olam velo yakitzu neum-hammelech Adonai tzevaot shemo
Ko-amar Adonai tzevaot chomot bavel harchava arer titarar ushareha haggevohim baesh yitztzattu veyigu ammim bede-rik ulummim bede-esh veyaefu
Haddavar asher-tziva yirmeyahu hannavi et-seraya ven-neriyya ben-machseya belechto et-tzidkiyyahu melech-yehuda bavel bishnat harviit lemalcho usraya sar menucha
Vayyichtov yirmeyahu et kal-haraa asher-tavo el-bavel el-sefer echad et kal-haddevarim haelle hakketuvim el-bavel
Vayyomer yirmeyahu el-seraya kevoacha vavel veraita vekarata et kal-haddevarim haelle
Veamarta Adonai atta dibbarta el-hammakom hazze lehachrito levilti heot-bo yoshev lemeadam vead-behema ki-shimmot olam tihye
Vehaya kechallotcha likro et-hassefer hazze tikshor alav even vehishlachto el-toch perat
Veamarta kacha tishka bavel velo-takum mippene haraa asher anochi mevi aleha veyaefu ad-henna divre yirmeyahu
Ben-esrim veachat shana tzidkiyyahu vemalcho veachat esre shana malach birushalam veshem immo chamutal bat-yirmeyahu millivna
Vayyaas hara beene Adonai kechol asher-asa yehoyakim
Ki al-af Adonai hayeta birushalam vihuda ad-hishlicho otam meal panav vayyimrod tzidkiyyahu bemelech bavel
Vayehi vashshana hatteshiit lemalcho bachodesh haasiri beasor lachodesh ba nevuchadretzar melech-bavel hu vechal-chelo al-yerushalam vayyachanu aleha vayyivnu aleha dayek saviv
Vattavo hair bammatzor ad ashte esre shana lammelech tzidkiyyahu
Bachodesh harvii betisha lachodesh vayyechezak haraav bair velo-haya lechem leam haaretz
Vattibbaka hair vechal-anshe hammilchama yivrechu vayyetzu mehair layela derech shaar ben-hachomotayim asher al-gan hammelech vechasdim al-hair saviv vayyelchu derech haarava
Vayyirdefu chel-kasdim achare hammelech vayyassigu et-tzidkiyyahu bearvot yerecho vechal-chelo nafotzu mealav
Vayyitpesu et-hammelech vayyaalu oto el-melech bavel rivlata beeretz chamat vayedabber itto mishpatim
Vayyishchat melech-bavel et-bene tzidkiyyahu leenav vegam et-kal-sare yehuda shachat berivlata
Veet-ene tzidkiyyahu iver vayyaasrehu vanchushtayim vayeviehu melech-bavel bavela vayyittenehu vvt-vet- happekuddot ad-yom moto
Uvachodesh hachamishi beasor lachodesh hi shenat tesha-esre shana lammelech nevuchadretzar melech-bavel ba nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim amad lifne melech-bavel birushalam
Vayyisrof et-bet-Adonai veet-bet hammelech veet kal-batte yerushalam veet-kal-bet haggadol saraf baesh
Veet-kal-chomot yerushalam saviv nattzu kal-chel kasdim asher et-rav-tabbachim
Umiddallot haam veet-yeter haam hannisharim bair veet-hannoflim asher naflu el-melech bavel veet yeter haamon hegla nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim
Umiddallot haaretz hishir nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim lechormim ulyogvim
Veet-ammude hannechoshet asher levet-Adonai veet-hammechonot veet-yam hannechoshet asher bevet-Adonai shibberu chasdim vayyisu et-kal-nechushtam bavela
Veet-hassirot veet-hayyaim veet-hamzammerot veet-hammizrakot veet-hakkappot veet kal-kele hannechoshet asher-yeshartu vahem lakachu
Veet-hassippim veet-hammachtot veet-hammizrakot veet-hassirot veet-hammenorot veet-hakkappot veet-hammenakiot asher zahav zahav vaasher-kesef kasef lakach rav-tabbachim
Haammudim shenayim hayyam echad vehabbakar shenem-asar nechoshet asher-tachat hammechonot asher asa hammelech shelomo levet Adonai lo-haya mishkal linchushtam kal-hakkelim haelle
Vehaammudim shemone esre amma komat haammud haechad vechut shettem-esre amma yesubbennu veavo arba atzbaot navuv
Vechoteret alav nechoshet vekomat hakkoteret haachat chamesh ammot usvacha verimmonim al-hakkoteret saviv hakkol nechoshet vechaelle laammud hashsheni verimmonim
Vayyihu harimmonim tishim veshishsha rucha kal-harimmonim mea al-hassevacha saviv
Vayyikkach rav-tabbachim et-seraya kohen harosh veet-tzefanya kohen hammishne veet-sheloshet shomre hassaf

Umin-hair lakach saris echad asher-haya fakid al-anshe hammilchama veshiva anashim meroe fene-hammelech asher nimtzeu vair veet sofer sar hatztzava hammatzbi et-am haaretz veshishshim ish meam haaretz hannimtzeim betoch hair
Vayyikkach otam nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim vayyolech otam el-melech bavel rivlata
Vayyakke otam melech bavel vayemitem berivla beeretz chamat vayyigel yehuda meal admato
Ze haam asher hegla nevuchadretzar bishnat-sheva yehudim sheloshet alafim veesrim ushlosha
Bishnat shemone esre linvuchadretzar mirushalam nefesh shemone meot sheloshim ushnayim
Bishnat shalosh veesrim linvuchadretzar hegla nevuzaradan rav-tabbachim yehudim nefesh sheva meot arbaim vachamishsha kal-nefesh arbaat alafim veshesh meot

Vayehi vishloshim vasheva shana legalut yehoyachin melech-yehuda bishnem asar chodesh beesrim vachamishsha lachodesh nasa evil merodach melech bavel bishnat malchuto et-rosh yehoyachin melech-yehuda vayyotze oto mibbet hakkelu
Vayedabber itto tovot vayyitten et-kiso mimmaal lechisse hammelachim asher itto bevavel
Veshinna et bigde chilo veachal lechem lefanav tamid kal-yeme chayyav
Vaaruchato aruchat tamid nittena-lo meet melech-bavel devar-yom beomo ad-yom moto kol yeme chayyav
Ezekiel: Vayehi bishloshim shana barvii bachamishsha lachodesh vaani vetoch-haggola al-nehar-kevar niftechu hashshamayim vaere marot elohim
Bachamishsha lachodesh hi hashshana hachamishit legalut hammelech yoyachin
Hayo haya devar-Adonai el-yechezkel ben-buzi hakkohen beeretz kasdim al-nehar-kevar vattehi alav sham yad-Adonai
Vaere vehinne ruach seara baa min-hatztzafon anan gadol veesh mitlakkachat venogah lo saviv umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh
Umittochah demut arba chayyot veze marehen demut adam lahenna
Vearbaa fanim leechat vearba kenafayim leachat lahem
Veraglehem regel yeshara vechaf raglehem kechaf regel egel venotztzim keen nechoshet kalal
Vide adam mittachat kanfehem al arbaat rivehem ufnehem vechanfehem learbatam
Chovrot ishsha el-achotah kanfehem lo-yissabbu velechtan ish el-ever panav yelechu
Udmut penehem pene adam ufne arye el-hayyamin learbatam ufne-shor mehassemol learbatan ufne-nesher learbatan
Ufnehem vechanfehem perudot milmala leish shettayim chovrot ish ushtayim mechassot et geviyotehena
Veish el-ever panav yelechu el asher yihye-shamma haruach lalechet yelechu lo yissabbu belechtan
Udmut hachayyot marehem kegachale-esh boarot kemare hallappidim hi mithallechet ben hachayyot venogah laesh umin-haesh yotze varak
Vehachayyot ratzo vashov kemare habbazak
Vaere hachayyot vehinne ofan echad baaretz etzel hachayyot learbaat panav
Mare haofannim umaasehem keen tarshish udmut echad learbatan umarehem umaasehem kaasher yihye haofan betoch haofan
Al-arbaat rivehen belechtam yelechu lo yissabbu belechtan
Vegabbehen vegovah lahem veyira lahem vegabbotam meleot enayim saviv learbatan
Uvlechet hachayyot yelchu haofannim etzlam uvhinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim
Al asher yihye-sham haruach lalechet yelechu shamma haruach lalechet vehaofannim yinnasu leummatam ki ruach hachayya baofannim
Belechtam yelechu uvamdam yaamodu uvhinnasam meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim leummatam ki ruach hachayya baofannim
Udmut al-rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora natuy al-rashehem milmala
Vetachat harakia kanfehem yesharot ishsha el-achotah leish shettayim mechassot lahenna ulish shettayim mechassot lahenna et geviyyotehem
Vaeshma et-kol kanfehem kekol mayim rabbim kekol-shadday belechtam kol hamulla kekol machane beamdam terappena chanfehen
Vayehi-kol meal larakia asher al-rosham beamdam terappena chanfehen
Umimmaal larakia asher al-rosham kemare even-sappir demut kisse veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav milmala
Vaere keen chashmal kemare-esh bet-lah saviv mimmare matnav ulmala umimmare matnav ulmatta raiti kemare-esh venogah lo saviv
Kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beom haggeshem ken mare hannogah saviv hu mare demut kevod-Adonai vaere vaeppol al-panay vaeshma kol medabber
Vayyomer elay ben-adam amod al-raglecha vaadabber otach
Vattavo vi ruach kaasher dibber elay vattaamideni al-raglay vaeshma et middabber elay
Vayyomer elay ben-adam sholeach ani otcha el-bene yisrael el-goyim hammordim asher mardu-vi hemma vaavotam pashu vi ad-etzem hayyom hazze
Vehabbanim keshe fanim vechizke-lev ani sholeach otcha alehem veamarta alehem ko amar adonay Adonai
Vehemma im-yishmeu veim-yechdalu ki bet meri hemma veyadu ki navi haya vetocham
Veatta ven-adam al-tira mehem umiddivrehem al-tira ki saravim vesallonim otach veel-akrabbim atta yoshev middivrehem al-tira umippenehem al-techat ki bet meri hemma
Vedibbarta et-devaray alehem im-yishmeu veim-yechdalu ki meri hemma
Veatta ven-adam shema et asher-ani medabber elecha al-tehi-meri kevet hammeri petze ficha veechol et asher-ani noten elecha
Vaere vehinne-yad shelucha elay vehinne-vo megillat-sefer
Vayyifros otah lefanay vehi chetuva panim veachor vechatuv eleha kinim vahege vahi
Vayyomer elay ben-adam et asher-timtza echol echol et-hammegilla hazzot velech dabber el-bet yisrael
Vaeftach et-pi vayyaachileni et hammegilla hazzot
Vayyomer elay ben-adam bitnecha taachel umeecha temalle et hammegilla hazzot asher ani noten elecha vaochla vattehi befi kidvash lematok
Vayyomer elay ben-adam lech-bo el-bet yisrael vedibbarta vidvaray alehem
Ki lo el-am imke safa vechivde lashon atta shaluach el-bet yisrael
Lo el-ammim rabbim imke safa vechivde lashon asher lo-tishma divrehem im-lo alehem shelachticha hemma yishmeu elecha
Uvet yisrael lo yovu lishmoa elecha ki-enam ovim lishmoa elay ki kal-bet yisrael chizke-metzach ukshe-lev hemma
Hinne natatti et-panecha chazakim leummat penehem veet-mitzchacha chazak leummat mitzcham
Keshamir chazak mitztzor natatti mitzchecha lo-tira otam velo-techat mippenehem ki bet-meri hemma
Vayyomer elay ben-adam et-kal-devaray asher adabber elecha kach bilvavcha uvaznecha shema
Velech bo el-haggola el-bene ammecha vedibbarta alehem veamarta alehem ko amar adonay Adonai im-yishmeu veim-yechdalu
Vattissaeni ruach vaeshma acharay kol raash gadol baruch kevod-Adonai mimmekomo
Vekol kanfe hachayyot mashshikot ishsha el-achotah vekol haofannim leummatam vekol raash gadol
Veruach nesaatni vattikkacheni vaelech mar bachamat ruchi veyad-Adonai alay chazaka
Vaavo el-haggola tel aviv hayyoshvim el-nehar-kevar vaeshev hemma yoshvim sham vaeshev sham shivat yamim mashmim betocham
Vayehi miktze shivat yamim f vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor
Ben-adam tzofe netatticha levet yisrael veshamata mippi davar vehizharta otam mimmenni
Beamri larasha mot tamut velo hizharto velo dibbarta lehazhir rasha middarko harshaa lechayyoto hu rasha baaono yamut vedamo miyyadcha avakkesh
Veatta ki-hizharta rasha velo-shav merisho umiddarko harshaa hu baaono yamut veatta et-nafshecha hitztzalta
Uvshuv tzaddik mitztzidko veasa avel venatatti michshol lefanav hu yamut ki lo hizharto bechattato yamut velo tizzacharna tzidkotav asher asa vedamo miyyadcha avakkesh
Veatta ki hizharto tzaddik levilti chato tzaddik vehu lo-chata chao yichye ki nizhar veatta et-nafshecha hitztzalta
Vattehi alay sham yad-Adonai vayyomer elay kum tze el-habbika vesham adabber otach
Vaakum vaetze el-habbika vehinne-sham kevod-Adonai omed kakkavod asher raiti al-nehar-kevar vaeppol al-panay
Vattavo-vi ruach vattaamideni al-raglay vayedabber oti vayyomer elay bo hissager betoch betecha
Veatta ven-adam hinne natnu alecha avotim vaasarucha bahem velo tetze betocham
Ulshoncha adbik el-chikkecha veneelamta velo-tihye lahem leish mochiach ki bet meri hemma
Uvdabberi otcha eftach et-picha veamarta alehem ko amar adonay Adonai hashshomea yishma vehechadel yechdal ki bet meri hemma
Veatta ven-adam kach-lecha levena venatatta otah lefanecha vechakkota aleha ir et-yerushalam
Venatatta aleha matzor uvanita aleha dayek veshafachta aleha solla venatatta aleha machanot vesim-aleha karim saviv
Veatta kach-lecha machavat barzel venatatta otah kir barzel bencha uven hair vahachinota et-panecha eleha vehayeta vammatzor vetzarta aleha ot hi levet yisrael
Veatta shechav al-tziddecha hassemali vesamta et-aon bet-yisrael alav mispar hayyamim asher tishkav alav tissa et-aonam
Vaani natatti lecha et-shene aonam lemispar yamim shelosh-meot vetishim yom venasata aon bet-yisrael
Vechillita et-elle veshachavta al-tziddecha hayemani shenit venasata et-aon bet-yehuda arbaim yom yom lashshana yom lashshana netattiv lach
Veel-metzor yerushalam tachin panecha uzroacha chasufa venibbeta aleha
Vehinne natatti alecha avotim velo-tehafech mitztziddecha el-tziddecha ad-kallotcha yeme metzurecha

Veatta kach-lecha chittin usorim ufol vaadashim vedochan vechussemim venatatta otam bichli echad veasita otam lecha lelachem mispar hayyamim asher-atta shochev al-tziddecha shelosh-meot vetishim yom tochalennu
Umaachalcha asher tochalennu bemishkol esrim shekel layyom meet ad-et tochalennu
Umayim bimsura tishte shishshit hahin meet ad-et tishte
Veugat seorim tochalenna vehi begelle tzeat haadam teugena leenehem
Vayyomer Adonai kacha yochlu vene-yisrael et-lachmam tame baggoyim asher addichem sham
Vaomar ahah adonay Adonai hinne nafshi lo metummaa unvela utrefa lo-achalti minneuray vead-atta velo-va befi besar piggul
Vayyomer elay ree natatti lecha tzefie habbakar tachat gelle haadam veasita et-lachmecha alehem
Vayyomer elay ben-adam hinni shover matte-lechem birushalam veachlu-lechem bemishkal uvidaga umayim bimsura uvshimmamon yishtu
Lemaan yachseru lechem vamayim venashammu ish veachiv venamakku baaonam
Veatta ven-adam kach-lecha cherev chadda taar haggallavim tikkachenna lach vehaavarta al-roshcha veal-zekanecha velakachta lecha mozne mishkal vechillaktam
Shelishit baur tavir betoch hair kimlot yeme hammatzor velakachta et-hashshelishit takke vacherev sevivoteha vehashshelishit tizre laruach vecherev arik acharehem
Velakachta mishsham meat bemispar vetzarta otam bichnafecha
Umehem od tikkach vehishlachta otam el-toch haesh vesarafta otam baesh mimmennu tetze-esh el-kal-bet yisrael
Ko amar adonay Adonai zot yerushalam betoch haggoyim samtiha usvivoteha aratzot
Vattemer et-mishpatay lerisha min-haggoyim veet-chukkotay min-haaratzot asher sevivoteha ki vemishpatay maasu vechukkotay lo-halchu vahem
Lachen ko-amar adonay Adonai yaan hamanchem min-haggoyim asher sevivotechem bechukkotay lo halachtem veet-mishpatay lo asitem uchmishpete haggoyim asher sevivotechem lo asitem
Lachen ko amar adonay Adonai hinni alayich gam-ani veasiti vetochech mishpatim leene haggoyim
Veasiti vach et asher lo-asiti veet asher-lo-eese chamohu od yaan kal-toavotayich
Lachen avot yochlu vanim betochech uvanim yochlu avotam veasiti vach shefatim vezeriti et-kal-sheeritech lechal-ruach
Lachen chay-ani neum adonay Adonai im-lo yaan et-mikdashi timmet bechal-shikkutzayich uvchal-toavotayich vegam-ani egra velo-tachos eni vegam-ani lo echmol
Shelishitech baddever yamutu uvaraav yichlu vetochech vehashshelishit bacherev yippelu sevivotayich vehashshelishit lechal-ruach ezare vecherev arik acharehem
Vechala appi vahanichoti chamati bam vehinnechamti veyadu ki-ani Adonai dibbarti bekinati bechalloti chamati bam
Veettenech lecharba ulcherpa baggoyim asher sevivotayich leene kal-over

Vahakimoti lahem matta leshem velo-yihu od asufe raav baaretz velo-yisu od kelimmat haggoyim

Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor

Lachen hinnave al-admat yisrael veamarta leharim velaggevaot laafikim velaggeaot ko-amar adonay Adonai hinni vekinati uvachamati dibbarti yaan kelimmat goyim nesatem
Lachen ko amar adonay Adonai ani nasati et-yadi im-lo haggoyim asher lachem missaviv hemma kelimmatam yissau
Veattem hare yisrael anpechem tittenu uferyechem tisu leammi yisrael ki kervu lavo
Ki hinni alechem ufaniti alechem veneevadtem venizratem

Vehirbeti alechem adam uvhema veravu ufaru vehoshavti etchem kekadmotechem vehetivoti merishotechem vidatem ki-ani Adonai
Veholachti alechem adam et-ammi yisrael vireshucha vehayita lahem lenachala velo-tosif od leshakkelam
Ko amar adonay Adonai yaan omrim lachem ochelet adam atte umshakkelet goyayich hayit
Lachen adam lo-tochli od vegoyayich lo tchshly-teshakkeli- od neum adonay Adonai

Vayehi devar-Adonai elay lemor
Ben-adam bet yisrael yoshvim al-admatam vayetammeu otah bedarkam uvaalilotam ketumat hannidda hayeta darkam lefanay
Vaeshpoch chamati alehem al-haddam asher-shafchu al-haaretz uvgillulehem timmeuha
Vaafitz otam baggoyim vayyizzaru baaratzot kedarkam vechaalilotam shefattim
Vayyavo el-haggoyim asher-bau sham vayechallelu et-shem kadshi beemor lahem am-Adonai elle umeartzo yatzau
Vaechmol al-shem kadshi asher chilleluhu bet yisrael baggoyim asher-bau shamma
Lachen emor levet-yisrael ko amar adonay Adonai lo lemaanchem ani ose bet yisrael ki im-leshem-kadshi asher chillaltem baggoyim asher-batem sham
Vekiddashti et-shemi haggadol hamchullal baggoyim asher chillaltem betocham veyadu haggoyim ki-ani Adonai neum adonay Adonai behikkadshi vachem leenehem
Velakachti etchem min-haggoyim vekibbatzti etchem mikkal-haaratzot veheveti etchem el-admatchem
Vezarakti alechem mayim tehorim uthartem mikkol tumotechem umikkal-gillulechem ataher etchem
Venatatti lachem lev chadash veruach chadasha etten bekirbechem vahasiroti et-lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar
Veet-ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti et asher-bechukkay telechu umishpatay tishmeru vaasitem
Vishavtem baaretz asher natatti laavotechem vihyitem li leam veanochi ehye lachem lelohim
Vehoshati etchem mikkol tumotechem vekarati el-haddagan vehirbeti oto velo-etten alechem raav
Vehirbeti et-peri haetz utnuvat hassade lemaan asher lo tikchu od cherpat raav baggoyim
Uzchartem et-darchechem haraim umaallechem asher lo-tovim unkototem bifnechem al aonotechem veal toavotechem
Lo lemaanchem ani-ose neum adonay Adonai yivada lachem boshu vehikkalmu middarchechem bet yisrael
Ko amar adonay Adonai beom tahari etchem mikkol aonotechem vehoshavti et-hearim venivnu hechoravot
Vehaaretz hanneshamma teaved tachat asher hayeta shemama leene kal-over
Veamru haaretz hallezu hanneshamma hayeta kegan-eden vehearim hechorevot vehanshammot vehanneherasot betzurot yashavu
Veyadu haggoyim asher yishshaaru sevivotechem ki ani Adonai baniti hanneherasot natati hanneshamma ani Adonai dibbarti veasiti
Ko amar adonay Adonai od zot iddaresh levet-yisrael laasot lahem arbe otam katztzon adam

Vehallishka asher paneha derech hatztzafon lakkohanim shomre mishmeret hammizbeach hemma vene-tzadok hakkerevim mibbene-levi el-Adonai lesharto
Vayyamad et-hechatzer orech mea amma verochav mea amma merubbaat vehammizbeach lifne habbayit
Vayevieni el-ulam habbayit vayyamad el ulam chamesh ammot mippo vechamesh ammot mippo verochav hashshaar shalosh ammot mippo veshalosh ammot mippo
Orech haulam esrim amma verochav ashte esre amma uvammaalot asher yaalu elav veammudim el-haelim echad mippo veechad mippo
Vayevieni el-hahechal vayyamad et-haelim shesh-ammot rochav-mippo veshesh-ammot-rochav mippo rochav haohel
Verochav happetach eser ammot vechitfot happetach chamesh ammot mippo vechamesh ammot mippo vayyamad arko arbaim amma verochav esrim amma
Uva lifnima vayyamad el-happetach shettayim ammot vehappetach shesh ammot verochav happetach sheva ammot
Vayyamad et-arko esrim amma verochav esrim amma el-pene hahechal vayyomer elay ze kodesh hakkodashim
Vayyamad kir-habbayit shesh ammot verochav hatztzela arba ammot saviv saviv labbayit saviv
Vehatztzelaot tzela el-tzela shalosh ushloshim peamim uvaot bakkir asher-labbayit latztzelaot saviv saviv lihot achuzim velo-yihu achuzim bekir habbayit
Verachava venasva lemala lemala latztzelaot ki musav-habbayit lemala lemala saviv saviv labbayit al-ken rochav-labbayit lemala vechen hattachtona yaale al-haelona lattichona
Veraiti labbayit govah saviv saviv musdot hatztzelaot melo hakkane shesh ammot atztzila
Rochav hakkir asher-latztzela el-hachutz chamesh ammot vaasher munnach bet tzelaot asher labbayit
Uven halleshachot rochav esrim amma saviv labbayit saviv saviv
Ufetach hatztzela lammunnach petach echad derech hatztzafon ufetach echad laddarom verochav mekom hammunnach chamesh ammot saviv saviv
Vehabbinyan asher el-pene haggizra peat derech-hayyam rochav shivim amma vekir habbinyan chamesh-ammot rochav saviv saviv vearko tishim amma
Umadad et-habbayit orech mea amma vehaggizra vehabbinya vekiroteha orech mea amma
Verochav pene habbayit vehaggizra lakkadim mea amma
Umadad orech-habbinyan el-pene haggizra asher al-achareha veattikeha mippo umippo mea amma vehahechal happenimi veulamme hechatzer
Hassippim vehachallonim haatumot vehaattikim saviv lishlashtam neged hassaf sechif etz saviv saviv vehaaretz ad-hachallonot vehachallonot mechussot
Al-meal happetach vead-habbayit happenimi velachutz veel-kal-hakkir saviv saviv bappenimi uvachitzon middot
Veasuy keruvim vetimorim vetimora ben-keruv lichruv ushnayim panim lakkeruv
Ufne adam el-hattimora mippo ufne-chefir el-hattimora mippo asuy el-kal-habbayit saviv saviv
Mehaaretz ad-meal happetach hakkeruvim vehattimorim asuyim vekir hahechal
Hahechal mezuzat revua ufne hakkodesh hammare kammare
Hammizbeach etz shalosh ammot gavoha vearko shettayim-ammot umiktzootav lo vearko vekirotav etz vayedabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai
Ushtayim delatot lahechal velakkodesh
Ushtayim delatot laddelatot shettayim musabbot delatot shettayim ledelet echat ushte delatot laacheret
Vaasuya alehen el-daltot hahechal keruvim vetimorim kaasher asuyim lakkirot veav etz el-pene haulam mehachutz
Vechallonim atumot vetimorim mippo umippo el-kitfot haulam vetzalot habbayit vehaubbim
Vayyotzieni el-hechatzer hachitzona hadderech derech hatztzafon vayevieni el-hallishka asher neged haggizra vaasher-neged habbinyan el-hatztzafon
El-pene-orech ammot hammea petach hatztzafon veharochav chamishshim ammot
Neged haesrim asher lechatzer happenimi veneged ritzfa asher lechatzer hachitzona attik el-pene-attik bashshelishim
Velifne halleshachot mahalach eser ammot rochav el-happenimit derech amma echat ufitchehem latztzafon
Vehalleshachot haelonot ketzurot ki-yochlu attikim mehena mehattachtonot umehattichonot binyan
Ki meshullashot henna veen lahen ammudim keammude hachatzerot al-ken neetzal mehattachtonot umehattichonot mehaaretz
Vegader asher-lachutz leummat halleshachot derech hechatzer hachitzona el-pene halleshachot arko chamishshim amma
Ki-orech halleshachot asher lechatzer hachitzona chamishshim amma vehinne al-pene hahechal mea amma
Vmtcht umittachat halleshachot haelle hammevi mehakkadim bevoo lahenna mehechatzer hachitzona
Berochav geder hechatzer derech hakkadim el-pene haggizra veel-pene habbinyan leshachot
Vederech lifnehem kemare halleshachot asher derech hatztzafon kearkan ken rachban vechol motzaehen uchmishpetehen uchfitchehen
Uchfitche halleshachot asher derech haddarom petach berosh darech derech bifne haggederet hagina derech hakkadim bevoan

Vayyomer elay lishchot hatztzafon lishchot haddarom asher el-pene haggizra henna lishchot hakkodesh asher yochlu-sham hakkohanim asher-kerovim la-Adonai kadshe hakkodashim sham yannichu kadshe hakkodashim vehammincha vehachattat vehaasham ki hammakom kadosh
Bevoam hakkohanim velo-yetzu mehakkodesh el-hechatzer hachitzona vesham yannichu vigdehem asher-yeshartu vahen ki-kodesh henna velavshu begadim acherim vekarvu el-asher laam
Vechilla et-middot habbayit happenimi vehotziani derech hashshaar asher panav derech hakkadim umdado saviv saviv
Madad ruach hakkadim bikne hammidda meot kanim bikne hammidda saviv
Madad ruach hatztzafon chamesh-meot kanim bikne hammidda saviv
Et ruach haddarom madad chamesh-meot kanim bikne hammidda
Savav el-ruach hayyam madad chamesh-meot kanim bikne hammidda
Learba ruchot medado choma lo saviv saviv orech chamesh meot verochav chamesh meot lehavdil ben hakkodesh lechol
Vayyolicheni el-hashshaar shaar asher pone derech hakkadim
Vehinne kevod elohe yisrael ba midderech hakkadim vekolo kekol mayim rabbim vehaaretz heira mikkevodo
Uchmare hammare asher raiti kammare asher-raiti bevoi leshachet et-hair umarot kammare asher raiti el-nehar-kevar vaeppol el-panay
Uchvod Adonai ba el-habbayit derech shaar asher panav derech hakkadim
Vattissaeni ruach vattevieni el-hechatzer happenimi vehinne male chevod-Adonai habbayit
Vaeshma middabber elay mehabbayit veish haya omed etzli
Vayyomer elay ben-adam et-mekom kisi veet-mekom kappot raglay asher eshkan-sham betoch bene-yisrael leolam velo yetammeu od bet-yisrael shem kadshi hemma umalchehem biznutam uvfigre malchehem bamotam
Betittam sippam et-sippi umzuzatam etzel mezuzati vehakkir beni uvenehem vetimmeu et-shem kadshi betoavotam asher asu vaachal otam beappi
Atta yerachaku et-zenutam ufigre malchehem mimmenni veshachanti vetocham leolam
Atta ven-adam hagged et-bet-yisrael et-habbayit veyikkalmu meaonotehem umaddu et-tachnit

Veim-nichlemu mikkol asher-asu tzurat habbayit utchunato umotzaav umovaav vechal-tzurotav veet kal-chukkotav tzurotav torotav hoda otam uchtov leenehem veyishmeru et-kal-tzurato veet-kal-chukkotav veasu otam
Zot torat habbayit al-rosh hahar kal-gevulo saviv saviv kodesh kadashim hinne-zot torat habbayit
Veelle middot hammizbeach baammot amma amma vatofach vechek haamma veamma-rochav ugvulah el-sefatah saviv zeret haechad veze gav hammizbeach
Umechek haaretz ad-haazara hattachtona shettayim ammot verochav amma echat umehoazara hakketanna ad-haazara haggedola arba ammot verochav haamma
Vehaharel arba ammot umehaariel ulmala hakkeranot arba
Vehaariel shettem esre orech bishtem esre rochav ravua el arbaat revaav
Vehaazara arba esre orech bearba esre rochav el arbaat revaeha vehaggevul saviv otah chatzi haamma vehachek-lah amma saviv umaalotehu penot kadim
Vayyomer elay ben-adam ko amar adonay Adonai elle chukkot hammizbeach beom heasoto lehaalot alav ola velizrok alav dam
Venatatta el-hakkohanim halviyyim asher hem mizzera tzadok hakkerovim elay neum adonay Adonai lesharteni par ben-bakar lechattat
Velakachta middamo venatatta al-arba karnotav veel-arba pinnot haazara veel-haggevul saviv vechitteta oto vechippartahu
Velakachta et happar hachattat usrafo bemifkad habbayit michutz lammikdash
Uvayyom hashsheni takriv seir-izzim tamim lechattat vechitteu et-hammizbeach kaasher chitteu bappar
Bechallotcha mechatte takriv par ben-bakar tamim veayil min-hatztzon tamim
Vehikravtam lifne Adonai vehishlichu hakkohanim alehem melach veheelu otam ola la-Adonai
Shivat yamim taase seir-chattat layyom ufar ben-bakar veayil min-hatztzon temimim yaasu
Shivat yamim yechapperu et-hammizbeach vetiharu oto umilu yadav
Vichallu et-hayyamim s vehaya vayyom hashshemini vahala yaasu hakkohanim al-hammizbeach et-olotechem veet-shalmechem veratziti etchem neum adonay Adonai
Vayyashev oti derech shaar hammikdash hachitzon happone kadim vehu sagur
Vayyomer elay Adonai hashshaar hazze sagur yihye lo yippateach veish lo-yavo vo ki Adonai elohe-yisrael ba vo vehaya sagur
Et-hannasi nasi hu yeshev-bo leechal-lechem lifne Adonai midderech ulam hashshaar yavo umiddarko yetze
Vayevieni derech-shaar hatztzafon el-pene habbayit vaere vehinne male chevod-Adonai et-bet Adonai vaeppol el-panay
Vayyomer elay Adonai ben-adam sim libbecha ure veenecha uvaznecha shema et kal-asher ani medabber otach lechal-chukkot bet-Adonai torotav vesamta libbecha limvo habbayit bechol motzae hammikdash
Veamarta el-meri el-bet yisrael ko amar adonay Adonai rav-lachem mikkal-toavotechem bet yisrael
Bahaviachem bene-nechar arle-lev vearle vasar lihot bemikdashi lechallelo et-beti behakrivchem et-lachmi chelev vadam vayyaferu et-beriti el kal-toavotechem
Velo shemartem mishmeret kadashay vattesimun leshomre mishmarti bemikdashi lachem
Ko-amar adonay Adonai kal-ben-nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el-mikdashi lechal-ben-nechar asher betoch bene yisrael
Ki im-halviyyim asher rachaku mealay bitot yisrael asher tau mealay achare gillulehem venasu aonam
Vehau vemikdashi meshartim pekuddot el-shaare habbayit umshartim et-habbayit hemma yishchatu et-haola veet-hazzevach laam vehemma yaamdu lifnehem leshartam
Yaan asher yeshartu otam lifne gillulehem vehau levet-yisrael lemichshol aon al-ken nasati yadi alehem neum adonay Adonai venasu aonam
Velo-yiggeshu elay lechahen li velageshet al-kal-kadashay el-kadshe hakkedashim venasu kelimmatam vetoavotam asher asu
Venatatti otam shomre mishmeret habbayit lechol avodato ulchol asher yease bo
Vehakkohanim halviyyim bene tzadok asher shamru et-mishmeret mikdashi bitot bene-yisrael mealay hemma yikrevu elay lesharteni veamdu lefanay lehakriv li chelev vadam neum adonay Adonai
Hemma yavou el-mikdashi vehemma yikrevu el-shulchani lesharteni veshamru et-mishmarti
Vehaya bevoam el-shaare hechatzer happenimit bigde fishtim yilbashu velo-yaale alehem tzemer beshartam beshaare hechatzer happenimit vavayeta
Paare fishtim yihu al-rosham umichnese fishtim yihu al-matnehem lo yachgeru bayyaza

Uvtzetam el-hechatzer hachitzona el-hechatzer hachitzona el-haam yifshetu et-bigdehem asher-hemma meshartim bam vehinnichu otam belishchot hakkodesh velavshu begadim acherim velo-yekaddeshu et-haam bevigdehem
Verosham lo yegallechu ufera lo yeshallechu kasom yichsemu et-rashehem
Veyayin lo-yishtu kal-kohen bevoam el-hechatzer happenimit
Vealmana ugrusha lo-yikchu lahem lenashim ki im-betulot mizzera bet yisrael vehaalmana asher tihye almana mikkohen yikkachu
Veet-ammi yoru ben kodesh lechol uven-tame letahor yodium
Veal-riv hemma yaamdu lemishpat bemishpatay yishpetuhu veet-torotay veet-chukkotay bechal-moaday yishmoru veet-shabbetotay yekaddeshu
Veel-met adam lo yavo letama ki im-leav ulem ulven ulvat leach ulachot asher-lo-hayeta leish yittammau
Veachare tahorato shivat yamim yisperu-lo
Uvom boo el-hakkodesh el-hechatzer happenimit lesharet bakkodesh yakriv chattato neum adonay Adonai
Vehayeta lahem lenachala ani nachalatam vaachuzza lo-tittenu lahem beyisrael ani achuzzatam
Hammincha vehachattat vehaasham hemma yochlum vechal-cherem beyisrael lahem yihye
Vereshit kal-bikkure chol vechal-terumat kol mikkol terumotechem lakkohanim yihye vereshit arisotechem tittenu lakkohen lehaniach beracha el-betecha
Kal-nevela utrefa min-haof umin-habbehema lo yochlu hakkohanim
Uvhappilchem et-haaretz benachala tarimu teruma la-Adonai kodesh min-haaretz orech chamishsha veesrim elef orech verochav asara alef kodesh-hu vechal-gevulah saviv
Yihye mizze el-hakkodesh chamesh meot bachamesh meot merubba saviv vachamishshim amma migrash lo saviv
Umin-hammidda hazzot tamod orech chamishsha veesrim elef verochav aseret alafim uvo-yihye hammikdash kodesh kadashim
Kodesh min-haaretz hu lakkohanim mesharte hammikdash yihye hakkerevim lesharet et-Adonai vehaya lahem makom levattim umikdash lammikdash
Vachamishsha veesrim elef orech vaaseret alafim rochav vehaya lalviyyim mesharte habbayit lahem laachuzza esrim leshachot
Vaachuzzat hair tittenu chameshet alafim rochav veorech chamishsha veesrim elef leummat terumat hakkodesh lechal-bet yisrael yihye

Velannasi mizze umizze litrumat hakkodesh velaachuzzat hair el-pene terumat-hakkodesh veel-pene achuzzat hair mippeat-yam yamma umippeat-kedma kadima veorech leummot achad hachalakim miggevul yam el-gevul kadima
Laaretz yihye-lo laachuzza beyisrael velo-yonu od nesiay et-ammi vehaaretz yittenu levet-yisrael leshivtehem
Ko-amar adonay Adonai rav-lachem nesie yisrael chamas vashod hasiru umishpat utzdaka asu harimu gerushotechem meal ammi neum adonay Adonai
Mozne-tzedek veefat-tzedek uvat-tzedek yehi lachem
Haefa vehabbat tochen echad yihye laset masar hachomer habbat vaasirit hachomer haefa el-hachomer yihye matkunto
Vehashshekel esrim gera esrim shekalim chamishsha veesrim shekalim asara vachamishsha shekel hammane yihye lachem
Zot hatteruma asher tarimu shishshit haefa mechomer hachittim veshishshitem haefa mechomer hasseorim
Vechok hashshemen habbat hashshemen masar habbat min-hakkor aseret habbattim chomer ki-aseret habbattim chomer
Vese-achat min-hatztzon min-hammatayim mimmashke yisrael lemincha ulola velishlamim lechapper alehem neum adonay Adonai
Kol haam haaretz yihu el-hatteruma hazzot lannasi beyisrael

Veal-hannasi yihye haolot vehammincha vehannesech bachaggim uvechodashim uvashshabbatot bechal-moade bet yisrael hu-yaase et-hachattat veet-hammincha veet-haola veet-hashshelamim lechapper bead bet-yisrael
Ko-amar adonay Adonai barishon beechad lachodesh tikkach par-ben-bakar tamim vechitteta et-hammikdash
Velakach hakkohen middam hachattat venatan el-mezuzat habbayit veel-arba pinnot haazara lammizbeach veal-mezuzat shaar hechatzer happenimit
Vechen taase beshiva vachodesh meish shoge umippeti vechippartem et-habbayit
Barishon bearbaa asar yom lachodesh yihye lachem happasach chag shevuot yamim matztzot yeachel
Veasa hannasi bayyom hahu baado uvad kal-am haaretz par chattat
Veshivat yeme-hechag yaase ola la-Adonai shivat parim veshivat elim temimim layyom shivat hayyamim vechattat seir izzim layyom
Umincha efa lappar veefa laayil yaase veshemen hin laefa
Bashshevii bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh bechag yaase chaelle shivat hayyamim kachattat kaola vechammincha vechashshamen
Ko-amar adonay Adonai shaar hechatzer happenimit happone kadim yihye sagur sheshet yeme hammaase uvom hashshabbat yippateach uvom hachodesh yippateach
Uva hannasi derech ulam hashshaar michutz veamad al-mezuzat hashshaar veasu hakkohanim et-olato veet-shelamav vehishtachava al-miftan hashshaar veyatza vehashshaar lo-yissager ad-haarev
Vehishtachau am-haaretz petach hashshaar hahu bashshabbatot uvechodashim lifne Adonai
Vehaola asher-yakriv hannasi la-Adonai beom hashshabbat shishsha chevasim temimim veayil tamim
Umincha efa laayil velakkevasim mincha mattat yado veshemen hin laefa
Uvom hachodesh par ben-bakar temimim vesheshet kevasim vaayil temimim yihu
Veefa lappar veefa laayil yaase mincha velakkevasim kaasher tassig yado veshemen hin laefa
Uvvo hannasi derech ulam hashshaar yavo uvdarko yetze

Uvvo am-haaretz lifne Adonai bammoadim habba derech-shaar tzafon lehishtachaot yetze derech-shaar negev vehabba derech-shaar negev yetze derech-shaar tzafona lo yashuv derech hashshaar asher-ba vo ki nichcho yetze
Vehannasi betocham bevoam yavo uvtzetam yetzeu
Uvachaggim uvammoadim tihye hammincha efa lappar veefa laayil velakkevasim mattat yado veshemen hin laefa
Vechi-yaase hannasi nedava ola o-shelamim nedava la-Adonai ufatach lo et hashshaar happone kadim veasa et-olato veet-shelamav kaasher yaase beom hashshabbat veyatza vesagar et-hashshaar achare tzeto
Vecheves ben-shenato tamim taase ola layyom la-Adonai babboker babboker taase oto
Umincha taase alav babboker babboker shishshit haefa veshemen shelishit hahin laros et-hassolet mincha la-Adonai chukkot olam tamid
Yaasu et-hakkeves veet-hammincha veet-hashshemen babboker babboker olat tamid
Ko-amar adonay Adonai ki-yitten hannasi mattana leish mibbanav nachalato hi levanav tihye achuzzatam hi benachala
Vechi-yitten mattana minnachalato leachad meavadav vehayeta lo ad-shenat hadderor veshavat lannasi ach nachalato banav lahem tihye
Velo-yikkach hannasi minnachalat haam lehonotam meachuzzatam meachuzzato yanchil et-banav lemaan asher lo-yafutzu ammi ish meachuzzato
Vayevieni vammavo asher al-ketef hashshaar el-hallishchot hakkodesh el-hakkohanim happonot tzafona vehinne-sham makom bayyarchatayim yamma
Vayyomer elay ze hammakom asher yevashshelu-sham hakkohanim et-haasham veet-hachattat asher yofu et-hammincha levilti hotzi el-hechatzer hachitzona lekaddesh et-haam
Vayyotzieni el-hechatzer hachitzona vayyaavireni el-arbaat miktzoe hechatzer vehinne chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer chatzer bemiktzoa hechatzer
Bearbaat miktzoot hechatzer chatzerot keturot arbaim orech ushloshim rochav midda achat learbatam mehuktzaot
Vetur saviv bahem saviv learbatam umvashshelot asuy mittachat hattirot saviv
Vayyomer elay elle bet hamvashshelim asher yevashshelu-sham mesharte habbayit et-zevach haam
Vayeshiveni el-petach habbayit vehinne-mayim yotzim mittachat miftan habbayit kadima ki-fene habbayit kadim vehammayim yordim mittachat mikketef habbayit hayemanit minnegev lammizbeach
Vayyotzieni derech-shaar tzafona vayesibbeni derech chutz el-shaar hachutz derech happone kadim vehinne-mayim mefakkim min-hakkatef hayemanit
Betzet-haish kadim vekav beyado vayyamad elef baamma vayyaavireni vammayim me afsayim
Vayyamad elef vayyaavireni vammayim mayim birkayim vayyamad elef vayyaavireni me matnayim
Vayyamad elef nachal asher lo-uchal laavor ki-gau hammayim me sachu nachal asher lo-yeaver
Vayyomer elay haraita ven-adam vayyolicheni vayeshiveni sefat hannachal
Beshuveni vehinne el-sefat hannachal etz rav meod mizze umizze
Vayyomer elay hammayim haelle yotzim el-haggelila hakkadmona veyardu al-haarava uvau hayyamma el-hayyamma hammutzaim venirpu hammayim
Vehaya chal-nefesh chayya asher-yishrotz el kal-asher yavo sham nachalayim yichye vehaya haddaga rabba meod ki vau shamma hammayim haelle veyerafu vachay kol asher-yavo shamma hannachal
Vehaya amdu alav davagim meen gedi vead-en eglayim mishtoach lacharamim yihu lemina tihye degatam kidgat hayyam haggadol rabba meod
Bitztzotav ugvaav velo yerafu lemelach nittanu
Veal-hannachal yaale al-sefato mizze umizze kal-etz-maachal lo-yibbol alehu velo-yittom piro lachodashav yevakker ki memav min-hammikdash hemma yotzim vehaya firo lemaachal vealehu litrufa
Ko amar adonay Adonai ge gevul asher titnachalu et-haaretz lishne asar shivte yisrael yosef chavalim
Unchaltem otah ish keachiv asher nasati et-yadi letittah laavotechem venafla haaretz hazzot lachem benachala
Veze gevul haaretz lifat tzafona min-hayyam haggadol hadderech chetlon levo tzedada
Chamat berota sivrayim asher ben-gevul dammesek uven gevul chamat chatzer hattichon asher el-gevul chaveran
Vehaya gevul min-hayyam chatzar enon gevul dammesek vetzafon tzafona ugvul chamat veet peat tzafon
Ufat kadim mibben chaveran umibben-dammesek umibben haggilad umibben eretz yisrael hayyarden miggevul al-hayyam hakkadmoni tamoddu veet peat kadima
Ufat negev temana mittamar ad-me merivot kadesh nachala el-hayyam haggadol veet peat-temana negba
Ufat-yam hayyam haggadol miggevul ad-nochach levo chamat zot peat-yam
Vechillaktem et-haaretz hazzot lachem leshivte yisrael

Hosea: Devar-Adonai asher haya el-hoshea ben-beeri bime uzziyya yotam achaz yechizkiyya malche yehuda uvime yaravam ben-yoash melech yisrael
Techillat dibber-Adonai behoshea f vayyomer Adonai el-hoshea lech kach-lecha eshet zenunim veyalde zenunim ki-zano tizne haaretz meachare Adonai
Vayyelech vayyikkach et-gomer bat-divlayim vattahar vatteled-lo ben
Vayyomer Adonai elav kera shemo yizreel ki-od meat ufakadti et-deme yizreel al-bet yehu vehishbatti mamlechut bet yisrael
Vehaya bayyom hahu veshavarti et-keshet yisrael beemek yizreel
Vattahar od vatteled bat vayyomer lo kera shemah lo ruchama ki lo osif od arachem et-bet yisrael ki-naso essa lahem
Veet-bet yehuda arachem vehoshatim ba-Adonai elohehem velo oshiem bekeshet uvcherev uvmilchama besusim uvfarashim
Vattigmol et-lo ruchama vattahar vatteled ben
Vayyomer kera shemo lo ammi ki attem lo ammi veanochi lo-ehye lachem
Vehaya mispar bene-yisrael kechol hayyam asher lo-yimmad velo yissafer vehaya bimkom asher-yeamer lahem lo-ammi attem yeamer lahem bene el-chay
Venikbetzu bene-yehuda uvne-yisrael yachdav vesamu lahem rosh echad vealu min-haaretz ki gadol yom yizreel
Imru laachechem ammi velaachotechem ruchama
Rivu veimmechem rivu ki-hi lo ishti veanochi lo ishah vetaser zenuneha mippane venaafufeha mibben shadeha
Pen-afshitenna arumma vehitztzagtiha keom hivaldah vesamtiha chammidbar veshattiha keeretz tziyya vahamittiha batztzama
Veet-baneha lo arachem ki-vene zenunim hemma
Ki zanta immam hovisha horatam ki amra elcha achare meahavay notne lachmi umemay tzamri ufishti shamni veshikkuyay
Lachen hinni-sach et-darkech bassirim vegadarti et-gederah untivoteha lo timtza
Veriddefa et-meahaveha velo-tassig otam uvikshatam velo timtza veamra elcha veashuva el-ishi harishon ki tov li az meatta
Vehi lo yada ki anochi natatti lah haddagan vehattirosh vehayyitzhar vechesef hirbeti lah vezahav asu labbaal
Lachen ashuv velakachti degani beitto vetiroshi bemoado vehitztzalti tzamri ufishti lechassot et-ervatah
Veatta agalle et-navlutah leene meahaveha veish lo-yatztzilenna miyyadi
Vehishbatti kal-mesosah chaggah chadshah veshabbattah vechol moadah
Vahashimmoti gafnah utenatah asher amra etna hemma li asher natnu-li meahavay vesamtim leyaar vaachalatam chayyat hassade
Ufakadti aleha et-yeme habbealim asher taktir lahem vattaad nizmah vechelyatah vattelech achare meahaveha veoti shachcha neum-Adonai
Lachen hinne anochi mefatteha veholachtiha hammidbar vedibbarti al libbah
Venatatti lah et-kerameha mishsham veet-emek achor lefetach tikva veanta shamma kime neureha vichom alotah meeretz-mitzrayim
Vehaya vayyom-hahu neum-Adonai tikrei ishi velo-tikrei-li od bali
Vahasiroti et-shemot habbealim mippiha velo-yizzachru od bishmam
Vecharatti lahem berit bayyom hahu im-chayyat hassade veim-of hashshamayim veremes haadama vekeshet vecherev umilchama eshbor min-haaretz vehishkavtim lavetach
Veerastich li leolam veerastich li betzedek uvmishpat uvchesed uvrachamim
Veerastich li beemuna veyadaatte et-Adonai
Vehaya bayyom hahu eene neum-Adonai eene et-hashshamayim vehem yaanu et-haaretz
Vehaaretz taane et-haddagan veet-hattirosh veet-hayyitzhar vehem yaanu et-yizreel
Uzratiha li baaretz verichamti et-lo ruchama veamarti lelo-ammi ammi-atta vehu yomar elohay
Vayyomer Adonai elay od lech ehav-ishsha ahuvat rea umnaafet keahavat Adonai et-bene yisrael vehem ponim el-elohim acherim veohave ashishe anavim
Vaekkereha li bachamishsha asar kasef vechomer seorim veletech seorim
Vaomar eleha yamim rabbim teshvi li lo tizni velo tihyi leish vegam-ani elayich
Ki yamim rabbim yeshvu bene yisrael en melech veen sar veen zevach veen matztzeva veen efod utrafim
Achar yashuvu bene yisrael uvikshu et-Adonai elohehem veet david malkam ufachadu el-Adonai veel-tuvo beacharit hayyamim
Shimu devar-Adonai bene yisrael ki riv la-Adonai im-yoshve haaretz ki en-emet veen-chesed veen-daat elohim baaretz
Alo vechachesh veratzoach veganov venaof paratzu vedamim bedamim nagau
Al-ken teeval haaretz veumlal kal-yoshev bah bechayyat hassade uvof hashshamayim vegam-dege hayyam yeasefu
Ach ish al-yarev veal-yochach ish veammecha kimrive chohen
Vechashalta hayyom vechashal gam-navi immecha layela vedamiti immecha
Nidmu ammi mibbeli haddaat ki-atta haddaat maasta veemascha mikkahen li vattishkach torat elohecha eshkach banecha gam-ani
Kerubbam ken chatu-li kevodam bekalon amir
Chattat ammi yochelu veel-aonam yisu nafsho
Vehaya chaam kakkohen ufakadti alav derachav umaalalav ashiv lo
Veachlu velo yisbau hiznu velo yifrotzu ki-et-Adonai azvu lishmor
Zenut veyayin vetirosh yikkach-lev
Ammi beetzo yishal umaklo yaggid lo ki ruach zenunim hita vayyiznu mittachat elohehem
Al-rashe heharim yezabbechu veal-haggevaot yekatteru tachat allon velivne veela ki tov tzillah al-ken tiznena benotechem vechallotechem tenaafna

Chavur atzabbim efrayim hannach-lo
Sar savam hazne hiznu ahavu hevu kalon maginneha

Shimu-zot hakkohanim vehakshivu bet yisrael uvet hammelech haazinu ki lachem hammishpat ki-fach heyitem lemitzpa vereshet perusa al-tavor
Veshachata setim hemiku vaani musar lechullam
Ani yadati efrayim veyisrael lo-nichchad mimmenni ki atta hizneta efrayim nitma yisrael
Lo yittenu maallehem lashuv el-elohehem ki ruach zenunim bekirbam veet-Adonai lo yadau
Veana geon-yisrael befanav veyisrael veefrayim yikkashlu baaonam kashal gam-yehuda immam

Ba-Adonai bagadu ki-vanim zarim yaladu atta yochlem chodesh et-chelkehem
Tiku shofar baggiva chatzotzra barama hariu bet aven acharecha binyamin

Al-tismach yisrael el-gil kaammim ki zanita meal elohecha ahavta etnan al kal-garnot dagan
